samples.source: 启用流式合成之后，首段可播延迟降到 800 毫秒以内。
samples.reference: With streaming synthesis enabled, the time to first playable audio drops below 800 milliseconds.
samples.hypothesis: After stream synthesis was enabled, the initial broadcast delay was reduced to less than 800 milliseconds.

samples.source: VAD 模型把这段录音切成了三个语音段，静音部分被丢弃。
samples.reference: The VAD model split this recording into three speech segments and dropped the silent parts.
samples.hypothesis: The VAD model cut the recording into three voice segments, with the silent portion discarded.

samples.source: Kokoro v1.1 用 int8 量化后模型体积约 320 MB，中文自然度接近可用。
samples.reference: After int8 quantization, Kokoro v1.1 ships at roughly 320 MB and Mandarin naturalness is close to usable.
samples.hypothesis: Kokoro v1.1 has a quantized model size of about 320 MB using int8, which is close to the naturalness of Chinese.

samples.source: SenseVoice 的自动语言检测在粤夹普的语料上表现不太稳定。
samples.reference: SenseVoice's automatic language detection is not very stable on Cantonese-Mandarin code-switched speech.
samples.hypothesis: SenseVoice's automatic language detection is not very stable on Cantonese.

samples.source: 实时档走 argos，端到端延迟约 200 毫秒，够做面对面场景。
samples.reference: The realtime mode runs through argos with end-to-end latency around 200 ms, fast enough for face-to-face scenarios.
samples.hypothesis: The real-time stream goes argos, with an end-to-end delay of about 200 milliseconds, enough for face-to-face scenes.

samples.source: 精译档走 madlad 加 ollama，质量优先，不承诺延迟预算。
samples.reference: The quality mode chains madlad and ollama and prioritizes accuracy over a latency budget.
samples.hypothesis: The proofreading file goes madlad plus ollama, quality first, no commitment to delay the budget.

samples.source: 隐私模式是硬不变量，任何配置都无法把云端引擎纳入路由。
samples.reference: Privacy mode is a hard invariant: no configuration can route cloud engines into the pipeline.
samples.hypothesis: The privacy mode is hard invariant, and no configuration can integrate the cloud engine into the routing.

samples.source: 翻译记忆命中率超过三成时，成本几乎只剩模型侧的一次性开销。
samples.reference: Once the translation memory hit rate passes thirty percent, cost is essentially a one-time model expense.
samples.hypothesis: When the translation memory hit rate exceeds 30 per cent, the cost is almost a one-time expense on the model side.

samples.source: 缓冲区太小会造成卡顿；太大会推高端到端延迟。
samples.reference: A buffer that is too small causes stuttering; one that is too large inflates end-to-end latency.
samples.hypothesis: A buffer that is too small will cause cartoning; a buffer that is too large will push up the end-to-end delay.

samples.source: 音频的采样率与位深决定了原始波形的数据量。
samples.reference: The sample rate and bit depth of audio determine the volume of raw waveform data.
samples.hypothesis: The sample rate and bit depth of the audio determine the amount of data in the original waveform.

samples.source: 单声道 16 千赫兹 16 位是语音识别最常见的输入格式。
samples.reference: Mono 16 kHz 16-bit is the most common input format for automatic speech recognition.
samples.hypothesis: The mono channel 16 kHz 16-bit is the most common input format for speech recognition.

samples.source: 双声道立体声在配音场景里通常会被下混回单声道再送入 ASR。
samples.reference: Stereo dual-channel audio is usually down-mixed to mono before being fed to the ASR model in a dubbing workflow.
samples.hypothesis: Bi-channel stereo is usually mixed back into the mono channel and sent to the ASR in the voiceover scene.

samples.source: 帧长 25 毫秒、帧移 10 毫秒是声学特征提取的常规配置。
samples.reference: A frame size of 25 ms and a frame shift of 10 ms is the standard setup for acoustic feature extraction.
samples.hypothesis: A frame length of 25 milliseconds and a frame shift of 10 milliseconds are typical configurations for acoustic feature extraction.

samples.source: 梅尔频谱图是把波形转换成模型可读输入的关键中间表示。
samples.reference: The mel spectrogram is the key intermediate representation that turns a waveform into something the model can read.
samples.hypothesis: The Merr spectrogram is the key intermediate representation for converting waveforms into model-readable input.

samples.source: 强制对齐可以把参考文本与识别输出逐字对齐，用于时间戳生成。
samples.reference: Forced alignment lines up the reference text and the recognition output word by word, used to generate timestamps.
samples.hypothesis: Forced alignment allows reference text to be aligned verbatim with the identification output for time stamp generation.

samples.source: 逆文本规整把 "二零二六年" 转成 "2026 年"，让下游解析更简单。
samples.reference: Inverse text normalization converts "two thousand twenty-six" into "2026" so downstream parsing is simpler.
samples.hypothesis: The reverse formatting changes "2026" to "2026" to make downstream analysis easier.

samples.source: 中英混排句子里，专用术语最好走术语表而不是让模型自由发挥。
samples.reference: In code-switched sentences, domain terminology should be pulled from the glossary rather than left to the model's imagination.
samples.hypothesis: In Chinese-English mixed sentences, it is better to use the glossary for specific terms rather than allow the model to play freely.

samples.source: Ollama 的提示注入要显式禁用思考模式，不然首字延迟会翻倍。
samples.reference: Prompt injection into Ollama must explicitly disable thinking mode, otherwise the time to first token doubles.
samples.hypothesis: Ollama prompts the inject to explicitly disable the thinking mode, otherwise the first-word delay will double.

samples.source: CUDA 提供程序在这块 RTX 4050 上给 TTS 带来的加速约 3 倍。
samples.reference: The CUDA provider gives TTS roughly a three-times speedup on this RTX 4050.
samples.hypothesis: The CUDA provider brings about 3x the acceleration to TTS on this RTX 4050.

samples.source: CPU 上跑 3B int8 模型的现实是每句 2 到 4 秒，不适合实时场景。
samples.reference: Running a 3B int8 model on CPU is realistically 2 to 4 seconds per sentence, not fit for realtime scenarios.
samples.hypothesis: The reality of the 3B int8 model is 2 to 4 seconds per sentence, which is not suitable for real-time scenarios.

samples.source: 字幕轨导出成 SRT 之后可以直接被播放器读取，不需要重新编码视频。
samples.reference: The subtitle track exported as SRT can be read directly by players without re-encoding the video.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle tracks exported to SRT can be read directly by the player without re-encoding the video.

samples.source: 双语字幕要求时序对齐：中文行与英文行必须落在同一时间窗口内。
samples.reference: Bilingual subtitles require timing alignment: the Chinese and English lines must share the same time window.
samples.hypothesis: Bilingual subtitles require chronological alignment: the Chinese and English lines must fall within the same time window.

samples.source: 硬字幕是烧进画面的，之后想改只能重编码；软字幕可以随时替换。
samples.reference: Burned-in subtitles are part of the picture, so editing them later requires re-encoding; soft subtitles can be swapped at any time.
samples.hypothesis: Hard captions are burned into the image and can only be re-encoded later; soft captions can be replaced at any time.

samples.source: 配音与对口型是两回事：前者关注语音替换，后者关注画面同步。
samples.reference: Dubbing and lip sync are separate concerns: the first replaces the audio, the second keeps the picture in sync.
samples.hypothesis: Voice-overs and voice-overs are two different things: the former focuses on voice substitution, the latter focuses on image synchronization.

samples.source: 声画同步误差控制在 40 毫秒以内，人眼才不会觉得违和。
samples.reference: Audio-video sync error within 40 milliseconds is imperceptible to human viewers.
samples.hypothesis: Synchronization errors are controlled within 40 milliseconds, so that the human eye does not feel any disturbance.

samples.source: 量化参数越高压缩率越高但画质损失越明显，需要在两者之间取舍。
samples.reference: A higher quantization parameter means a smaller bitrate but worse quality; the trade-off has to be tuned.
samples.hypothesis: The higher the quantification parameter, the higher the compression rate but the more obvious the loss of image quality, and a trade-off between the two is required.

samples.source: GOP 越长比特率越低但快进快退越迟钝，直播场景一般不超过 2 秒。
samples.reference: A longer GOP lowers bitrate but makes seek response sluggish; live streaming usually caps it at two seconds.
samples.hypothesis: The longer the GOP, the lower the bitrate, but the faster the retreat, the slower the retreat, and the live-streaming scene usually does not exceed 2 seconds.

samples.source: 词错误率与字符错误率不能相互替代，中文更常用字符错误率。
samples.reference: Word error rate and character error rate are not interchangeable; Chinese benchmarks typically report character error rate.
samples.hypothesis: The word error rate and the character error rate are not interchangeable, and the character error rate is more commonly used in Chinese.

samples.source: FLORES-101 是通用域，与产品主打的涉密文档与批量本地化场景仍有分布差。
samples.reference: FLORES-101 is general domain, still a distributional mismatch with the confidential-document and batch-localization scenarios this product targets.
samples.hypothesis: FLORES-101 is a generic domain, and there is still a distribution gap between the product-focused encrypted documentation and the bulk localization scenario.

samples.source: 术语表按语言对检索，同名条目在通用与领域之间会冲突，需要 domain 段来分组。
samples.reference: The glossary is looked up by language pair; entries with the same source term collide between generic and domain rows, so the primary key needs a domain segment.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary is searched by language pair, and homonymous entries conflict between generic and domain, requiring the domain section to group them.

samples.source: 语音活动检测的阈值调低会把呼吸声也切成语音段，调高则会吞掉句末弱读。
samples.reference: Lowering the voice activity detection threshold cuts breathing into speech segments as well; raising it swallows weak syllables at sentence ends.
samples.hypothesis: Lowering the threshold for speech activity detection will also cut the breath sound into speech segments, while raising it will swallow the end-of-phrase weak reading.

samples.source: 自动语音识别的后处理通常包含标点恢复与数字规整两个独立步骤。
samples.reference: Post-processing for automatic speech recognition usually involves two independent steps: punctuation restoration and number normalization.
samples.hypothesis: The post-processing of automatic speech recognition typically involves two separate steps: punctuation recovery and digital correction.

samples.source: 神经机器翻译的编码器把源句压成上下文向量，解码器再自回归生成目标句。
samples.reference: In neural machine translation the encoder squeezes the source sentence into a context vector and the decoder autoregressively generates the target sentence.
samples.hypothesis: In neural machine translation, the encoder compresses the source sentence into a context vector, and the decoder returns to generate the target sentence.

samples.source: 文本转语音的前端要做分词、字音转换和韵律预测三级流水，任一级掉链子都会破坏自然度。
samples.reference: The text-to-speech frontend runs three stages -- tokenization, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion and prosody prediction -- and a failure in any of them hurts naturalness.
samples.hypothesis: At the front end of text-to-speech, there are three levels of flow: hyphenation, phonological transformation, and rhythm prediction.

samples.source: 流式识别与离线识别的差别不只是延迟，还包括前缀假设与最终结果的一致性。
samples.reference: Streaming recognition differs from offline recognition not only in latency but also in the consistency between prefix hypotheses and the final result.
samples.hypothesis: The difference between stream identification and offline identification is not only in delay, but also in the consistency of the prefix assumption with the final result.

samples.source: 同声传译产品化时最常见的取舍是 "延迟换准确率"，滑窗大小直接决定这两者。
samples.reference: The most common trade-off when productizing real-time interpretation is "buying accuracy with latency", and the sliding-window size directly determines both.
samples.hypothesis: The most common trade-off in simultaneous interpretation productization is "delay for accuracy", and the size of the slider directly determines both.

samples.source: 批量本地化管线要能在 1000 句的规模下保持每小时不崩，因此断点续传与幂等重跑是硬要求。
samples.reference: A batch localization pipeline must survive a thousand-sentence run for hours without crashing, which makes checkpoint-resume and idempotent retries hard requirements.
samples.hypothesis: A batch local pipeline must be able to remain unbroken every hour at a scale of 1000 statements, so breakpoint retransmission and potential rerunning are tough requirements.

samples.source: 语音翻译与文本翻译共用同一套路由：TM 命中、隐私钳制、语言对分档、置信度门控、AI 升级。
samples.reference: Speech translation and text translation share the same routing: TM hit, privacy clamp, per-language-pair tiering, confidence gating and AI upgrade.
samples.hypothesis: Speech translation shares the same routing as text translation: TM hits, privacy locks, language pairs, trust level controls, and AI upgrades.

samples.source: 端点检测比 VAD 更严格，它需要区分 "句子说完" 与 "句中停顿"。
samples.reference: Endpoint detection is stricter than VAD -- it has to distinguish "sentence finished" from "pause inside a sentence".
samples.hypothesis: The endpoint detection is more stringent than the VAD, as it needs to distinguish between "the end of a sentence" and "pauses in a sentence".

samples.source: 说话人分离在会议录音上表现好，在重叠说话的播客里就明显退化。
samples.reference: Speaker diarization works well on meeting recordings but degrades visibly on podcasts with overlapping speech.
samples.hypothesis: Speaker separation performs well on conference recordings, but degrades significantly in podcasts with overlapping speeches.

samples.source: 情感语音合成需要额外一路韵律条件，不能只靠文本前端。
samples.reference: Expressive speech synthesis needs an extra prosody conditioning channel and cannot rely on the text frontend alone.
samples.hypothesis: Emotional speech synthesis requires additional one-way rhythmic conditions, not just the front end of the text.

samples.source: 零样本音色克隆只要 5 秒参考音频就能起步，但对采样率与信噪比敏感。
samples.reference: Zero-shot speaker cloning can start from just five seconds of reference audio but is sensitive to sample rate and signal-to-noise ratio.
samples.hypothesis: Zero-sample tone cloning can start with as little as 5 seconds of reference audio, but is sensitive to sample rate and signal-to-noise ratio.

samples.source: 语音识别的置信度分数不能直接搬到翻译置信度上，两者校准曲线完全不同。
samples.reference: A speech recognition confidence score cannot be lifted directly into a translation confidence score; their calibration curves are entirely different.
samples.hypothesis: Speech recognition confidence scores cannot be directly transferred to translation confidence scores, which have completely different calibration curves.

samples.source: Kokoro 的中文男声 sid 45-52 中，52 混排表现最好，48 更贴近播音腔。
samples.reference: Among Kokoro's Mandarin voices at sid 45-52, 52 handles CJK/Latin code-switching best while 48 sits closer to a broadcast tone.
samples.hypothesis: In Kokoro's Chinese male voice sid 45-52,52 the mix performs best,48 closer to the broadcast cavity.

samples.source: Whisper 类模型在长语音上会漂移，切片策略一般按 VAD 边界而不是固定 30 秒。
samples.reference: Whisper-style models drift on long audio, so the standard slicing policy follows VAD boundaries rather than a fixed 30 seconds.
samples.hypothesis: Whisper-type models drift over long voices, and slicing strategies are generally based on VAD boundaries rather than fixed 30 seconds.

samples.source: 流式 ASR 的因果性约束意味着当前的识别不能引用未来帧，与离线模型有本质差别。
samples.reference: The causality constraint in streaming ASR means the current hypothesis cannot look ahead to future frames -- a fundamental difference from offline models.
samples.hypothesis: The causal constraints of the flow ASR mean that the current identification cannot refer to future frames, which is inherently different from the offline model.

samples.source: 实时字幕的常见做法是稳定前缀 + 浮动后缀，让阅读体验不至于一句话改三遍。
samples.reference: Real-time subtitles usually stabilize the prefix and let the suffix float, so a single sentence is not rewritten three times for the reader.
samples.hypothesis: The common practice for real-time subtitles is a stable prefix + floating suffix, so that the reading experience does not involve changing a sentence three times.

samples.source: 批量本地化任务往往跨夜跑，日志聚合与断言式失败必须能事后重放。
samples.reference: Batch localization jobs often run overnight, so log aggregation and assertion-style failures must be replayable after the fact.
samples.hypothesis: Bulk localization tasks often run overnight, and log aggregation and assertive failures must be replayable afterwards.

samples.source: 端到端语音翻译把 ASR、MT、TTS 融成一个模型，牺牲可解释性换更低延迟。
samples.reference: End-to-end speech translation collapses ASR, MT and TTS into a single model, trading interpretability for lower latency.
samples.hypothesis: End-to-end voice translation combines ASR, MT, and TTS into one model, sacrificing interpretability for lower latency.

samples.source: 语音采样率与位深决定了奈奎斯特频率上限，16 千赫兹的语音只能表达 8 千赫兹以下的成分。
samples.reference: The audio sample rate and bit depth set the Nyquist ceiling; 16 kHz speech can only carry content below 8 kHz.
samples.hypothesis: Speech sampling rate and bit depth determine the upper limit of the Nyquist frequency, and 16 kHz speech can only express components below 8 kHz.

samples.source: 声码器负责把频谱反演回波形，Griffin-Lim 慢而糊，神经网络声码器快且清晰。
samples.reference: A vocoder inverts the spectrum back into a waveform -- Griffin-Lim is slow and muddy, while neural vocoders are fast and clean.
samples.hypothesis: The encoder is responsible for reversing the frequency spectrum back to the waveform, the Griffin-Lim is slow and blurry, and the neural network encoder is fast and clear.

samples.source: 基频 F0 的估计常用自相关或 YIN 算法，浊音段准，清音段本身就是噪声。
samples.reference: Fundamental-frequency estimation usually uses autocorrelation or YIN; both are accurate on voiced segments, but unvoiced segments are noise by definition.
samples.hypothesis: Estimates of the base frequency F0 are often made using self-correlation or YIN algorithms, with the muffled band accurate and the clear band itself being noise.

samples.source: 倒谱系数取前 40 维已经足够覆盖大部分人耳可辨的频谱特征。
samples.reference: The first 40 cepstral coefficients already cover most of the spectral detail the human ear can distinguish.
samples.hypothesis: The first 40 dimensions of the inverted spectral coefficient are sufficient to cover most of the frequency spectrum that is audible to the human ear.

samples.source: 立体声到单声道 down-mix 需要按能量归一而不是简单平均，不然左右声道的相位差会引入染色。
samples.reference: Down-mixing stereo to mono should normalize by energy rather than average samples, otherwise the phase difference between channels colors the output.
samples.hypothesis: Stereo to mono channel down-mixing requires energy unification rather than simple averaging, otherwise the phase difference between the left and right channels will introduce staining.

samples.source: 静音压缩通过保留 VAD 判定的语音段来实现，会议录音可以省下 30% 到 50% 时长。
samples.reference: Silence compression keeps only the segments VAD flags as speech, saving 30 to 50 percent of the length on typical meeting recordings.
samples.hypothesis: Silent compression is achieved by retaining VAD-determined voice segments, which can save 30% to 50% of the length of a meeting recording.

samples.source: 重采样从 48 千赫兹降到 16 千赫兹要先做抗混叠低通滤波，不然高频会折叠进语音带。
samples.reference: Resampling from 48 kHz to 16 kHz must apply an anti-aliasing low-pass filter first, otherwise high frequencies fold into the speech band.
samples.hypothesis: Re-sampling from 48 kHz to 16 kHz requires an anti-mixing low-pass filter, otherwise the high frequencies will be folded into the vocal band.

samples.source: 信噪比低于 10 分贝的现场录音通常要先做降噪再送 ASR。
samples.reference: Field recordings with a signal-to-noise ratio below 10 dB usually need denoising before being sent to ASR.
samples.hypothesis: Live recordings with a signal-to-noise ratio of less than 10 dB are usually noise-reduced before sending to ASR.

samples.source: 预加重滤波把高频抬起来，能让后续特征提取对小擦音更敏感。
samples.reference: Pre-emphasis filtering lifts high frequencies so that later feature extraction is more sensitive to weak fricatives.
samples.hypothesis: The pre-weighted filter raises the high frequencies, making subsequent feature extraction more sensitive to small frictions.

samples.source: 分帧时常用的汉明窗能显著削弱矩形窗带来的吉布斯振铃。
samples.reference: A Hamming window is standard during framing and noticeably reduces the Gibbs ringing a rectangular window would introduce.
samples.hypothesis: The Hammond window, which is commonly used for splitting frames, significantly reduces the Gibbs bell caused by the rectangular window.

samples.source: 帧率 25 fps 是影视的常规，50 fps 会让观众觉得 "太像新闻"。
samples.reference: A 25 fps frame rate is normal for film; 50 fps makes viewers feel it "looks too much like news footage".
samples.hypothesis: A frame rate of 25 fps is common in video, and 50 fps would make viewers feel "too much like news".

samples.source: 位深度从 16 升到 24 位不会让响度更大，但动态范围与量化噪声显著改善。
samples.reference: Raising bit depth from 16 to 24 does not increase loudness but improves dynamic range and quantization noise noticeably.
samples.hypothesis: Bit depth from 16 bit to 24 bit does not increase volume, but dynamic range and quantized noise are significantly improved.

samples.source: 音画同步在编码链路上要留一个音视频缓冲差，视频通常比音频晚 20 毫秒。
samples.reference: Audio-video sync has to leave a small buffer skew in the encoding chain -- video is typically about 20 ms behind audio.
samples.hypothesis: Audio-video synchronization leaves an audio-video buffer on the encoding link, and video is usually 20 milliseconds later than audio.

samples.source: 声道布局从 5.1 下混到立体声要用 Dolby Pro Logic 而不是简单相加。
samples.reference: Down-mixing from 5.1 to stereo should use Dolby Pro Logic rather than a straight sum.
samples.hypothesis: Channel layouts are mixed from 5.1 down to stereo using Dolby Pro Logic rather than simply adding.

samples.source: 频谱质心、零过率、能量这三个特征就能把音乐与语音分开。
samples.reference: Spectral centroid, zero-crossing rate and energy are enough to separate music from speech.
samples.hypothesis: The three characteristics of frequency mass, zero excess, and energy separate music from speech.

samples.source: 梅尔刻度是仿人耳感知非线性；线性刻度做 FFT 直接分箱不符合听觉心理。
samples.reference: The mel scale mirrors the non-linear frequency perception of human hearing; a linear FFT binning does not match psychoacoustics.
samples.hypothesis: The Merr scale is non-linear in human-like perception; the linear scale for FFT direct boxing is not consistent with auditory psychology.

samples.source: 基音周期与共振峰是语音产生物理模型里最基础的两个概念。
samples.reference: Pitch period and formants are the two most basic concepts in the physical model of speech production.
samples.hypothesis: The phonological cycle and resonance peak are two of the most fundamental concepts in the phonobiology model.

samples.source: 声纹识别与说话人分离是两回事：前者固定身份集合做识别，后者只做聚类不分身份。
samples.reference: Voiceprint recognition and speaker diarization are not the same: the first identifies a fixed set of speakers, the second only clusters without identities.
samples.hypothesis: Vocal pattern recognition and speaker separation are two different things: the former identifies a fixed set of identities, while the latter only clusters without distinction of identity.

samples.source: 音频缓冲不足会引发 dropout，视频缓冲不足会引发跳帧，两者表现不同但根因都是背压。
samples.reference: Insufficient audio buffering causes dropouts, insufficient video buffering causes frame skips -- different symptoms but the same root cause is backpressure.
samples.hypothesis: Insufficient audio buffering causes dropout, and insufficient video buffering causes frame skipping, both behaving differently but rooted in back pressure.

samples.source: 流式协议里 chunk 与 packet 常被混用，但对时延统计而言是两个概念。
samples.reference: In streaming protocols chunk and packet are often used interchangeably, but for latency accounting they are two different concepts.
samples.hypothesis: In stream protocols, chunk and packet are often used interchangeably, but they are two different concepts for time lag statistics.

samples.source: 抖动缓冲动态调整目标延迟，网络好时压到 20 毫秒，网络差时拉到 200 毫秒。
samples.reference: A jitter buffer dynamically retargets delay -- pushing it down to 20 ms when the network is good and stretching it to 200 ms when the network is bad.
samples.hypothesis: The shake buffer dynamically adjusts the target delay to 20 milliseconds when the network is good and 200 milliseconds when the network is bad.

samples.source: 流水线里任何一级的吞吐瓶颈都会把上游顶爆，反压信号必须能一路传回输入端。
samples.reference: Any throughput bottleneck in a pipeline will back up everything upstream, so the backpressure signal has to propagate all the way to the input.
samples.hypothesis: A bottleneck at any level in the pipeline will blow up the upstream, and the back pressure signal must be able to go all the way back to the input.

samples.source: TCP 的重传会破坏实时性，音视频低延迟场景普遍走 UDP 加前向纠错。
samples.reference: TCP retransmission ruins real-time behaviour; low-latency audio and video usually ride on UDP with forward error correction.
samples.hypothesis: TCP retransmission undermines real-timeness, and audio-video low-latency scenarios generally go UDP plus forward error correction.

samples.source: 关键帧间隔太长会让 seek 卡顿，太短会让相同画质下比特率翻倍。
samples.reference: Keyframes spaced too far apart make seeking stutter; too close and the bitrate doubles for the same quality.
samples.hypothesis: A keyframe interval that is too long will make the search cardon, while a keyframe interval that is too short will double the bitrate at the same quality.

samples.source: 分块处理时相邻块要有 50% 重叠，不然边界处的能量估计会跳变。
samples.reference: Chunked processing needs 50 percent overlap between adjacent chunks, otherwise the energy estimate jumps at the boundaries.
samples.hypothesis: Block processing requires 50% overlap between adjacent blocks, otherwise the energy at the boundary is estimated to jump.

samples.source: 冲刷操作的语义是 "把当前缓冲里的内容全部吐出去并结束本段"。
samples.reference: Flush means "emit everything currently in the buffer and terminate this segment".
samples.hypothesis: The semantics of the wipe operation is "spit out all the contents of the current buffer and end the paragraph".

samples.source: 端到端流水线里背压没设计好时，最下游的消费者慢就整条链堵死。
samples.reference: If backpressure is not designed in an end-to-end pipeline, a slow consumer at the tail stalls the entire chain.
samples.hypothesis: When back-pressure in the end-to-end pipeline is not designed properly, the downstream consumer slowly blocks the entire chain.

samples.source: 缓冲预取一般按帧数而不是按时长，因为帧才是模型的原子单位。
samples.reference: Buffer prefetch usually counts in frames, not in seconds, because a frame is the atomic unit of the model.
samples.hypothesis: The buffer is generally pre-loaded by the number of frames rather than by the length of time, since frames are the atomic units of the model.

samples.source: 流式合成的边界要落在词或短语之后，切在助词或连词中间会明显刺耳。
samples.reference: Streaming synthesis boundaries should land after a word or phrase; cutting at a particle or conjunction is audibly jarring.
samples.hypothesis: The boundary of flow synthesis lies after a word or phrase, and the cut in the middle of an adverb or conjunction is noticeably stingy.

samples.source: 数据报传输协议丢一两个包时解码器要能优雅丢帧而不是崩。
samples.reference: When the datagram transport protocol drops one or two packets, the decoder should gracefully conceal rather than crash.
samples.hypothesis: When the data transfer protocol loses one or two packets, the decoder must be able to elegantly lose frames instead of crashing.

samples.source: 恒定比特率适合广播，可变比特率适合存储；两者的缓冲模型完全不同。
samples.reference: Constant bitrate suits broadcast, variable bitrate suits storage -- their buffering models are completely different.
samples.hypothesis: Constant bitrate is suitable for broadcasting, and variable bitrate is suitable for storage; the buffering models are completely different.

samples.source: 容器只负责封装与同步，编解码器负责压缩；把 mkv 转成 mp4 不需要重编码。
samples.reference: The container only handles packaging and synchronisation; the codec handles compression. Turning an mkv into an mp4 needs no re-encoding.
samples.hypothesis: The container is only responsible for packaging and synchronization, and the codec is responsible for compression; converting mkv to mp4 does not require re-encoding.

samples.source: 比特流的网络抽象层携带时序与合成信息，缺失会让解码器无法正确解码。
samples.reference: The network abstraction layer of the bitstream carries timing and composition information; missing it leaves the decoder unable to render correctly.
samples.hypothesis: The network abstraction layer of the bitstream carries sequence and synthesis information, the absence of which would prevent the decoder from decoding correctly.

samples.source: 编码器要显式声明 profile 与 level，播放器据此判断能不能吃下这条流。
samples.reference: The encoder must declare its profile and level explicitly so the player can decide whether it can accept this stream.
samples.hypothesis: The encoder explicitly declares the profile and level, and the player decides whether or not to eat the stream.

samples.source: 解复用就是把一个容器拆开成若干条音视频字幕轨，不做任何解码。
samples.reference: Demultiplexing means splitting a container into its video, audio and subtitle tracks without decoding anything.
samples.hypothesis: Decoding is the process of splitting a container into several audio-video subtitle tracks without any decoding.

samples.source: 无损压缩对波形做熵编码，可以逐比特还原；有损压缩引入量化误差。
samples.reference: Lossless compression entropy-codes the waveform and can restore it bit-for-bit; lossy compression introduces quantization error.
samples.hypothesis: Lossless compression encodes the waveform with entropy and can be restored bit by bit; lossy compression introduces quantization errors.

samples.source: 转码时如果源和目标编解码器不同，一定要经过帧缓冲重排。
samples.reference: Transcoding between different source and target codecs must go through a frame buffer for reorder.
samples.hypothesis: If the source and target codecs are different, the frame buffer must be rearranged during transcoding.

samples.source: 帧内预测只依赖当前帧，帧间预测要引用参考帧，二者的错误传播特性不同。
samples.reference: Intra-frame prediction depends only on the current frame; inter-frame prediction references other frames, and the two propagate errors differently.
samples.hypothesis: In-frame predictions rely only on the current frame, while inter-frame predictions refer to reference frames, which have different error propagation characteristics.

samples.source: 运动估计的搜索半径越大越精确但也越慢，默认 16 像素是常见折中。
samples.reference: A larger motion-estimation search radius is more accurate but slower; 16 pixels is the common default.
samples.hypothesis: The larger the search radius, the more accurate but also slower the motion estimate, with the default of 16 pixels being a common fold.

samples.source: 熵编码用霍夫曼或算术编码；算术编码效率略高但专利与复杂度都是负担。
samples.reference: Entropy coding uses Huffman or arithmetic coding -- the latter is slightly more efficient but carries patent and complexity overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Entropic encoding uses Hoffman or arithmetic encoding; arithmetic encoding is slightly more efficient but both patent and complexity are burdensome.

samples.source: 码率控制要感知内容，静态场景压低码率，运动场景放开码率。
samples.reference: Rate control should be content-aware: lower bitrate for static scenes, higher bitrate for motion-heavy scenes.
samples.hypothesis: The bitrate control to perceive the content, static scenes lower the bitrate, motion scenes release the bitrate.

samples.source: AVC、HEVC、VVC 每一代同画质下比特率大致降一半，复杂度大约翻倍。
samples.reference: Each generation from AVC to HEVC to VVC roughly halves the bitrate for the same quality but doubles the complexity.
samples.hypothesis: AVC, HEVC, VCC Each generation reduces the bitrate by approximately half and the complexity by approximately twice at the same quality.

samples.source: Opus 在 6 到 512 千比特率之间自适应，是互联网语音的默认选择。
samples.reference: Opus adapts between 6 and 512 kbps and is the default choice for voice on the internet.
samples.hypothesis: Opus adapts between 6 and 512 kbit/s and is the default choice for Internet voice.

samples.source: FLAC 无损压缩率大约 5:1，适合母带归档；MP3 是有损，别用来做二压。
samples.reference: FLAC compresses losslessly around 5:1 and is suited to archiving masters; MP3 is lossy and should never be secondarily compressed.
samples.hypothesis: FLAC has a lossless compression ratio of about 5:1, which is suitable for tape archives; MP3 is lossy, and should not be used for double compression.

samples.source: 视频字幕要处理换行宽度、字符编码与字体缺字三个独立问题。
samples.reference: Video subtitles have to handle three independent problems: line-width wrapping, character encoding and missing glyphs.
samples.hypothesis: Video captions have to deal with three separate issues of line width, character encoding, and font omissions.

samples.source: SubRip 只有时间轴与文本两栏，样式能力弱；ASS 有事件与样式两栏，能表达卡拉OK。
samples.reference: SubRip only has timing and text fields, weak styling; ASS adds event and style sections and can express karaoke effects.
samples.hypothesis: SubRip has only a timeline and two columns of text, and weak styling capabilities; ASS has two columns of events and styles, and can express karaoke.

samples.source: WebVTT 是 W3C 定义的网页字幕格式，天然与 HTML5 播放器对接。
samples.reference: WebVTT is the W3C-defined subtitle format for the web and slots straight into HTML5 players.
samples.hypothesis: WebVTT is a W3C-defined web subtitle format that naturally integrates with HTML5 players.

samples.source: 逐字时间戳需要强制对齐输出，纯 ASR 只有段级时间戳。
samples.reference: Word-level timestamps require forced-alignment output; ASR alone only provides segment-level timing.
samples.hypothesis: Word-by-word timestamps require forced alignment output, while pure ASR only requires segment-by-segment timestamps.

samples.source: 字幕断行要按语义而不是按字符数：把 "声画同步" 拆到两行会破坏阅读。
samples.reference: Subtitle line breaks should follow meaning rather than character count; splitting "audio-video sync" across two lines wrecks readability.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitles should break semantically rather than by number of characters: splitting "synchronization" into two lines would disrupt reading.

samples.source: 硬字幕化流程 = 抽帧、烧字、重编码；每一步都可能引入代际损失。
samples.reference: Burning in subtitles means extracting frames, drawing captions and re-encoding -- each step can add a generation of loss.
samples.hypothesis: Hard subtitling process = extraction, burning, recoding; each step may introduce intergenerational losses.

samples.source: 对口型算法在真人上主要看嘴部关键点，在动画上要看帧与语音能量包络。
samples.reference: Lip-sync algorithms track mouth keypoints on real people and match frame-by-frame energy envelopes on animation.
samples.hypothesis: On real people, the mouth-type algorithm looks primarily at the key points of the mouth, while on animation it looks at the frame and voice energy envelope.

samples.source: 配音时原声要压低 12 分贝做 ducking，不然观众听不清配音。
samples.reference: When dubbing, duck the original audio by 12 dB or viewers will miss the new voice.
samples.hypothesis: The original voice is ducked by 12 dB, otherwise the audience will not be able to hear the voice.

samples.source: 解说场景往往需要保留少量背景音，纯静音配音会让人出戏。
samples.reference: Voiceover scenes usually keep a little background ambience; pure silence makes the viewer drop out of the scene.
samples.hypothesis: Explanatory scenes often need to retain a small amount of background sound, and silent voice-overs can get people out of their comfort zone.

samples.source: 多角色配音要按说话人分离结果分别合成，再按时间戳混流。
samples.reference: Multi-role dubbing must synthesise each speaker separately by diarization result, then remux by timestamp.
samples.hypothesis: Multiple voices are synthesized separately as a result of speaker separation and then mixed by time stamp.

samples.source: 双语字幕对齐时如果两边段落数不同，宁可拆段也不要错开。
samples.reference: When bilingual subtitles have mismatched segment counts, split segments rather than let them drift out of phase.
samples.hypothesis: When aligning bilingual subtitles, if the number of paragraphs on both sides is different, it is preferable to divide the paragraphs without misalignment.

samples.source: 时间轴漂移在长视频里会累积，每 10 分钟要人工核对一次锚点。
samples.reference: Timeline drift accumulates on long videos; check the anchors by hand every ten minutes.
samples.hypothesis: Timeline drifts accumulate in long videos, and anchor points need to be checked manually every 10 minutes.

samples.source: 音轨抽取常用 ffmpeg 的 -vn 参数，代价是重封装而不是重编码。
samples.reference: Extracting an audio track usually uses ffmpeg's -vn flag; the cost is remuxing, not re-encoding.
samples.hypothesis: Audio tracks are extracted using the common ffmpeg -vn parameter, at the cost of repackaging rather than re-encoding.

samples.source: 字幕嵌入视频流会让不支持字幕的播放器也能显示，代价是不可关闭。
samples.reference: Embedding subtitles into the video stream lets even non-subtitle players display them, at the cost of losing the on/off toggle.
samples.hypothesis: Embedding subtitles into a video stream allows players that do not support subtitles to display it, at the cost of not being able to turn it off.

samples.source: 视频重封装时如果编码格式没变，可以逐包拷贝，秒级完成。
samples.reference: Remuxing a video where the codec has not changed can copy packet-by-packet and finish in seconds.
samples.hypothesis: If the encoding format remains unchanged when the video is re-encoded, it can be copied packet-by-packet, in seconds.

samples.source: 帧精确的字幕对齐要求毫秒级时间戳，段级精度在快语速时不够用。
samples.reference: Frame-accurate subtitle alignment requires millisecond timestamps; segment-level accuracy is not enough for fast speech.
samples.hypothesis: Frame-accurate caption alignment requires millisecond time stamps, and paragraph-level accuracy is not sufficient at fast speech speeds.

samples.source: 时间码 SMPTE 12 小时制在 30 帧率下有掉帧与非掉帧两种，跨系统同步时要显式声明。
samples.reference: SMPTE 12-hour timecode has drop-frame and non-drop-frame variants at 30 fps; state which one when synchronising across systems.
samples.hypothesis: SMPTE 12-hour timecodes at 30 frames per second have drop-frames and non-drop-frames, which must be explicitly declared when synchronizing across systems.

samples.source: 配音脚本的时长要与原视频对齐，写译文时要按 "口型开放度" 估算音节上限。
samples.reference: Dubbing scripts must match the duration of the original video; when writing translations, estimate the syllable budget from visible mouth openness.
samples.hypothesis: The length of the voice-over script should be aligned with the original video, and the upper limit of syllables should be estimated by "mouth openness" when writing the translation.

samples.source: 模型检查点最好同时保存权重、优化器状态与 tokenizer，方便续训与推理。
samples.reference: A model checkpoint should store weights, optimiser state and the tokenizer together, so resuming training and inference are both easy.
samples.hypothesis: The model checkpoints should save the weights, optimizer states, and tokenizer at the same time to facilitate retraining and reasoning.

samples.source: 子词切分把未登录词拆成可组合的部件，词表大小与切分粒度直接相关。
samples.reference: Subword tokenization breaks unknown words into combinable pieces; vocabulary size and merge granularity are directly related.
samples.hypothesis: Subsplicing breaks down unregistered words into assembleable parts, and the size of the glossary is directly related to the granularity of the slicing.

samples.source: 字节对编码从字符级开始反复合并高频对，构造出面向该语料的最优词表。
samples.reference: Byte-pair encoding starts from characters and repeatedly merges the most frequent pairs, producing a vocabulary optimised for that corpus.
samples.hypothesis: Byte pairing encoding begins at the character level by repeatedly combining high-frequency pairs to construct the optimal vocabulary for the language.

samples.source: 词嵌入把符号映射到连续空间，语义相近的词在向量空间里距离更近。
samples.reference: Word embeddings map symbols into continuous space so that semantically similar words lie close together in the vector space.
samples.hypothesis: Word embedding maps symbols to a continuous space, where semantically close words are closer apart in the vector space.

samples.source: 注意力机制允许解码器在每一步软选择性地查看源句的所有位置。
samples.reference: Attention allows the decoder at every step to softly inspect every position in the source sentence.
samples.hypothesis: The attention mechanism allows the decoder to softly selectively look at all positions of the source statement at each step.

samples.source: Transformer 用自注意力替代循环结构，训练时并行度高但推理时 KV 缓存吃内存。
samples.reference: The Transformer replaces recurrence with self-attention -- high parallelism during training, but KV-cache cost at inference time.
samples.hypothesis: Transformer uses self-attention to replace the loop structure, which is high-parallel in training but KV-cached in reasoning.

samples.source: 量化到 int8 后模型体积大约压到三分之一，速度提升视硬件与算子而定。
samples.reference: Quantising to int8 shrinks the model to about a third of its size; the speed gain depends on hardware and operators.
samples.hypothesis: After quantization to int8, the model volume is compressed to about one-third, and the speed increases depending on the hardware and operators.

samples.source: 半精度 fp16 保留浮点动态范围，训练时用得多；int8 推理时用得多。
samples.reference: Half-precision fp16 keeps the dynamic range of floats and is used heavily in training; int8 is used heavily in inference.
samples.hypothesis: Half-precision fp16 preserves the floating-point dynamic range, used more often in training; int8 is used more often in reasoning.

samples.source: 知识蒸馏把大模型的软标签灌给小模型，让后者逼近前者的准确率。
samples.reference: Knowledge distillation feeds the soft labels of a large model into a small model so the latter approaches the former's accuracy.
samples.hypothesis: Knowledge distillation injects the soft labels of the large model into the small model, bringing the latter closer to the accuracy of the former.

samples.source: 教师模型可以是 30B 参数，学生模型压到 1B，蒸馏后小模型在窄任务上不掉太多。
samples.reference: The teacher might have 30B parameters and the student only 1B; a distilled student loses surprisingly little on a narrow task.
samples.hypothesis: The teacher's model can be 30B parameter, the student's model can be pushed to 1B, and the distilled small model doesn't lose much on narrow tasks.

samples.source: 微调在特定领域语料上继续训练，学习率要显著低于预训练阶段。
samples.reference: Fine-tuning continues training on a domain-specific corpus at a much lower learning rate than pretraining.
samples.hypothesis: Continuing training on language in a specific area is fine-tuned, and the learning rate is significantly lower than in the pre-training phase.

samples.source: LoRA 只训练两个低秩矩阵，参数量与原模型相比不到百分之一。
samples.reference: LoRA only trains two low-rank matrices, less than one percent of the base model's parameter count.
samples.hypothesis: LoRA trained only two low-order matrices, with parameter sizes less than one percent of the original model.

samples.source: 推理时 batch size 越大吞吐越高但延迟也越长，实时场景往往锁死 batch=1。
samples.reference: At inference time, larger batch size raises throughput but also latency; realtime pipelines usually lock batch=1.
samples.hypothesis: The larger the batch size, the higher the throughput but also the longer the latency, and real-time scenarios tend to lock at batch=1.

samples.source: 线程数不是越多越好；ONNX 的 inter-op 与 intra-op 要分开调。
samples.reference: More threads are not always better; ONNX's inter-op and intra-op thread counts have to be tuned separately.
samples.hypothesis: The number of threads is not the best; ONNX's inter-op and intra-op are tuned separately.

samples.source: 算子融合把多个小算子合并成一个大算子，减少内存往返与调度开销。
samples.reference: Operator fusion collapses several small operators into one, reducing memory round-trips and scheduling overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Operator fusion combines multiple minor operators into one major operator, reducing memory travel and routing expenses.

samples.source: 计算图优化是推理框架的核心工作，图切分决定哪些算子留在 CPU 哪些上 GPU。
samples.reference: Computation-graph optimisation is the core work of an inference framework; graph partitioning decides which operators stay on CPU and which move to GPU.
samples.hypothesis: Computational graph optimization is the core work of the reasoning framework, and the graph slice determines which operators remain on the CPU and which on the GPU.

samples.source: 运行时提供程序的选择影响极大，同一模型在 CUDA 与 CPU 上可能差 5 到 10 倍。
samples.reference: Choosing the runtime provider matters a lot -- the same model can be 5 to 10 times faster on CUDA than on CPU.
samples.hypothesis: The choice of runtime provider has a huge impact, and the same model can be 5 to 10 times different on CUDA and CPU.

samples.source: 显存不足时 Ollama 会自动把部分层卸载到内存，速度骤降但不会崩。
samples.reference: When VRAM is insufficient Ollama offloads some layers to main memory; throughput collapses but the process survives.
samples.hypothesis: When display memory is low, Ollama automatically unloads some layers to memory, slowing down but not crashing.

samples.source: 批大小与序列长度的乘积决定 KV 缓存的显存开销。
samples.reference: The product of batch size and sequence length determines the VRAM cost of the KV cache.
samples.hypothesis: The product of the batch size by the sequence length determines the KV cache visual memory expenditure.

samples.source: 多语言模型用一份参数覆盖 100 多种语言，冷门语向的质量通常明显低于热门语向。
samples.reference: A multilingual model covers more than a hundred languages with one set of weights, and quality on cold pairs is usually much lower than on hot pairs.
samples.hypothesis: Multilingual models cover more than 100 languages with a single parameter, and the quality of the cold language is usually significantly lower than that of the hot language.

samples.source: 分词器与模型的词表必须严格匹配，错配会导致输出乱码但不报错。
samples.reference: The tokenizer and the model's vocabulary must match exactly; a mismatch produces garbled output without raising an error.
samples.hypothesis: The parser must be strictly matched to the glossary of the model, and a mismatch will result in a miscoded output that does not report an error.

samples.source: 温度采样把概率分布拉平，让模型输出更多样，但翻译场景通常希望更低温度。
samples.reference: Temperature sampling flattens the probability distribution and yields more varied output, but translation typically wants lower temperature.
samples.hypothesis: Temperature sampling flattens the probability distribution and allows the model to output more variation, but translation scenarios usually prefer lower temperatures.

samples.source: 上下文窗口是 LLM 的硬约束，长文档翻译要么截断要么分段喂。
samples.reference: The context window is a hard constraint on the LLM; long documents must be truncated or fed one sentence at a time.
samples.hypothesis: The context window is the hard constraint of LLM, and long document translations are either truncated or fragmented.

samples.source: 系统提示里显式列出术语表可以显著降低专业词错译，但会占用输入 token。
samples.reference: Listing the glossary explicitly inside the system prompt significantly reduces terminology errors but consumes input tokens.
samples.hypothesis: Explicit listing of glossaries in system prompts can significantly reduce mistranslations of technical terms, but will take up input tokens.

samples.source: 少样本示例把 "用户希望的译法" 直接摆到模型眼前，比抽象指令更有效。
samples.reference: Few-shot examples put the user's preferred rendering directly in front of the model, which beats any abstract instruction.
samples.hypothesis: Fewer sample examples put the "translation the user wants" directly in front of the model, which is more effective than abstract instructions.

samples.source: 术语表要按当前请求的语言对与领域过滤，把不相关条目喂给模型只会稀释注意力。
samples.reference: Glossaries must be filtered by the current request's language pair and domain; feeding irrelevant rows only dilutes attention.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary is filtered by the language and domain of the current request, and feeding unrelated entries to the model will only dilute attention.

samples.source: 翻译记忆是精确匹配，命中即零成本；模糊匹配是另一码事，会引入排序噪声。
samples.reference: Translation memory matches exactly -- a hit is zero-cost; fuzzy matching is a different problem and brings ranking noise.
samples.hypothesis: Translation memories are precise matches, and hit is zero cost; vague matches are another thing, and they introduce sorting noise.

samples.source: 置信度门控是本地结果与 AI 升级之间的开关，阈值定太松会白白多花一次 API。
samples.reference: Confidence gating is the switch between local output and AI upgrade; too permissive a threshold wastes API calls.
samples.hypothesis: Confidence threshold control is the switch between local results and AI upgrades, and too loose a threshold will cost the API more than it deserves.

samples.source: 质量分记录每条 TM 的历史可信度，AI 写入通常是 0.95，本地是估算，手动是 1.0。
samples.reference: The quality score records each TM entry's historical reliability -- AI writes at 0.95, local estimates its own, manual writes 1.0.
samples.hypothesis: The mass fraction records the historical credibility of each TM, typically 0.95 for AI writing, locally estimated, and 1.0 for manual writing.

samples.source: 兜底降级必须携带原因说明，让调用方知道 "翻不出" 和 "翻错了但降级返回" 是两回事。
samples.reference: Fallback degradation must carry a reason so the caller can tell "could not translate" apart from "translated wrong but degraded anyway".
samples.hypothesis: Downgrades must be accompanied by a reason, so that the caller knows the difference between "no turn" and "wrong turn but downgrade returns."

samples.source: 不静默降级是本产品的硬约束：任何路径回落都要写进 message 字段。

samples.source: 上下文窗口是 LLM 硬约束，长文档翻译要么截断要么按句喂，不能整段塞进去。

samples.source: 术语注入到提示词中要显式约束格式，不然模型会把中文术语当成解释性文本。

samples.hypothesis: The term inserted in the prompt must explicitly bind the format, otherwise the model will treat the Chinese term as an explanatory text.

samples.source: 多语言模型对冷门语言对的表现受限于训练语料规模，不是模型容量。

samples.hypothesis: Neural machine translation's descriptors are attached to the training language, and cross-language use leads to a sharp drop in glossary accuracy.

samples.source: 大语言模型可以做机器翻译，但对提示工程敏感，同一个源句换个提示可能质量差一档。

samples.source: 自动评测不能替代人工评测；chrF/BLEU 与 COMET 与人工评分之间相关系数在窄域上会明显下降。

samples.source: 统计机器翻译的短语表在语序差异大的语对之间退化严重，比如中文到芬兰语。

samples.hypothesis: Statistical machine translation glossaries are severely degraded between language pairs with large order differences, such as from Chinese to Finnish.

samples.source: 翻译记忆的模糊匹配按编辑距离或语义距离排序，返回的 top-k 数量要克制。

samples.hypothesis: Translation memory fuzzy matches are sorted by editorial distance or semantic distance, and the number of top-k returns is limited.

samples.source: 置信度门控在实时档要更严，因为实时档不接受升级；在精译档可以稍松，因为 AI 兜底。

samples.source: 术语注入到本地引擎与注入到 LLM 的效果不一样：本地引擎把它当硬约束，LLM 会理解上下文再决定。

samples.hypothesis: Injecting a term into a local engine does not have the same effect as injecting it into an LLM: the local engine treats it as hard-bound, and the LLM understands the context and decides.

samples.source: 蒸馏产出要区分 "用户已确认" 与 "机器自抽"，前者可以覆盖后者，反之不行。

samples.hypothesis: The distillation output should distinguish between "user-confirmed" and "machine-extracted", where the former can override the latter, but not the other way around.

samples.source: 命中率与延迟之间通常正相关；命中率越高说明重复内容越多，缓存路径也越快。

samples.hypothesis: There is usually a positive correlation between hit rate and delay; the higher the hit rate, the more duplicate content and the faster the cache path.

samples.source: 端到端语音翻译里 ASR 的错误会传染给 MT，再传染给 TTS，因此段级评估要独立跑。

samples.hypothesis: In end-to-end speech translation, ASR errors are transmitted to MT and then to TTS, so segment evaluation runs independently.

samples.source: 神经机器翻译的注意力可视化能揭示模型 "看到" 了源句的哪一部分，但不等于可解释性。

samples.hypothesis: Attention visualization in neural machine translation can reveal which part of the source sentence the model "sees", but it is not equivalent to explanability.

samples.source: 翻译记忆的更新策略是 last-write-wins 还是 best-quality-wins，产品语义完全不同。

samples.hypothesis: Translation memory updating strategies are last-write-wins or best-quality-wins, and the product semantics are completely different.

samples.source: 大语言模型的 prompt injection 是隐私风险的来源之一，术语表内容不能包含可执行指令。

samples.hypothesis: Prompt injection in the Big Language model is one source of privacy risk, as the glossary content cannot contain executable instructions.

samples.source: 翻译引擎的兜底不是简单的 "翻不出来返回原文"，而是要明确 "为什么没翻出来"。

samples.hypothesis: The bottom line for a translation engine is not simply "can't translate back to the original", but rather "why can't translate".

samples.source: 端到端评估的样本要覆盖短句、中句、长句三档，短多义词与长复杂句的失败模式不同。

samples.hypothesis: The end-to-end assessment sample covers short, medium, and long sentences, and the failure pattern of short polynomials differs from that of long complex sentences.

samples.source: 用户锁定条目优先级最高：蒸馏不能覆盖，导入种子包也不能覆盖，除非用户显式撤销。

samples.hypothesis: User lock entries have the highest priority: distillation cannot be overridden, nor can import seed packages be overridden, unless explicitly cancelled by the user.

samples.source: 麦克风增益过高会让削波后的波形失去可识别性，ASR 会明显退化。
samples.reference: Microphone gain that is too high produces clipped waveforms with no recognisable content and degrades ASR visibly.
samples.hypothesis: Excessive microphone gain will make the cut-off waveform unrecognizable, and the ASR will significantly degrade.

samples.source: 扬声器输出的音量归一化要放在编码前而不是解码后，否则动态范围会丢。

samples.hypothesis: The volume of the speaker output must be normalized before encoding and not after decoding, otherwise the dynamic range will be lost.

samples.source: 录音的静音剪裁要在 VAD 判定后做，不能在波形上做简单的能量阈值。
samples.reference: Silence trimming must follow VAD decisions rather than a naive energy threshold on the raw waveform.
samples.hypothesis: Silent trimming of the recording must be done after VAD determination and cannot be done on a simple energy threshold on the waveform.

samples.source: 播放头跨段跳变时要触发一次 flush，不然缓冲里会残留上一段的音频。

samples.hypothesis: When the playhead jumps over a segment, a flush is triggered, otherwise the audio of the previous segment remains in the buffer.

samples.source: 时间轴面板要区分视频帧号与音频样本号；两者换算依赖帧率与采样率。
samples.reference: The timeline panel must distinguish video frame indices from audio sample indices; converting between them depends on frame rate and sample rate.
samples.hypothesis: The Timeline panel distinguishes between the video frame number and the audio sample number; the two are converted depending on the frame rate and sample rate.

samples.source: 导入含 BOM 的字幕文件要能识别并剥离 BOM，不然首行字幕会带上不可见字符。

samples.hypothesis: Importing a subtitle file containing a BOM must be able to recognize and remove the BOM, otherwise the first line of the subtitle will contain an invisible character.

samples.source: 导出为 SRT 时的时间戳精度到毫秒即可；ASS 需要到厘秒，两者格式不同。

samples.hypothesis: When exported as SRT, the time stamp is accurate to milliseconds; for ASS, the time stamp is accurate to milliseconds, and the two formats are different.

samples.hypothesis: The preview window is rendered as a soft caption, allowing the user to switch the caption track; the export options are decoupled from it.

samples.source: 剪辑导出时如果只改时间轴不改内容，重封装就够，不要引入不必要的二压。

samples.hypothesis: When exporting a clip, it is sufficient to repackage it if you only change the timeline without changing the content, and do not introduce unnecessary second press.

samples.source: 波形视图与频谱视图是互补的：前者看能量分布，后者看频率分布。

samples.hypothesis: The waveform view and the spectrum view are complementary: the former looks at the energy distribution and the latter at the frequency distribution.

samples.hypothesis: Beam shaping of the microphone array can significantly improve the signal-to-noise ratio of distant speakers, provided that sampling is synchronized.

samples.hypothesis: The audio format conversion explicitly selects whether to re-sample, and the re-sample declares whether to go through a high-quality filter.

samples.hypothesis: All figures for external commitments in the project must have an empirical source; the pre-estimation is always marked as "estimated".

samples.hypothesis: The sidecar process only listens to the home loop, and any external exposure is a clear violation of the privacy invariant.

samples.reference: Language-pair tiering decides which engine runs; cold pairs may not have any local engine at all.
samples.hypothesis: The language pair determines which engine to go on; a cold-gate language pair may take root without a native engine option.

samples.hypothesis: The user environment may be an offline intranet when the offline integration package is delivered, and neither the model nor the glossary can be downloaded on-the-fly.

samples.hypothesis: The quality promises of the Translated Edition include "AI can be upgraded as much as possible," not "always go local."

samples.hypothesis: Quality preferences are selected on page 2 of the settings, saved and restarted to avoid state confusion caused by in-flight reroutes.

samples.source: 兜底降级要区分 "本地模型缺失" 与 "外部引擎不可达"，前者可提示下载，后者要重试。

samples.hypothesis: The model licensing matrix is part of the product ' s external commitment, and any new dependencies are subject to licensing.

samples.hypothesis: The switches that execute the provider program must go through the environment variables, not be written in the source code.

samples.hypothesis: Routing decisions are observable: the route_plan of each translation can be read back through the diagnostic interface.

samples.hypothesis: There is a hard boundary between the on-premises engine and the cloud engine, and privacy mode closes all access on this boundary.

samples.hypothesis: The confidential documentation scenario requires that all local components be available offline and that networking functionality be completely disabled.

samples.hypothesis: The desktop client shows which engine actually went through each translation, and "transparent traceability" is a basic promise of the product.

samples.hypothesis: Translation memory exports should be take-away or shared, but glossaries packaged by domain should not be released with user-private entries.

samples.hypothesis: The end-to-end delay is connected in series by VAD, ASR, MT, and TTS, and any deterioration of the delay is reflected in the user's face.

samples.source: 批处理任务的日志要按句粒度落盘，失败重跑时能精确恢复到出错那一条而不是从头再来。

samples.hypothesis: Bulk localization of sensitive customers typically requires on-site deployment, with any remote measurement being completely disabled.

samples.hypothesis: The routing table is data-driven: routes.json, settings.json, environment variables, initialized JSON are overridden by four priority levels in order.

samples.source: 端到端评测的样本要按子领域打标签，才能算出 "流水线核心 vs 多义词边界" 的分组质量差。
samples.reference: End-to-end evaluation samples carry sub-domain labels so per-group quality deltas ("pipeline core vs polysemy boundary") can be computed.
samples.hypothesis: The samples of the end-to-end evaluation are labeled by sub-domains in order to calculate the cluster quality gap of the "flowline core vs. polynomial boundary".

samples.source: 批量本地化的性能指标是 "每小时能翻多少段"，与实时场景的 "端到端多少毫秒" 是两套。
samples.reference: The performance metric for batch localisation is sentences per hour; the realtime metric is end-to-end milliseconds -- two completely different scales.
samples.hypothesis: The performance metrics for batch localization are "how many segments per hour" and "how many milliseconds end-to-end" for real-time scenarios are two sets.

samples.source: 桌面产品的首次启动体验很重要：模型缺失时要在 UI 里明说而不是抛异常。
samples.reference: The first-launch experience of a desktop product matters: missing models must surface as a friendly UI message, not an exception.
samples.hypothesis: The first-time startup experience for desktop products is important: when a model is missing, it should be stated in the UI rather than thrown as an exception.

samples.source: 本地模型的下载要能显示进度并支持断点续传，几百 MB 到几 GB 的模型不适合一刀断重来。
samples.reference: Local model downloads must show progress and support resumable fetch; hundreds of megabytes to gigabytes are not worth restarting from zero.
samples.hypothesis: Local model downloads need to show progress and support breakpoint renewal, and models of several hundred MB to several GB are not suitable for reloading at once.

samples.source: 精译档与实时档的切换粒度是每请求；同一批里可以混着走，不用切档。
samples.reference: Switching between quality and realtime mode happens per request; a single batch can freely mix them without a global toggle.
samples.hypothesis: The switching granularity of the transcription batch and the real-time batch is per request; they can be mixed in the same batch without having to switch batch.

samples.source: sidecar 的生命周期由 UI 层管理，启动时轮询健康检查，退出时优雅 kill。
samples.reference: The sidecar's lifecycle is managed by the UI layer -- health-poll on startup, graceful kill on shutdown.
samples.hypothesis: The sidecar's lifecycle is managed by the UI layer, rolling health checks at startup and elegant kills at exit.

samples.source: Python 侧车与 Rust 核心之间是 HTTP/JSON 契约，禁止 native binding 引入新的依赖负担。
samples.reference: The contract between the Python sidecar and the Rust core is HTTP over JSON, with native bindings forbidden so no new dependency burden creeps in.
samples.hypothesis: Between the Python sidecar and the Rust core is an HTTP/JSON contract, which prevents native binding from introducing new dependency burdens.

samples.source: Windows 智能应用控制会拦截未签名的本地构建 DLL，产品发布签名要覆盖所有二进制。
samples.reference: Windows Smart App Control intercepts unsigned locally built DLLs, so product signing must cover every binary shipped.
samples.hypothesis: Windows Intelligent Application Control blocks unsigned local build DLLs, and the product release signature covers all binaries.

samples.source: 许可证门禁覆盖 Cargo.lock、Python requirements、.NET csproj 与文档引用的第三方素材。
samples.reference: The licence gate covers Cargo.lock, Python requirements, .NET csproj files, and any third-party material referenced from the docs.
samples.hypothesis: License restrictions cover Cargo.lock, Python requirements, .NET csproj and third-party materials referenced in the documentation.

samples.source: 源码注释统一英文；文档面向中文用户，中英双版按 README 起头互链。
samples.reference: Source-code comments are English throughout; user-facing documentation is Chinese with an English twin linked from the README.
samples.hypothesis: The source code notes are in standard English; the documentation is intended for Chinese users, and the Chinese and English versions are interlinked at the beginning of the README.

samples.source: 所有对外发布的数字都要能追溯到一次可复现的评测运行，含脚本、种子、时间戳。
samples.reference: Every externally published number must trace back to a reproducible evaluation run -- script, seed and timestamp included.
samples.hypothesis: All externally released figures must be traceable to a reproducible evaluation run, including script, seed, and timestamp.

samples.source: 文档中不出现机器盘符路径；所有默认路径都走 data_dir 解析。
samples.reference: Docs must not carry machine drive paths; every default path resolves through data_dir.
samples.hypothesis: The machine disk path does not appear in the document; all default paths are parsed by data_dir.

samples.source: 构建入口以 Python 脚本为主，Windows 与 Linux 各配一个 .bat / .sh 做 OS 级薄壳。
samples.reference: Build entry points are Python scripts, with a thin .bat on Windows and .sh on Linux as OS-level wrappers.
samples.hypothesis: Build entry is dominated by Python scripts, with Windows and Linux each having a .bat / .sh as the OS-level thin shell.

samples.source: pre-commit 钩子按路径触发不同检查，全绿才允许 commit。
samples.reference: The pre-commit hook dispatches different checks by file path and only allows a commit when every applicable check passes.
samples.hypothesis: The pre-commit hook triggers different checks depending on the path.

samples.source: Conventional Commits 是提交信息规范，type(scope): subject 一行说清 "改了什么的哪部分"。
samples.reference: Conventional Commits is the message convention: type(scope): subject says "what changed in which part" in a single line.
samples.hypothesis: Conventional Commits are commit information specifications where the type(scope): subject line specifies "which part of what has been changed".

samples.source: pathspec 限定提交是并发协作下的原子性保障；共享暂存区容易被别的会话扫走。
samples.reference: Pathspec-scoped commits are the atomicity guarantee in concurrent collaboration; a shared staging area is easily swept by another session's commit.
samples.hypothesis: The pathspec restriction on commits is an atomic safeguard in parallel collaboration; shared caches are easily wiped out by other sessions.

samples.source: patch 文件要显式说明行尾策略，Windows 下 autocrlf=true 检出可能破坏 git apply。
samples.reference: Patch files must state their line-ending policy explicitly; under autocrlf=true on Windows a checkout may otherwise break git apply.
samples.hypothesis: The patch file must explicitly specify the end-of-line policy, and the autocrlf=true detection under Windows may break git apply.

samples.source: "缓存" 在 CDN 语境是 cache，在视频缓冲语境通常是 buffer；两者混用会误导读者。
samples.reference: "缓存" is cache in a CDN context but buffer in a video buffering context; conflating them misleads the reader.
samples.hypothesis: "Caching" is cache in the CDN context, and usually buffer in the video buffering context; mixing the two can mislead the reader.

samples.source: "编码器" 与 "加密器" 中文近似但英文完全不同：encoder 与 encryptor，翻译不能滑。
samples.reference: "编码器" and "加密器" are near-homographs in Chinese but encoder and encryptor in English -- the translation must not slide.
samples.hypothesis: "Encoder" and "encryptor" are similar in Chinese but completely different in English: encoder and encryptor, the translation is not smooth.

samples.source: "解码器" 与 "解密器" 同样易混：decoder 与 decryptor，看是压缩域还是安全域。
samples.reference: "解码器" and "解密器" are equally confusable: decoder versus decryptor -- decide by compression domain or security domain.
samples.hypothesis: "Decoder" and "decryptor" are equally confusing: decoder and decryptor, depending on whether the domain is compression or security.

samples.source: "关键帧" 是 video keyframe；"关键帧动画" 是 animation keyframe；同名不同物。
samples.reference: A video keyframe and an animation keyframe share the Chinese term "关键帧" but denote different things.
samples.hypothesis: "Keyframe" is a video keyframe; "keyframe animation" is an animation keyframe; different things with the same name.

samples.source: "声道" 与 "通道" 在英文都是 channel；中文 UI 要根据域强制选一个不能默认。
samples.reference: "声道" and "通道" both render as channel in English; the UI must pick one explicitly by domain rather than default.
samples.hypothesis: Both "voice" and "channel" are channels in English; Chinese UI requires one to be chosen by domain, which is not the default.

samples.source: "分词" 在 NLP 是 tokenization，在中文文本处理还可能是 word segmentation，两者粒度不同。
samples.reference: "分词" is tokenization in NLP but may be word segmentation in Chinese text processing -- the two operate at different granularity.
samples.hypothesis: "Segmentation" in NLP is tokenization, and in Chinese text processing it may also be word segmentation, both of which are of different granularity.

samples.source: "重采样" 在音频域是 resample，在统计域是 bootstrap 采样；上下文域决定译法。
samples.reference: "重采样" in audio is resampling; in statistics it is bootstrap sampling -- the surrounding domain decides the rendering.
samples.hypothesis: "Resampling" is resample in the audio domain, bootstrap sampling in the statistical domain; the context domain determines the translation.

samples.source: "预训练" 与 "预热" 在中文里都含 "pre"，英文是 pretraining 与 warmup，工程语义完全不同。
samples.reference: "预训练" and "预热" both start with "pre-" in Chinese, but they are pretraining and warmup in English -- completely different engineering meanings.
samples.hypothesis: "Pre-training" and "warm-up" both contain the word "pre" in Chinese, while the English words pretraining and warm-up have completely different engineering semantics.

samples.source: 解码线程卡在队列上时，冲刷一次缓冲区通常就能让流水线重新动起来。
samples.reference: When the decode thread stalls on the queue, flushing the buffer once usually gets the pipeline moving again.
samples.hypothesis: When the decoder card is in the queue, a buffer wipe usually gets the flow line moving again.

samples.source: 背压信号要一路传到采集端，否则缓冲区会在无人察觉时溢出。
samples.reference: The backpressure signal has to reach the capture side, otherwise the buffer overflows without anyone noticing.
samples.hypothesis: The back pressure signal must be transmitted all the way to the collecting end, otherwise the buffer zone will overflow undetected.

samples.source: 把分块大小从 20 毫秒调到 40 毫秒，端到端延迟会上升但网络抖动的容忍度变好。
samples.reference: Raising the chunk size from 20 ms to 40 ms increases end-to-end latency but tolerates network jitter better.
samples.hypothesis: By changing the block size from 20 milliseconds to 40 milliseconds, end-to-end latency increases but tolerance for network shaking improves.

samples.source: 数据流在中间层被复制两份时，要注意两份的帧序号不能各自递增。
samples.reference: When the data stream is duplicated in the middle layer, the frame numbering of both copies must not advance independently.
samples.hypothesis: When the data stream is duplicated in two copies in the intermediate layer, the chapter numbers of the two copies cannot be incremental.

samples.source: 流水线里任何一段引入线程池，都要重新检查语段结束事件的顺序保证。
samples.reference: Whenever a thread pool is introduced anywhere in the pipeline, the ordering guarantee of speech-segment end events must be rechecked.
samples.hypothesis: Any segment in the flow introduces a thread pool that re-checks the sequence assurance of the segment end event.

samples.source: 队列长度是观测项，应该和首包延迟一起出现在诊断接口里。
samples.reference: Queue depth is an observable and should appear in the diagnostics endpoint next to time to first packet.
samples.hypothesis: The queue length is an observation and should appear in the diagnostic interface along with the first packet delay.

samples.source: 流式识别在中途断线后，续传位置要以帧为单位记录而不是以秒为单位。
samples.reference: After streaming recognition is cut off mid-way, the resume position must be recorded in frames rather than in seconds.
samples.hypothesis: In stream identification, the retransmission position is recorded in frames rather than seconds after the line has been interrupted.

samples.source: 分块处理音频时，块边界要对齐到采样点，否则会在交界处产生咔哒声。
samples.reference: When audio is processed in chunks, block boundaries must align to samples, or clicks appear at the seams.
samples.hypothesis: When blocking audio, the block boundaries must be aligned to the sampling point, otherwise clicks will occur at the intersection.

samples.source: 缓冲策略要显式声明是丢弃最旧还是阻塞生产者，两者语义完全不同。
samples.reference: The buffering policy must state whether it drops the oldest frame or blocks the producer; the two semantics differ completely.
samples.hypothesis: A buffer strategy must explicitly state whether it is discarding the oldest or blocking producers, which are semantically completely different.

samples.source: 流水线在关闭前要先冲刷所有阶段，否则最后一个语段会静默消失。
samples.reference: The pipeline has to flush every stage before shutdown, otherwise the final speech segment disappears without a trace.
samples.hypothesis: All stages of the flow line must be cleared before it closes, otherwise the last line will disappear silently.

samples.source: 运行时把解码器放在工作线程上，界面线程只负责时间轴刷新。
samples.reference: The runtime puts the decoder on a worker thread, leaving the UI thread to only refresh the timeline.
samples.hypothesis: When running, the decoder is placed on the working thread, and the interface thread is only responsible for refreshing the timeline.

samples.source: 每帧都重建特征维度的数组会造成明显垃圾回收压力，应当复用缓冲。
samples.reference: Rebuilding the feature-dimension array every frame causes noticeable garbage-collection pressure; reuse the buffer instead.
samples.hypothesis: Arrays in which each frame reconstructs a characteristic dimension will cause significant garbage recovery pressures and should be re-buffered.

samples.source: 推理服务的并发上限应当与队列长度一起上报，便于运维判断排队规模。
samples.reference: An inference service should report its concurrency limit together with queue depth so operators can judge how long the line is.
samples.hypothesis: The concurrence limit for the reasoning service should be reported together with the queue length to enable operators to assess the size of the queue.

samples.source: 流式传输的重连策略要区分服务端主动关闭与网络抖动两种情况。
samples.reference: The reconnect policy for streaming transport must separate a server-initiated close from network jitter.
samples.hypothesis: Reconnection policies for streaming transport distinguish between service-side shutdowns and network shaking.

samples.source: 语音分段的边界判定依赖帧移设置，改帧移会同时改变分段粒度。
samples.reference: Segmentation boundaries in voice segmentation depend on the frame shift; changing it also changes segment granularity.
samples.hypothesis: The boundary determination of voice segments depends on the frame shift setting, and changing the frame shift changes the segment granularity at the same time.

samples.source: 缓冲区水位线要能同时约束延迟与丢帧率，只设上限是不够的。
samples.reference: A buffer watermark has to bound latency and frame loss together; an upper limit alone is not enough.
samples.hypothesis: If the buffer zone water level line is to control both delay and frame loss, a single upper limit is not sufficient.

samples.source: 当解码速度低于采集速度时，背压会把等待时间转移到编码器队列上。
samples.reference: When decoding runs slower than capture, backpressure shifts the waiting onto the encoder queue.
samples.hypothesis: When the decoding rate is lower than the acquisition rate, backpressure transfers the waiting time to the encoder queue.

samples.source: 检查点加载完成后要先做一次预热推理，再接受第一个请求。
samples.reference: After a checkpoint is loaded, run one warm-up inference before accepting the first request.
samples.hypothesis: After the checkpoint is loaded, a pre-heat reasoning is performed before the first request is accepted.

samples.source: 流水线阶段的日志要带上语段编号，否则跨段问题无法归因。
samples.reference: Log lines for each pipeline stage should carry the speech-segment id, or cross-segment issues cannot be attributed.
samples.hypothesis: Logs of flow-line stages must be segment-numbered, otherwise cross-segment problems cannot be attributed.

samples.source: 模型权重热更新时要冻结当前队列，等所有在飞请求结束后再替换。
samples.reference: Hot-swapping model weights must freeze the queue and wait for in-flight requests before the replacement.
samples.hypothesis: When the model weight is hot-updated, the current queue is frozen, waiting for all to be replaced after the end of the flight request.

samples.source: 词元数量超限的长文档要按段落切分喂入，而不是整段截断。
samples.reference: Long documents that exceed the token limit must be fed paragraph by paragraph rather than truncated as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: Long documents that exceed the number of elements will be fed by paragraph rather than by entire paragraph.

samples.source: 子词切分语言的重试策略要按词元计费上限设计，而非按句子数量。
samples.reference: Retry limits for subword-segmented languages should be designed around the token budget, not a sentence count.
samples.hypothesis: Retry strategies for subordinate-splitting languages are designed to charge on the basis of the maximum number of elements, rather than the number of sentences.

samples.source: 运行时提供两个内存池，一个给帧缓冲，一个给特征张量。
samples.reference: The runtime offers two memory pools, one for the frame buffer and one for feature tensors.
samples.hypothesis: Two memory pools are provided during runtime, one for the frame buffer and one for the characteristic tensor.

samples.source: 分块边界与强制对齐的时间戳要对齐到同一采样点基准。
samples.reference: Chunk boundaries and forced-alignment timestamps must share one sample-based reference.
samples.hypothesis: The block boundary and the forced alignment timestamp are aligned to the same sampling point reference.

samples.source: 流式合成输出的第一段要包含完整帧，播放器才不会在开头消音。
samples.reference: The first block emitted by streaming synthesis must contain whole frames, or the player goes silent at the start.
samples.hypothesis: The first section of the stream synthesis output must contain the full frame so that the player does not mute at the beginning.

samples.source: 队列满时的丢弃策略要写进响应说明，不能让调用方以为全部处理完成。
samples.reference: If a full queue causes drops, say so in the response instead of letting the caller believe everything was processed.
samples.hypothesis: The queue-full discard policy is written into the response statement and cannot be used by the caller to assume that all has been processed.

samples.source: 解码器输出的声道顺序要与容器声明一致，左右声道颠倒很难被听见。
samples.reference: The decoder's channel order must match the container's declaration; swapped stereo channels are hard to hear.
samples.hypothesis: The sequence of channels output by the decoder must be consistent with the container declaration, and inverted channels are difficult to hear.

samples.source: 端到端评测要按阶段拆开计时，采集到推理的间隔常常被忽略。
samples.reference: End-to-end evaluation should time each stage; the gap between capture and inference is often overlooked.
samples.hypothesis: When end-to-end assessments are broken down by phases, the intervals from acquisition to reasoning are often overlooked.

samples.source: 推理线程绑核能减少抖动，但会让队列在单核机器上更容易积压。
samples.reference: Pinning inference threads reduces jitter but lets the queue build up more easily on single-core machines.
samples.hypothesis: Reasoning threading reduces shaking, but makes queues more prone to lag on single-core machines.

samples.source: 帧缓冲的容量按秒换算时，要用采样率与特征维度共同决定。
samples.reference: Converting the frame buffer from seconds to bytes needs both the sample rate and the feature dimension.
samples.hypothesis: When the frame buffer capacity is converted to seconds, it is determined in conjunction with the sample rate and the feature dimension.

samples.source: 数据流合并后要重新编号，否则下游无法判断哪个语段先结束。
samples.reference: Merged data streams require renumbering, or downstream stages cannot tell which speech segment ends first.
samples.hypothesis: The data streams must be renumbered after merging, otherwise it will be impossible for the downstream to judge which segment ends first.

samples.source: 冲刷操作必须是幂等的，重复调用不能把队列清空两次。
samples.reference: A flush must be idempotent; calling it twice must not empty the queue twice.
samples.hypothesis: The wipe operation must be pairwise, and repeated calls cannot empty the queue twice.

samples.source: 流水线监控至少要暴露各阶段队列长度与最老请求等待时间。
samples.reference: Pipeline monitoring should expose per-stage queue depth and the age of the oldest request.
samples.hypothesis: Flowline monitoring exposes at least the length of the queue at each stage and the waiting time for the oldest request.

samples.source: 语言代码在内部一律用规范形式，展示层再本地化，避免比较分叉。
samples.reference: Language codes stay canonical internally and are localized only at display time, to avoid comparison forks.
samples.hypothesis: Internally, the language code is always in standard form, and the display layer is relocalized to avoid comparative forks.

samples.source: 自动语音识别与翻译阶段共享同一个词表缓存，能省下重复初始化。
samples.reference: Sharing one vocabulary cache between automatic speech recognition and translation saves repeated initialization.
samples.hypothesis: Automatic speech recognition shares the same glossary cache as the translation phase, thus avoiding duplicate initialization.

samples.source: 语音闭环里任何一段改成异步，都要重新定义首段可播的测量点。
samples.reference: If any stage of the speech loop becomes asynchronous, redefine where time to first playable segment is measured.
samples.hypothesis: Any segment in the voice closed loop that becomes asynchronous requires a redefinition of the measuring point for the first broadcast segment.

samples.source: 缓冲区的目标水位应当随网络抖动的历史分布自适应调整。
samples.reference: A buffer's target watermark should adapt to the historical distribution of network jitter.
samples.hypothesis: The target water level in the buffer zone should adapt to the historical distribution of the network shaking.

samples.source: 分块处理的窗口重叠长度会影响频谱估计的稳定度。
samples.reference: The overlap length of chunked processing affects the stability of the spectrum estimate.
samples.hypothesis: The window overlap length of the block processing affects the stability of the spectrum estimate.

samples.source: 背压在跨进程边界上会失真，需要显式传递等待原因而不是靠超时推断。
samples.reference: Backpressure loses fidelity across a process boundary, so pass the waiting reason explicitly rather than inferring it from timeouts.
samples.hypothesis: Backpressure is distorted at cross-process boundaries and requires explicit communication of the reason for waiting rather than time-out inference.

samples.source: 检查点切换要保留旧实例直到最后一个请求返回。
samples.reference: On a checkpoint switch, keep the old instance alive until the last request has returned.
samples.hypothesis: Checkpoint switches keep the old instance until the last request is returned.

samples.source: 流水线的排队等待不计入推理耗时，否则延迟报表会被误读。
samples.reference: Queueing ahead of the pipeline must not count as inference time, or latency reports become misleading.
samples.hypothesis: Line queues are not counted as reasoning time, otherwise the delayed statement could be misread.

samples.source: 帧长为 25 毫秒、帧移为 10 毫秒时，一帧对应三个采样点窗口。
samples.reference: With a 25 ms frame length and a 10 ms frame shift, one frame spans three sample windows.
samples.hypothesis: For a frame length of 25 milliseconds and a frame shift of 10 milliseconds, a frame corresponds to three sampling point windows.

samples.source: 队列的等待上限必须有硬边界，超过平台表示范围会直接抛错。
