samples.reference: A queue wait limit needs a hard ceiling; past the platform's representable range it raises instead of waiting.
samples.hypothesis: There must be a hard limit to the waiting time of a queue, beyond which errors will be thrown directly.

samples.source: 推理阶段的批大小上限要与显存水位联动，固定值在共享机器上不稳。
samples.reference: The inference batch cap should follow the memory watermark; a fixed value is unstable on shared machines.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum batch size in the reasoning phase is linked to the displayed water level, and the fixed value is unstable on the shared machine.

samples.source: 解码器输出的时间戳精度到毫秒即可，字幕文件不需要厘秒。
samples.reference: Millisecond timestamps from the decoder are enough; subtitle files do not need centiseconds.
samples.hypothesis: The time stamp accuracy of the decoder output is within milliseconds, while the subtitle file does not require milliseconds.

samples.source: 流式识别的部分结果要标注是否可回退，供下游决定是否上屏。
samples.reference: Partial results from streaming recognition should say whether they can be revised, so downstream can decide to show them.
samples.hypothesis: Part of the flow identification results are marked as reversible for downstream decisions on whether to display.

samples.source: 语音分段结果与说话人分离结果合并时，段边界可能不一致需要仲裁。
samples.reference: Merging voice segmentation with speaker diarization can disagree on boundaries and needs arbitration.
samples.hypothesis: When voice segmentation results are merged with speaker separation results, segment boundaries may be inconsistent and require arbitration.

samples.source: 运行时退出前要打印各阶段缓冲剩余量，便于事后判断是否丢数据。
samples.reference: On shutdown the runtime should print what each buffer still holds, to tell later whether data was dropped.
samples.hypothesis: The remaining buffer amounts of each stage are printed before exiting the run, to make it easier to judge subsequently whether data has been lost.

samples.source: 队列超时后仍要继续消费，避免恢复瞬间被积压请求淹没。
samples.reference: Keep draining after a queue timeout, so a flood of backlogged requests does not overwhelm the restart.
samples.hypothesis: The queue continues to consume after the timeout to avoid being overwhelmed by backlog requests at the moment of recovery.

samples.source: 流水线里共享的可变状态要用消息传递替代锁，否则阶段顺序一变就死锁。
samples.reference: Replace locks with message passing for shared mutable state in a pipeline; a stage reorder otherwise deadlocks.
samples.hypothesis: The variable states shared in the flowline must be communicated to the alternate lock by means of a message, otherwise the deadlock occurs when the phase sequence changes.

samples.source: 首包延迟与首段可播是两个量，不能混用同一个指标名。
samples.reference: Time to first packet and time to first playable segment are different measurements and must not share one metric name.
samples.hypothesis: The first bundle delay and the first segment broadcastability are two quantities that cannot be mixed under the same indicator name.

samples.source: 词元预算接近上限时，优先裁剪历史示例而不是术语表。
samples.reference: Near the token budget, trim the few-shot examples before the terminology list.
samples.hypothesis: Priority is given to trimming historical examples rather than glossaries when the term budget approaches the ceiling.

samples.source: 分块下载的音频要先做采样率一致性校验再送入识别。
samples.reference: Chunk-downloaded audio needs a sample-rate consistency check before recognition.
samples.hypothesis: Audio downloaded in blocks must first be sampled for consistency before being sent for identification.

samples.source: 缓冲区预取过多会让最后一个语段等待时间变长。
samples.reference: Over-prefetching in the buffer lengthens how long the final speech segment waits.
samples.hypothesis: Over-buffering can cause the last segment to wait longer.

samples.source: 流式传输的序号回绕要在协议层定义清楚，不能靠实现默契。
samples.reference: Sequence wrap-around in streaming transport must be defined by the protocol, not left to implementation habit.
samples.hypothesis: Sequential loopback in stream transmission must be clearly defined at the protocol layer and cannot be implemented by default.

samples.source: 解码器遇到损坏帧时应当输出静音帧并记录原因，而不是直接抛异常。
samples.reference: On a corrupt frame the decoder should emit silence and record the reason rather than raising.
samples.hypothesis: When a decoder encounters a damaged frame, it should output a silent frame and record the reason, rather than directly throw an exception.

samples.source: 推理结果缓存以语言对与领域共同定键，跨领域复用会错配语境。
samples.reference: The inference result cache is keyed by language pair and domain together; reusing across domains mismatches context.
samples.hypothesis: The reasoning result cache is keyed in language pairs with the domain, and cross-domain reuse will mismatch the context.

samples.source: 流水线的每一段都要能单独降级，而不是整体失败。
samples.reference: Each stage of the pipeline needs its own degradation path instead of failing as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: Each section of the pipeline needs to be downgraded individually, not fail as a whole.

samples.source: 运行时指标里排队时长与处理时长分开统计，运维才知道该扩容哪一段。
samples.reference: Separate queueing time from processing time in runtime metrics so operators know which stage to scale.
samples.hypothesis: In the runtime indicator, the queue length is measured separately from the processing time, so that operations know which section to expand.

samples.source: 音频归一化要放在编码之前做，动态范围才不会被压缩吃掉。
samples.reference: Do audio normalization before encoding, or the dynamic range gets compressed away.
samples.hypothesis: Audio unification is done before encoding, so that the dynamic range is not eaten up by compression.

samples.source: 转码任务按片段粒度断点续跑，失败时不必从头重来。
samples.reference: Transcoding jobs resume per segment, so a failure does not restart the whole file.
samples.hypothesis: Transcoding tasks are run intermittently at a fragmentary scale, and do not have to be repeated from scratch if they fail.

samples.source: 码率控制选择恒定质量时，关键帧间隔会随之浮动而非固定。
samples.reference: Constant-quality rate control lets the keyframe interval float instead of staying fixed.
samples.hypothesis: When the bit rate control chooses a constant quality, the key frame intervals will float with it rather than be fixed.

samples.source: 容器格式的时间戳基准是媒体时间，换算成墙钟需要轨道起始偏移。
samples.reference: A container format stamps media time, so wall-clock conversion needs the track's start offset.
samples.hypothesis: The time stamp for the container format is based on the media time, and the conversion to a wall clock requires a track start offset.

samples.source: 复用器要求两条轨道的采样点对齐，否则会插入填充包。
samples.reference: The multiplexer demands sample-aligned tracks, or it inserts filler packets.
samples.hypothesis: The repeater requires the sampling points of the two tracks to be aligned, otherwise a fill package is inserted.

samples.source: 解码器的错误隐藏强度是可配置项，过高会让损坏音频听起来平滑但失真。
samples.reference: Decoder error concealment is configurable; too much makes damaged audio smooth but wrong.
samples.hypothesis: The decoder's error hidden intensity is configurable, and too high can make damaged audio sound smooth but distorted.

samples.source: 图像组长度与随机接入点共同决定快进快退的响应速度。
samples.reference: The group of pictures length and the random access points decide how responsive seeking is.
samples.hypothesis: The length of the image group together with the random access point determines the speed of the fast forward and backward response.

samples.source: 帧间预测依赖参考帧顺序，丢帧后必须请求新的同步点。
samples.reference: Inter-frame prediction depends on reference order, so a lost frame must trigger a fresh sync point.
samples.hypothesis: Interframe prediction depends on the reference frame sequence, and a new synchronization point must be requested after a lost frame.

samples.source: 量化参数越高压缩率越高，但文字边缘的块效应会先进入可见范围。
samples.reference: A higher quantization parameter compresses more, but blocking artifacts on text edges become visible first.
samples.hypothesis: The higher the quantization parameter, the higher the compression ratio, but the block effect at the text edges will first enter the visible range.

samples.source: 熵编码的上下文表要在流开始时重置，跨片段复用会造成漂移。
samples.reference: The entropy coding context table must reset at stream start; reusing it across segments causes drift.
samples.hypothesis: The context table of the entropy encoding is reset at the start of the stream, and cross-fragment reuse causes drift.

samples.source: 转码链路里保持原始采样点总数不变，重采样只在显式请求时启用。
samples.reference: A transcoding chain keeps the original sample count unless resampling is explicitly requested.
samples.hypothesis: The total number of original sampling points is kept unchanged in the transcode link, and re-sampling is enabled only on explicit request.

samples.source: 无损压缩只保证比特一致，不保证人耳听到的主观质量提升。
samples.reference: Lossless compression guarantees identical bits, not a better subjective quality.
samples.hypothesis: Lossless compression only guarantees bit consistency and does not guarantee a subjective improvement in the quality of human hearing.

samples.source: 有损压缩在低码率下会优先牺牲高频细节而非语音基频。
samples.reference: At low bitrate, lossy compression sacrifices high-frequency detail before the voice fundamental.
samples.hypothesis: Lossy compression at low bit rates gives priority to high frequency details over vocal bass frequencies.

samples.source: 解复用器遇到交错写入的轨道时要按解码顺序输出样本。
samples.reference: A demuxer must emit samples in decode order when tracks were interleaved on write.
samples.hypothesis: The decoder outputs samples in the decoding sequence when it encounters interlaced written tracks.

samples.source: 比特率探测窗口过短会把静止画面误判成可以降到极低码率。
samples.reference: A bitrate estimation window that is too short mistakes a still frame for something expendable.
samples.hypothesis: A too short bitrate detection window can mistakenly interpret a still image as being reduced to an extremely low frame rate.

samples.source: 编解码器协商失败时必须落回双方共同支持的最低配置。
samples.reference: Negotiation between codecs must fall back to the lowest configuration both sides support.
samples.hypothesis: When a codec negotiation fails, it must fall back to the minimum configuration supported by both parties.

samples.source: 容器格式对轨道数量的限制会在多字幕语言时先撞上。
samples.reference: Container format limits on track count are hit first when many subtitle languages are bundled.
samples.hypothesis: The container format's limitation on the number of tracks will hit first in multi-subtitle languages.

samples.source: 关键帧间隔超过两秒时，直播场景的拖动预览会明显迟钝。
samples.reference: Keyframe intervals beyond two seconds make scrubbing previews sluggish in live scenarios.
samples.hypothesis: The drag preview of live scenes is noticeably slower when the keyframe interval exceeds two seconds.

samples.source: 运动估计的搜索范围增大并不总能提升质量，却一定增加编码耗时。
samples.reference: Widening the motion estimation search rarely improves quality and always costs encoding time.
samples.hypothesis: The movement estimates that increasing the search scope does not always improve quality, but that increasing coding is certainly time-consuming.

samples.source: 帧内预测在静止画面上的收益高于帧间预测，但码率也随之上升。
samples.reference: Intra-frame prediction pays off on still imagery more than inter-frame, though the bitrate rises.
samples.hypothesis: In-frame predictions on still images yield higher gains than inter-frame predictions, but the bitrate increases as well.

samples.source: 编码器输出的容器头信息应当与素材真实声道数一致，不能沿用模板。
samples.reference: The container header an encoder writes must match the real channel count, not the template's.
samples.hypothesis: The container header information output by the encoder should be consistent with the true sound channel number of the material and should not follow a template.

samples.source: 转码前的媒体探针结果要落盘，事后核对声道与位深变化。
samples.reference: Save the probe result before transcoding, to check channel and bit-depth changes afterwards.
samples.hypothesis: The results of the media probe before the transcoding are placed on the plate, and the sound channel and bit depth changes are checked afterwards.

samples.source: 多进程转码时每个进程独立持有缓冲，禁止共享帧缓冲内存。
samples.reference: In multi-process transcoding each process owns its buffer; sharing frame buffer memory is forbidden.
samples.hypothesis: In multi-process transcoding, each process holds the buffer independently, preventing shared frame buffer memory.

samples.source: 解码顺序与显示顺序不同的轨道必须由容器显式记录偏移。
samples.reference: Tracks whose decode order differs from display order need an explicit container offset.
samples.hypothesis: Tracks whose decoding sequence differs from the display sequence must be explicitly offset by the container.

samples.source: 码率控制对旁白静音段的分配应当低于同期对白，而非均分。
samples.reference: Rate control should allocate less to narration silence than to the speech in the same passage.
samples.hypothesis: Rate controls should allocate less of the narrator ' s silent segments than of the simultaneous whites, rather than equally.

samples.source: 熵解码错误在关键帧之后才可恢复，静音期不能替代同步点。
samples.reference: Entropy decoding errors recover only at a keyframe; silence is not a sync point.
samples.hypothesis: The entropy decoding error can only be recovered after the key frame, and the silent period cannot replace the synchronization point.

samples.source: GOP 首帧必须是可独立解码帧，否则切片工具会在段首花屏。
samples.reference: The first frame of a group of pictures must be independently decodable, or segmenting tools show corruption.
samples.hypothesis: The GOP first frame must be an independently decodeable frame, otherwise the slicer will pop the first frame of the segment.

samples.source: 容器格式的元数据字段长度限制会影响双语字幕的轨道命名。
samples.reference: A container format's metadata length limits affect how bilingual subtitle tracks are named.
samples.hypothesis: Container format metadata field length restrictions affect the track naming of bilingual subtitles.

samples.source: 编码器对字幕轨只做透传时，也要保留原始时间轴精度。
samples.reference: Pass-through of a subtitle track must still preserve the original timeline precision.
samples.hypothesis: The original timeline accuracy is also retained when the encoder only passes through the subtitles track.

samples.source: 转码并发改多了会让磁盘随机写成为瓶颈，而非 CPU。
samples.reference: Too much transcoding concurrency makes random disk writes the bottleneck rather than the CPU.
samples.hypothesis: A lot of transcoding and modifying makes the disk a random write bottleneck rather than a CPU bottleneck.

samples.source: 双语字幕的每一行都要各自满足阅读速度上限，不能只看中文一行。
samples.reference: Each line of a bilingual subtitle has to meet the reading-speed bound on its own, not just the Chinese one.
samples.hypothesis: Each line of the bilingual subtitles must meet the upper limit of reading speed individually and cannot be read only in Chinese.

samples.source: 硬字幕烧进画面后只能靠重新编码修改，软字幕可以随时替换轨道。
samples.reference: Hard subtitles can only be changed by re-encoding, while soft subtitles let you swap the track at any time.
samples.hypothesis: Hard subtitles can only be modified by re-encoding once they have been burned into the image, while soft subtitles can be replaced at any time.

samples.source: 字幕轨的字符编码要在容器里显式声明，否则播放器会按本地默认码页猜。
samples.reference: The subtitle track's encoding must be declared in the container, or the player guesses from the local code page.
samples.hypothesis: The character encoding of the subtitle track must be explicitly declared in the container, otherwise the player will guess from the local default code page.

samples.source: 配音替换的是音轨而不是时长，压缩时长会破坏声画同步。
samples.reference: Dubbing replaces the audio track, not the duration; squeezing the duration breaks audio-video sync.
samples.hypothesis: Voice-overs replace tracks rather than lengths, and compression of lengths would disrupt soundscape synchronization.

samples.source: 旁白的语速通常低于对白，配音时不能沿用同一套时间轴策略。
samples.reference: Narration is slower paced than dialogue, so dubbing cannot reuse the same timeline strategy.
samples.hypothesis: The narrator usually speaks at a slower pace than the voice-over, and the voice-over cannot follow the same set of timeline strategies.

samples.source: 对口型调整只能在帧级别微调，超过两帧就会看出违和。
samples.reference: Lip sync adjustment works only within a couple of frames; beyond that the mismatch becomes visible.
samples.hypothesis: Contrast adjustment can only be fine-tuned at the frame level, and more than two frames will result in discrepancies.

samples.source: 字幕时序的漂移通常累积在段落边界，而不是均匀分布在每行。
samples.reference: Subtitle timing drift accumulates at paragraph boundaries rather than spreading evenly across lines.
samples.hypothesis: Drifts in the subtitle sequence are usually accumulated at paragraph boundaries, rather than evenly distributed across each line.

samples.source: 字幕对齐要先按语音分段切点，再把文字映射到段边界。
samples.reference: Subtitle alignment should cut points by voice segmentation first, then map text onto those boundaries.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle alignment involves first dividing the text into audio segments and then mapping the text to the segment boundaries.

samples.source: 分段计时要以素材的时间轴为基准，转码后不能假设毫秒值不变。
samples.reference: Segment timing must be based on the media timeline; do not assume millisecond values survive transcoding.
samples.hypothesis: Segment timing is based on the timeline of the material and cannot be assumed to remain unchanged after transcoding.

samples.source: 字幕文件导入时若带字节顺序标记，要识别并剥除，否则首行字幕会带上不可见字符。
samples.reference: Detect and strip a byte order mark on subtitle import, or the first line carries an invisible character.
samples.hypothesis: If the subtitle file is imported with a byte sequence marker, it must be identified and removed, otherwise the first line of the subtitle will be marked with an invisible character.

samples.source: 配音与对口型的验收标准不同，前者听语音替换，后者看画面同步。
samples.reference: Dubbing and lip sync have different acceptance criteria: one is judged by the replaced voice, the other by the picture.
samples.hypothesis: The acceptance standards for voiceovers differ from those for voice-overs, in which the voice is replaced by sound, while the screen is synchronized.

samples.source: 多语种字幕发布时，字幕轨语言要用语言代码而不是显示名。
samples.reference: Multi-language subtitle releases should key subtitle tracks by language code, not display name.
samples.hypothesis: When multilingual subtitles are released, the subtitle track language is used with the language code rather than the display name.

samples.source: 字幕行的换行位置要在渲染端决定，导出选项与之解耦。
samples.reference: Line breaking for subtitles belongs to the renderer, decoupled from export options.
samples.hypothesis: The position of the subtitle line break is determined by the render side, and the export options are decoupled from it.

samples.source: 时间轴面板要区分视频帧号与音频采样点号，两者换算依赖帧率与采样率。
samples.reference: A timeline panel must separate video frame numbers from audio sample indices; conversion depends on frame rate and sample rate.
samples.hypothesis: The timeline panel distinguishes between the video frame number and the audio sample point number, both of which are converted depending on the frame rate and sample rate.

samples.source: 配音音轨的响度归一化目标要与原对白一致，否则切换时音量跳变。
samples.reference: The loudness target of a dubbed audio track must match the original or the level jumps when switching.
samples.hypothesis: The volume of the voice-over tracks must be consistent with the original, otherwise the volume will jump when switching.

samples.source: 字幕时序在变速播放下需要重新映射，倍速不是简单缩放时间戳。
samples.reference: Subtitle timing needs remapping under variable playback speed; scaling timestamps is not enough.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle timing needs to be remapped under variable-speed playback, and double-speed is not a simple scaling time stamp.

samples.source: 导出为 SRT 时时间戳精确到毫秒即可，ASS 需要到厘秒。
samples.reference: Export to SRT needs millisecond timestamps while ASS needs centiseconds.
samples.hypothesis: For SRT exports, the time stamp should be accurate to the millisecond, and for ASS to the centisecond.

samples.source: 预览窗口按软字幕渲染，让用户能开关字幕轨。
samples.reference: The preview renders soft subtitles so users can toggle the subtitle track.
samples.hypothesis: The preview window is rendered as soft subtitles, allowing the user to switch between subtitles tracks.

samples.source: 剪辑导出时若只改时间轴不改内容，重新封装就够，不要引入不必要的二压。
samples.reference: Re-muxing is enough when only the timeline changes; do not add an unnecessary second lossy compression pass.
samples.hypothesis: If the clips are exported with no changes to the timeline, repackaging is sufficient to avoid introducing unnecessary duplication.

samples.source: 配音项目的交付要同时给音轨与双语字幕，缺一项就无法复核。
samples.reference: A dubbing delivery needs both the audio track and bilingual subtitles, or the work cannot be reviewed.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery of voice-over projects requires both audio tracks and bilingual subtitles, and the absence of one cannot be reviewed.

samples.source: 字幕断句要避开词中间，中文按语段、拉丁文按词边界处理。
samples.reference: Subtitle line breaking must avoid cutting inside words: Chinese by speech segment, Latin scripts by word boundary.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle breaks should be avoided in the middle of words, and should be treated by phrase and word boundaries in Chinese and Latin respectively.

samples.source: 音轨对齐检查可以在无配音情况下先做，不必等全部素材到位。
samples.reference: Timeline alignment checks can run before dubbing, without waiting for all assets.
samples.hypothesis: Track alignment checks can be done without the voice acting, rather than waiting for all the material to be in place.

samples.source: 台词删改会移动后续时间轴，需要整段重排而不是逐行挪。
samples.reference: Cutting a line shifts every later timestamp, so reflow the whole block rather than nudging rows.
samples.hypothesis: The deletion of words would move the subsequent timeline, requiring a complete rearrangement rather than line-by-line.

samples.source: 配音演员的分段录音要保留采样率与位深一致，避免二次重采样。
samples.reference: Dubbing sessions must keep a consistent sample rate and bit depth to avoid a second resampling.
samples.hypothesis: The segmented recordings of voice actors should retain the sample rate consistent with the bit depth to avoid duplicate re-sampling.

samples.source: 字幕轨的最大字符数应按目标语言宽度实测，不按中文经验值套。
samples.reference: The maximum characters per subtitle line should be measured for the target language's width, not copied from Chinese habits.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum number of characters in the subtitles track should be measured by the width of the target language, not by the Chinese empirical set.

samples.source: 声画同步的容忍阈值要按素材类型定，会议录像与动画并不一样。
samples.reference: The audio-video sync tolerance depends on the material; conference recordings and animation differ.
samples.hypothesis: The tolerance threshold for audio-visual synchronization depends on the type of material, and conference video is not the same as animation.

samples.source: 字幕的标点恢复要在分段之后做，跨段标点会错挂到相邻行。
samples.reference: Run punctuation restoration after segmentation, or punctuation crosses into neighbouring lines.
samples.hypothesis: Punctuation restoration for subtitles is done after paragraphs, and cross-paragraph punctuation is incorrectly attached to adjacent lines.

samples.source: 旁白与对白混在同一音轨时，配音替换需要按语段定位。
samples.reference: When narration and dialogue share one audio track, dubbing replacement must locate speech segments first.
samples.hypothesis: When narrators and counterparts are mixed in the same audio track, voice substitution needs to be positioned per segment.

samples.source: 导出前比对采样率、声道与位深三项，不匹配就提示并拒绝静默重采样。
samples.reference: Compare sample rate, channel count and bit depth before export, and refuse a silent resample when they differ.
samples.hypothesis: Before exporting, the sample rate, channel and depth are compared, and if they do not match, a prompt is displayed and a silent resampling is refused.

samples.source: 字幕时序在缺帧素材上要按有效帧长插值，不能假设恒定帧率。
samples.reference: Subtitle timing on material with dropped frames must interpolate by real frame durations, not a constant rate.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle timing on missing frame material is based on the effective frame length interpolation and cannot assume a constant frame rate.

samples.source: 多角色播客的本地化要先做说话人分离，再按角色分配合成音色。
samples.reference: Multi-speaker podcast localization needs speaker diarization first, then timbre assignment per role.
samples.hypothesis: The localization of multi-role podcasts involves the separation of speakers and the allocation of voices to each role.

samples.source: 配音的口型参考帧应在解码后取，编码前的帧序列不可靠。
samples.reference: Use decoded frames as the lip-sync reference; pre-encode frame order is unreliable.
samples.hypothesis: Vocal reference frames for voiceovers should be taken after decoding, and pre-encoding sequences are unreliable.

samples.source: 字幕轨嵌套富文本时，容器格式对标签白名单要写清。
samples.reference: When a subtitle track carries rich text, spell out the container's tag whitelist.
samples.hypothesis: When the caption track is nested with rich text, the container format must be clearly written for the label whitelist.

samples.source: 把内嵌字幕转成软字幕需要光学字符识别，质量会低于原始文本。
samples.reference: Converting hard subtitles into soft ones needs optical recognition, and quality drops below authored text.
samples.hypothesis: Converting embedded captions to soft captions requires optical character recognition, which is of lower quality than the original text.

samples.source: 时长压缩到 95% 会累积成半秒偏移，长素材必须分段校正。
samples.reference: Squeezing duration to 95 percent accumulates into a half-second offset; long material needs segment-wise correction.
samples.hypothesis: Length compression to 95% will accumulate as a half-second offset, and long material must be corrected in segments.

samples.source: 配音交付要附时间轴文件与音轨两份产物，命名规则事先约定。
samples.reference: Dubbing delivery ships two artefacts, a timeline file and an audio track, with naming agreed in advance.
samples.hypothesis: The voice-over delivery is accompanied by two copies of the timeline file and the soundtrack, and the naming rules are agreed upon in advance.

samples.source: 字幕行长度与每屏行数共同决定阅读速度上限。
samples.reference: Line length and lines per screen together bound the readable speed of subtitles.
samples.hypothesis: The length of the caption line together with the number of lines per screen determines the upper limit of the reading speed.

samples.source: 同一素材的多语种字幕应共享分段结果，避免各自漂移。
samples.reference: Subtitle tracks in several languages should share one segmentation result to avoid drifting apart.
samples.hypothesis: Multilingual subtitles of the same material should share segmentation results to avoid individual drifts.

samples.source: 时间轴导出要显式声明参考是媒体时间还是墙钟时间。
samples.reference: Timeline export must state whether it references media time or wall-clock time.
samples.hypothesis: The timeline export must explicitly state whether the reference is media time or wall clock time.

samples.source: 配音的呼吸声保留与否要与原声一致，过度降噪会显得虚假。
samples.reference: Keep or remove dubbing breathes consistently with the source; over-cleaning sounds artificial.
samples.hypothesis: The breathing sounds of the voice actors must be consistent with the original sound, and excessive noise reduction may appear false.

samples.source: 字幕对齐失败时要报出对不上的语段编号，方便人工介入。
samples.reference: On alignment failure, report the speech segment ids that disagree so a human can step in.
samples.hypothesis: In the case of a failed caption alignment, the field number of the failed alignment is reported to facilitate manual intervention.

samples.source: 字幕轨与视频轨的起始偏移要各自记录，合并后无法反推。
samples.reference: Record the start offsets of subtitle and video tracks separately; they cannot be recovered after muxing.
samples.hypothesis: The initial offsets of the subtitles track and the video track are recorded separately and cannot be reversed after merging.

samples.source: 变速与变调要分别声明，只调其一时听感会不一致。
samples.reference: Declare speed and pitch changes separately; changing one alone sounds inconsistent.
samples.hypothesis: Changes in speed and intonation must be declared separately, and only adjustment will be inconsistent for a while.

samples.source: 对白密集的素材里，字幕分段应以停顿而不是标点为主判据。
samples.reference: In dialogue-dense material, break subtitles on pauses rather than punctuation.
samples.hypothesis: In white-on-white material, subtitle paragraphs should be judged by punctuation rather than punctuation marks.

samples.source: 音轨替换后重新混流时，要保留原轨的语言标签与默认轨标记。
samples.reference: After swapping an audio track, preserve its language tag and default-track flag when re-muxing.
samples.hypothesis: When remixing after a track replacement, the language tags of the original track and the default track tags are retained.

samples.source: 字幕时序校正要以可懂度为准，不为齐帧牺牲断句。
samples.reference: Let intelligibility rule subtitle timing fixes rather than aligning to frames.
samples.hypothesis: The timing of subtitles should be corrected for intelligible purposes, without sacrificing phrase breaks for the sake of framing.

samples.source: 配音时长超出画面时，优先调整语速而不是删内容。
samples.reference: When a dubbing runs long against the picture, adjust pacing before cutting content.
samples.hypothesis: When voice-overs exceed the length of the screen, priority is given to adjusting the speech speed rather than deleting content.

samples.source: 把双语字幕上下排布会让每屏行数翻倍，需下调停留时间。
samples.reference: Stacking bilingual subtitles doubles lines per screen, so dwell time must shrink.
samples.hypothesis: The bilingual subtitles would be arranged so that the number of lines per screen would be doubled, requiring a downward adjustment of the pause time.

samples.source: 字幕文件的时间戳若早于视频起始偏移，播放器会丢弃该行。
samples.reference: The player drops subtitle lines whose timestamps precede the video's start offset.
samples.hypothesis: If the time stamp of the subtitles file shifts earlier than the beginning of the video, the player will skip the line.

samples.source: 导出前检查相邻字幕重叠，重叠会让阅读者不知读哪一行。
samples.reference: Check for overlapping subtitles before export; overlap leaves the reader unsure which line to read.
samples.hypothesis: Before exporting, check for overlapping of adjacent captions, which would leave the reader unsure which line to read.

samples.source: 配音演员的分段间隔要留静音余量，便于后期对齐。
samples.reference: Leave silence padding between dubbing takes to make later alignment possible.
samples.hypothesis: The intervals between the voice actors should leave a margin of silence for later alignment.

samples.source: 长视频的字幕分段建议按语义段落而不是固定秒数切。
samples.reference: Split subtitles for long video by semantic paragraphs rather than fixed seconds.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle paragraphs in long videos are recommended to be cut by semantic paragraphs rather than fixed seconds.

samples.source: 字幕时序导出为帧率非整数素材时，必须用时间基而不是帧计数。
samples.reference: For non-integer frame rates, export subtitle timing in a timebase instead of frame counts.
samples.hypothesis: When the subtitles time sequence is exported as a non-integer frame rate material, it must be counted on a time basis rather than a frame count.

samples.source: 音轨的响度目标要在混流前定，混完再压会牵连对白。
samples.reference: Set the loudness target before muxing; compressing afterwards also affects dialogue.
samples.hypothesis: The volume target of the audio track is set before mixing, and after mixing re-pressing involves correction.

samples.source: 字幕断行遇到缩写与专有名词要有保护规则，避免误断。
samples.reference: Line breaking needs protection rules for abbreviations and proper names.
samples.hypothesis: There should be rules to protect subtitles from being interrupted by abbreviations and proprietary terms.

samples.source: 对口型素材若帧率不一致，要先统一到时间轴基准。
samples.reference: Normalize differing frame rates onto one timeline before any lip-sync work.
samples.hypothesis: If the frame rate of the counterpart material is inconsistent, it must first be aligned to the timeline reference.

samples.source: 字幕的省略号与破折号在语音合成里需要单独停顿规则。
samples.reference: Ellipses and dashes in subtitles need their own pause rules for speech synthesis.
samples.hypothesis: The skips and hyphens in subtitles require separate pause rules in speech synthesis.

samples.source: 配音质检要按语段回放，整片一次过会漏掉局部不同步。
samples.reference: Review dubbing speech segment by segment; one pass over the whole show misses local desync.
samples.hypothesis: The sound quality check is played back by segments, and the entire film will miss out on local non-synchronization once.

samples.source: 多语言交付里，字幕文件命名要含语言代码与来源标记。
samples.reference: In multilingual delivery, subtitle filenames carry the language code and provenance.
samples.hypothesis: In multilingual delivery, the subtitles file is named with the language code and source tag.

samples.source: 时间轴导出要包含轨道偏移与有效帧率两项元数据。
samples.reference: Timeline export must include track offsets and the effective frame rate.
samples.hypothesis: Timeline exports include both track offset and effective frame rate metadata.

samples.source: 字幕行的停留时长下限由字数决定，不由切换节奏决定。
samples.reference: A subtitle line's minimum dwell time is set by its length, not by cut rhythm.
samples.hypothesis: The lower limit for the duration of a caption line is determined by the number of words, not by the speed of switching.

samples.source: 旁白与配乐同轨时，配音替换需要额外的分离步骤。
samples.reference: When narration shares a track with music, dubbing needs an extra separation step.
samples.hypothesis: When the narrator is in sync with the score, voice replacement requires additional separation steps.

samples.source: 字幕轨的字符集要在导出日志里记录，供现场排障。
samples.reference: Record the subtitle track's character set in the export log for field debugging.
samples.hypothesis: The character set of the subtitles track is recorded in the export log for on-site troubleshooting.

samples.source: 声画同步测量要用人耳可辨的事件点，例如掌声与敲击。
samples.reference: Measure audio-video sync on audible events such as claps and strikes.
samples.hypothesis: Synchronous sound imaging measures event points that are audible to the human ear, such as applause and knocking.

samples.source: 字幕对齐的人工抽检要覆盖首尾与中途，长素材中段最容易漂。
samples.reference: Spot-check subtitle alignment at the start, middle and end; the middle drifts most.
samples.hypothesis: The manual sampling of caption alignment covers the beginning, middle and end of a long material, which is most prone to drift.

samples.source: 配音要按目标语言重排断句，直译长度常常超出画面。
samples.reference: Dubbing must re-break lines for the target language; literal length usually exceeds the picture.
samples.hypothesis: Voice-overs have to be rearranged according to the target language, and the length of the translation often exceeds the length of the screen.

samples.source: 字幕时序在丢帧素材上要记录丢帧位置，否则校正无据。
samples.reference: Log dropped-frame positions on subtitle timelines, or corrections have no basis.
samples.hypothesis: The subtitle sequence must record the drop frame position on the drop frame material, otherwise the correction will not be recorded.

samples.source: 多轨合并时默认轨与强制轨标记要显式写入，不靠播放器猜。
samples.reference: Write default and forced track flags explicitly when merging tracks.
samples.hypothesis: When merging multiple tracks, the default and mandatory track markers are written explicitly, not guessed by the player.

samples.source: 导出双语字幕时，两种语言的停留时长要共同满足阅读速度约束。
samples.reference: When exporting bilingual subtitles, dwell time must satisfy one reading-speed bound for both languages.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting bilingual subtitles, the length of stay in both languages must meet the read speed constraints together.

samples.source: 缓冲不足会让字幕渲染出现整行闪烁，与内容无关。
samples.reference: Underrun in the buffer makes whole subtitle lines flicker, independent of content.
samples.hypothesis: Insufficient buffering causes the rendering of subtitles to flicker throughout the line, irrelevant to the content.

samples.source: 分段计时表要能导出为对照清单，供配音现场按行取用。
samples.reference: Export the segment timing sheet as a checklist dubbing sessions can follow line by line.
samples.hypothesis: Timelines should be able to be exported as checklists for line-by-line access on the set.

samples.source: 时间轴上的静默段也要保留编号，删除会造成后续错位。
samples.reference: Keep numbering for silent spans on the timeline; deleting one shifts everything after it.
samples.hypothesis: The silence segments on the timeline should also be retained numbered, and deletion would cause subsequent misalignment.

samples.source: 音轨替换要同步替换时长元数据，只换负载会留下错长度。
samples.reference: Replacing an audio track must update its duration metadata, not just the payload.
samples.hypothesis: Replacement of tracks requires synchronous replacement of time-length metadata, and only changing the load will leave the incorrect length.

samples.source: 缓存命中率高不等于翻译质量好，缓存只说明这句话以前见过。
samples.reference: A high cache hit rate does not mean good translation quality; it only means the sentence was seen before.
samples.hypothesis: A high cache hit rate is not equal to a good translation quality; the cache only indicates that the sentence has been seen before.

samples.source: 这里的缓存指的是音频帧缓存，不要译成网页缓存。
samples.reference: The cache here is the audio frame cache, not a web cache.
samples.hypothesis: Cache here refers to audio frame caching, not to be translated as web page caching.

samples.source: 预取缓存开太大时，最后一个语段的等待时间反而变长。
samples.reference: An over-large prefetch cache lengthens how long the last speech segment waits.
samples.hypothesis: When the pre-cache is too large, the wait time for the last segment becomes longer.

samples.source: 磁盘缓存在断电后仍然有效，所以失效策略要写清版本标识。
samples.reference: A disk cache survives power loss, so its invalidation policy needs a version tag.
samples.hypothesis: The disk cache remains valid after a power failure, so the expiration policy must clearly write the version marker.

samples.source: 缓存键必须含语言对与领域，否则跨领域复用会错配语境。
samples.reference: A cache key must include the language pair and domain, or cross-domain reuse mismatches context.
samples.hypothesis: The cache key must contain a language pair with a domain, otherwise cross-domain replication will mismatch the context.

samples.source: 编解码器升级后旧码流仍能解码，兼容矩阵要写进发布说明。
samples.reference: After a codec upgrade old streams still decode, and the compatibility matrix belongs in the release notes.
samples.hypothesis: The old streams can still be decoded after the codec is upgraded, and the compatibility matrix is written into the release notes.

samples.source: 这个文件需要软编解码器而不是系统自带的那个。
samples.reference: This file needs the software codec rather than the system one.
samples.hypothesis: This file requires a soft codec, not the one that comes with the system.

samples.source: 编解码器协商要看双方都支持的档位，不能只看自己声明的列表。
samples.reference: Codec negotiation must look at what both sides support, not just one's own advertised list.
samples.hypothesis: Codec negotiations should look at the bandwidth supported by both sides, not just the list of their own declarations.

samples.source: 容器格式选错会让字幕轨被丢弃，即使视频轨看起来正常。
samples.reference: A wrong container format can drop the subtitle track even while video looks fine.
samples.hypothesis: Incorrect formatting of the container will cause the subtitle track to be discarded, even if the video track appears normal.

samples.source: 同一段素材换容器格式封装后，时长元数据可能有几毫秒差异。
samples.reference: Re-muxing the same material into another container can shift duration metadata by a few milliseconds.
samples.hypothesis: The time metadata may differ by a few milliseconds when the same section is packaged in a material-changing container format.

samples.source: 混音要把对白、配乐与音效分轨处理，而不是在一条轨上叠。
samples.reference: A mix should treat dialogue, music and effects as separate stems rather than stacked on one track.
samples.hypothesis: Mixing involves separating the alignment, music, and sound effects into separate tracks rather than stacking them on a single track.

samples.source: 混音后的响度目标要按交付平台要求设定，不是越响越好。
samples.reference: Set the loudness target of the mix to the delivery platform's requirement, not as loud as possible.
samples.hypothesis: The volume target after mixing will be set as required by the delivery platform, not the louder the better.

samples.source: 混音阶段保留头部空间，避免后期压缩再次抬升噪声。
samples.reference: Leave headroom during mixing so later compression does not lift the noise floor.
samples.hypothesis: The mixing phase preserves headroom to avoid the noise being raised again by later compression.

samples.source: 分轨导出时每条轨的起始时间必须一致，否则合回会错位。
samples.reference: Exported stems must share one start time, or reassembling them misaligns.
samples.hypothesis: When split tracks are exported, the start time of each track must be the same, otherwise the merge return will be misplaced.

samples.source: 干声里残留的伴奏会被识别成语音，导致转写出现幻听内容。
samples.reference: Accompaniment left in the dry vocal is recognised as speech and invents transcript content.
samples.hypothesis: The accompaniment that remains in the dry voice is recognized as speech, resulting in a hallucinatory content of the transcription.

samples.source: 配音的干声要单独留档，混音之后就无法再分离。
samples.reference: Keep the dubbing dry vocal archived on its own; after the mix it can no longer be separated.
samples.hypothesis: The dry sounds of the voices are kept separately and cannot be separated after mixing.

samples.source: 音轨表里的声道映射要按容器写，不按播放器显示顺序。
samples.reference: Map channels in the track table according to the container, not the player's display order.
samples.hypothesis: The audio channel mapping in the audio track table is written by container, not by player display order.

samples.source: 路由规则改一次就要重跑覆盖矩阵，否则报表描述的不是当前配置。
samples.reference: Rerun the coverage matrix after any change to the routing table, or the report describes a stale configuration.
samples.hypothesis: Once a routing rule is changed, the override matrix must be rerunned, otherwise the report does not describe the current configuration.

samples.source: 这里的路由指引擎选择路由，不是网络路由表。
samples.reference: The routing here means engine selection, not a network routing table.
samples.hypothesis: Routing here refers to the route selected by the engine, not the network routing table.

samples.source: 视频片段切片要以关键帧为界，否则会解出花屏。
samples.reference: Video clip cuts must land on keyframes, or the result decodes as corrupted.
samples.hypothesis: Video clips must be cut by key frames, otherwise the screen will be unlocked.

samples.source: 切片工具对无关键帧的长图像组支持有限，需要先重编码。
samples.reference: Splitting tools handle long groups of pictures poorly without re-encoding first.
samples.hypothesis: The slicer tool has limited support for long image sets without key frames, which require re-encoding first.

samples.source: 表格数据作为字幕源时要防公式注入，导出侧也要转义。
samples.reference: Spreadsheet data used as subtitle source needs formula-injection guards on both sides.
samples.hypothesis: The table data as the source of the caption must be protected from formula injection, and the export side must also be redefined.

samples.source: 表结构变更要向后兼容，旧素材没有新字段是常态。
samples.reference: Keep the table schema backward compatible; old assets without the new field are the norm.
samples.hypothesis: Table structure changes are backward compatible, and it is normal for old material to have no new fields.

samples.source: 帧率是媒体属性不是剪辑属性，导出侧不要二次换算。
samples.reference: Frame rate is a media property, not an editing one; do not convert it twice on export.
samples.hypothesis: The frame rate is a media attribute, not a clip attribute, and is not converted twice on the export side.

samples.source: 模型的部分权重损坏时应整体拒绝加载，而不是静默补齐。
samples.reference: If part of the model weights are corrupt, refuse the checkpoint instead of silently filling in.
samples.hypothesis: Partial weights of the model should be rejected as a whole when damaged, rather than silently replenished.

samples.source: 词表不匹配时子词切分会退化成逐字符，推理质量随之崩塌。
samples.reference: On a vocabulary mismatch, subword tokenisation degrades to per-character and quality collapses.
samples.hypothesis: When the glossary does not match, subjunctive decomposition degenerates into character-by-character decomposition, and the reasoning quality collapses.

samples.source: 流水线在队列满时给的是拒绝还是等待，必须是可观测的。
samples.reference: Whether the pipeline rejects or waits on a full queue has to be observable.
samples.hypothesis: The flow line must be observable when the queue is full, whether it rejects or waits.

samples.source: 队列策略变更会影响首包延迟，回归里要一起看。
samples.reference: A queue policy change moves time to first packet, so keep it in the same regression.
samples.hypothesis: Changes in queue policy will affect the first packet delay, which will be discussed in the return.

samples.source: 缓冲与缓冲区的译法在中文里同形，英文要统一为 buffer。
samples.reference: Buffering and buffer both read the same in Chinese; keep one English word for them.
samples.hypothesis: Buffer and buffer zone are translated the same in Chinese, but in English they should be translated as buffer.

samples.source: 数据流与流式传输在文档里要区分，一个是内容一个是传输方式。
samples.reference: Separate the data stream from streaming transport in docs: one is content, the other is how it travels.
samples.hypothesis: Data streams and streamed transmissions in documents are to be distinguished, one is the content and the other is the mode of transmission.

samples.source: 检查点是指模型权重还是任务断点，句子里要靠上下文消除歧义。
samples.reference: Say from context whether checkpoint means model weights or a resume point.
samples.hypothesis: The checkpoints refer to model weights or task breakpoints, and the context in the sentence eliminates ambiguity.

samples.source: 流水线的段与语音分段段是两个概念，命名要分开。
samples.reference: A pipeline stage and a speech segment are different notions; name them apart.
samples.hypothesis: The segment of the flowline and the vocal sub-segment are two concepts that should be named separately.

samples.source: 声道与通道在英文里是同一个词，所以中文界面必须按领域强制选一个。
samples.reference: Channel covers both senses in English, so the Chinese interface must pick one by domain instead of defaulting.
samples.hypothesis: Sound channel and channel are the same word in English, so the Chinese interface must be forced to choose one by domain.

samples.source: 关键帧与首帧不是同一件事，预览逻辑要按可解码帧判断。
samples.reference: A keyframe is not the first frame; preview logic must decide on decodable frames.
samples.hypothesis: The key frame is not the same as the first frame, and the preview logic is judged by the decodeable frame.

samples.source: 词元与子词在计费与切分上口径不同，报表不能混用。
samples.reference: Tokens and subwords differ for billing and for segmentation; do not share one metric.
samples.hypothesis: Elements and sub-elements differ in scale in terms of charges and deductions, and statements cannot be confused.

samples.source: 比特率与码率在文档里统一用一个词，避免读者以为两项指标。
samples.reference: Keep bitrate and rate control terminology distinct but consistent, or readers see two metrics.
samples.hypothesis: Bitrate and bit rate are used as a single term in the documentation to avoid confusion.

samples.source: 分块与批处理是两回事，分块是流式内的窗口。
samples.reference: Chunking is not batching; chunking is a window inside streaming, batching is a group of requests.
samples.hypothesis: Blocking is different from batch processing, and blocking is a window within a flow.

samples.source: 重采样与重新量化都要声明，混在一起会掩盖质量损失。
samples.reference: Declare resampling and requantisation separately, or one hides the other's damage.
samples.hypothesis: Both re-sampling and re-quantification must be declared, and mixing together masks loss of quality.

samples.source: 编码器预设档位与质量参数冲突时应报错，不是静默取一个。
samples.reference: Error out when an encoder preset and an explicit quality flag conflict, rather than silently choosing one.
samples.hypothesis: The encoder should report an error when a preset range conflicts with a quality parameter, not take one in silence.

samples.source: 解码器在硬件与软件之间回退时，要记录回退原因。
samples.reference: Record why the decoder fell back from hardware to software.
samples.hypothesis: When the decoder returns between hardware and software, the reason for the return shall be recorded.

samples.source: 容器与编解码器的能力列表不一致，以容器约束为准。
samples.reference: When container and codec capabilities disagree, the container's constraint wins.
samples.hypothesis: Container and codec capability lists are not consistent, container constraints prevail.

samples.source: 混音轨数超过容器上限时，要先给可执行提示再失败。
samples.reference: Warn before failing when the mix exceeds the container's track limit.
samples.hypothesis: When the number of mix tracks exceeds the container's upper limit, an executable prompt is given before failure.

samples.source: 干声质量决定配音可懂度，伴奏残留的代价是转写错字。
samples.reference: Dry vocal quality drives dubbing intelligibility; leftover accompaniment shows up as transcript errors.
samples.hypothesis: The quality of the sound determines the intelligibility of the voice, and accompaniment remains at the cost of transliteration errors.

samples.source: 表格导入的字幕时长若缺列，要按行报错而不是补默认值。
samples.reference: Report the row when a subtitle sheet lacks a duration column, instead of defaulting it.
samples.hypothesis: If the length of the caption is missing from the table import, the error should be reported per line instead of filling in the default.

samples.source: 帧序号在跨段拼接后必须重排，否则解码顺序与显示顺序倒挂。
samples.reference: Renumber frames after concatenation, or decode order and display order invert.
samples.hypothesis: Chapter numbers must be rearranged after cross-sectional binding, otherwise the decoding sequence is inverted with the display sequence.

samples.source: 路由决策要能回读，只给结果不给路径无法排障。
samples.reference: Routing decisions must be readable back; a result without a path cannot be debugged.
samples.hypothesis: Routing decisions need to be read backwards, so that only results are given without paths.

samples.source: 词表的领域覆盖决定子词切分好坏，通用词表在专名上会碎。
samples.reference: A vocabulary's domain coverage decides subword quality; a general one shreds proper nouns.
samples.hypothesis: The domain coverage of the glossary determines whether or not a subjunctive is divided, and a generic glossary is broken down on the specifics.

samples.source: 缓存失效在跨版本场景要按语言对粒度，而不是全局清空。
samples.reference: Expire the cache per language pair across versions rather than clearing it globally.
samples.hypothesis: Cache failures in cross-version scenarios are cleared on a language-specific basis, rather than globally.

samples.source: 自动评测不能替代人工评测，窄域上指标与人工打分相关性明显下降。
samples.reference: Automatic evaluation cannot replace human review; on narrow domains the correlation drops sharply.
samples.hypothesis: Automatic assessments cannot replace manual assessments, and the correlation between narrow-field indicators and manual scoring has significantly decreased.

samples.source: 抽样评测要按子领域分层，否则长尾问题看不见。
samples.reference: Sample evaluations must stratify by sub-domain, or the long tail stays invisible.
samples.hypothesis: Sampling assessments must be stratified by sub-domain, otherwise the long-tail problem will not be visible.

samples.source: 中文语音评测以字符错误率为主指标，词错误率依赖分词口径。
samples.reference: Chinese speech evaluation leans on character error rate, because word error rate depends on a tokenisation convention.
samples.hypothesis: The Chinese phonological assessment is based on the character error rate as the main indicator, while the word error rate depends on the word spacing.

samples.source: 对照实验只改一个变量，同时改注入策略与上限会让结果无法归因。
samples.reference: Change one variable per experiment; altering injection policy and its cap together makes results unattributable.
samples.hypothesis: Changing only one variable in the control experiment, and changing the injection strategy and the upper limit, would make the results unattributable.

samples.source: 评测样本要覆盖短句、中句、长句三档，失败模式各不相同。
samples.reference: Evaluation samples should cover short, medium and long sentences; their failure modes differ.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation sample covers three ranges of short, medium and long sentences, each with different failure patterns.

samples.source: 回归基线一旦发布就要固定种子与时间戳，便于复现。
samples.reference: Once a regression baseline is published, fix the seed and timestamp so it can be reproduced.
samples.hypothesis: Once released, the return baseline will have a fixed seed and time stamp to facilitate reproduction.

samples.source: 统计显著性不等于实际显著，零点几个百分点要看是否影响体感。
samples.reference: Statistical significance is not practical significance; check whether a few tenths reach the user.
samples.hypothesis: Statistical significance is not equal to actual significance, and the difference can range from zero to a few percentage points, depending on whether it affects perception.

samples.source: 负结论也要同样口径报告，不能只报成功的那一轮。
samples.reference: Report negative results under the same discipline, not only the round that worked.
samples.hypothesis: Negative conclusions should be reported in the same way, not only the successful round.

samples.source: 评测重跑要限定范围参数，否则会把其他引擎的既有证据覆盖掉。
samples.reference: Scope a rerun explicitly, or it overwrites evidence belonging to other engines.
samples.hypothesis: The rerun of the evaluation should be limited to scope parameters, otherwise it would override existing evidence from other engines.

samples.source: 分母里不能混入失败行，否则会把引擎故障报成质量下降。
samples.reference: Do not leave failed rows in the denominator, or an engine fault reads as a quality drop.
samples.hypothesis: Failure lines cannot be mixed in the denominator, otherwise engine failures will be reported as quality decreases.

samples.source: 同臂复采给出噪声地板，落在地板内的差值不足以归因。
samples.reference: Same-arm repeats give the noise floor; a delta inside it cannot be attributed.
samples.hypothesis: The co-arm re-excavation gives noise floors, and the differences falling within the floors are not sufficient to be attributed.

samples.source: 指标行要能追到一次可复现运行，含脚本、样本与时间。
samples.reference: Every metric row must trace to one reproducible run with script, samples and time.
samples.hypothesis: The indicator row must be able to trace back to a repeatable operation, including script, sample and time.

samples.source: 人工抽检的污染率要有实测来源，不能沿用旧一轮的估计。
samples.reference: Keep a measured source for spot-checked contamination rates instead of reusing an old estimate.
samples.hypothesis: The contamination rates of the manual samples must have an empirical source and cannot be based on estimates from the previous round.

samples.source: 评测脚本要进版本控制，仓外的一次性脚本无人能复核。
samples.reference: Keep evaluation scripts under version control; a one-off script outside the repo cannot be re-checked.
samples.hypothesis: Evaluation scripts are under version control, and out-of-the-box one-time scripts cannot be reviewed.

samples.source: 配对比较要按同一批句子，不同窗口的均值差不是效果。
samples.reference: Pair on the same sentences; a difference between unlike windows is not an effect.
samples.hypothesis: Matching comparisons are based on the same set of sentences, and differences in mean values from different windows are not effects.

samples.source: 留出集要真留出，参与过调优的样本不能当评测集。
samples.reference: Hold-out means held out; samples that took part in tuning cannot be the evaluation set.
samples.hypothesis: The excluded set must be truly excluded, and the samples that participated in the optimization cannot be used as a test set.

samples.source: 报告要写清局限，分布差异不外推到未覆盖的领域。
samples.reference: State limitations plainly; do not extrapolate a distribution beyond the domains it covers.
samples.hypothesis: Limitations should be clearly stated in the report and distributional differences should not be extrapolated to areas not covered.

samples.source: 每个对外数字都要有实测来源，估计值一律标注为估算。
samples.reference: Every published number needs a measured source; label estimates as estimates.
samples.hypothesis: Each external figure has an empirical source and the estimates are always marked as estimates.

samples.source: 同一指标的多次运行要区分身份，避免新跑覆盖旧证。
samples.reference: Give repeated runs of one metric distinct identities so a new run cannot replace the old evidence.
samples.hypothesis: Multiple runs of the same indicator should distinguish identities and avoid overlapping new runs with old ones.

samples.source: 评测语料的许可要过门禁，不允许传染性许可进入产物。
samples.reference: Evaluation corpora must pass the license gate; no copyleft licence may enter the artefacts.
samples.hypothesis: Permission to evaluate the material is granted only after closure, and no contagious permits are allowed to enter the product.

samples.source: 子领域分组的边界要写进配置，不能靠人记住行号。
samples.reference: Record sub-domain group boundaries in config, not in someone's memory of line numbers.
samples.hypothesis: The boundaries of the subdomain clusters are written into the configuration and cannot be memorized.

samples.source: 自动分数的绝对值不适合作承诺，相对差与人工判断才可靠。
samples.reference: Absolute automatic scores make poor promises; relative deltas plus human review hold.
samples.hypothesis: Absolute values of automatic scores are not suitable for cooperation commitments, and relative differences with manual judgments are only reliable.

samples.source: 抽样规模不足时报告要拒绝判定，而不是给出乐观数字。
samples.reference: Refuse to conclude under an insufficient sample rather than printing an optimistic number.
samples.hypothesis: If the sample size is insufficient, the report should reject the conclusion, rather than give an optimistic figure.

samples.source: 评测脚本的失败要非零退出，静默通过会骗过后续流程。
samples.reference: Fail non-zero in evaluation scripts; a silent pass misleads everything downstream.
samples.hypothesis: Failure to evaluate a script is not a zero exit, and a silent pass will fool the following processes.

samples.source: 回归集扩样时旧行的顺序不可改动，否则历史数字不再可比。
samples.reference: Never reorder existing rows when growing a regression set, or past numbers stop being comparable.
samples.hypothesis: The order of the old rows cannot be changed when returning to the expanded set, otherwise the historical figures are no longer comparable.

samples.source: 指标口径变更要另立一次变更，不与数据扩充同批合入。
samples.reference: Land a metric-definition change in its own commit, not together with corpus growth.
samples.hypothesis: Changes to the indicator ' s scope are made on a separate basis and are not merged with the data expansion batch.

samples.source: 评测环境要有前置声明，宿主服务在跑与否会改变结论。
samples.reference: State the evaluation environment up front; whether a host service is running changes the conclusion.
samples.hypothesis: The test environment must have a pre-statement that whether or not the host service is running will change the conclusion.

samples.source: 人工评测的标注规范要先写，事后统一会引入回看偏差。
samples.reference: Write the annotation guideline before human review, or hindsight biases the labels.
samples.hypothesis: Marking standards for manual evaluation have to be written first, and subsequent harmonization will introduce retrospective deviations.

samples.source: 对照组与实验组必须同机同版本，跨机对比不成立。
samples.reference: Control and treatment need the same machine and build; cross-machine comparison is void.
samples.hypothesis: The control group and the experimental group must have the same version on the same machine, and cross-machine comparisons are not possible.

samples.source: 指标下降要先排除测量层，再怀疑模型能力。
samples.reference: Rule out the measurement layer before blaming the model when a metric drops.
samples.hypothesis: A decline in the indicator would first exclude the measurement layer and then cast doubt on the model ' s ability.

samples.source: 可复现要求包含数据、脚本、时间与环境四项，缺一即不成立。
samples.reference: Reproducibility needs data, script, timestamp and environment; one missing voids it.
samples.hypothesis: The reproducibility requirement consists of four elements: data, script, time and environment.

samples.source: 评测结果入库前要校验自描述字段，缺身份的证据不可引用。
samples.reference: Verify self-describing fields before storing evidence; anonymous artefacts cannot be cited.
samples.hypothesis: The results of the evaluation are checked against the description field before they are stored, and evidence that lacks identity cannot be cited.

samples.source: 统计区间要同时报置信区间与样本量，只报均值没有意义。
samples.reference: Report the confidence interval with the sample size; a bare mean carries no information.
samples.hypothesis: The statistical intervals must be reported in conjunction with the confidence intervals and the sample size, and the mean alone does not make sense.

samples.source: 边界样本要专挑易歧义词，随机抽样测不出领域敏感度。
samples.reference: Build boundary probes around ambiguous words; random sampling cannot measure domain sensitivity.
samples.hypothesis: The boundary sample is selected for ambiguous terms, and random sampling does not measure the sensitivity of the domain.

samples.source: 涉密项目的批量本地化通常要现场部署，遥测与外呼都要能整体关闭。
samples.reference: Classified batch localization normally runs on site, with telemetry and any outbound call closeable as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: Bulk localization of sensitive projects typically requires on-site deployment, with both telemetry and call-out being completely shut down.

samples.source: 离线整合包交付时模型与词表都不能靠运行时下载。
samples.reference: In an offline delivery bundle, neither models nor vocabularies may rely on runtime downloads.
samples.hypothesis: When an offline integration package is delivered, neither the model nor the glossary can be downloaded at runtime.

samples.source: 隐私模式关闭的是升级通路，而不是把原文送去云端处理。
samples.reference: Privacy mode closes the upgrade path rather than sending source text to the cloud.
samples.hypothesis: Privacy mode turns off the upgrade path instead of sending the original text to the cloud for processing.

samples.source: 日志里不得出现原文片段，用户素材本身就是敏感内容。
samples.reference: Logs must not carry source fragments; the user's material is itself sensitive.
samples.hypothesis: The original text must not appear in the log, and the user material itself is sensitive.

samples.source: 导出文件时要检查元数据，轨道名与作者字段常会带上项目信息。
samples.reference: Check metadata on export: track titles and author fields often leak project names.
samples.hypothesis: The metadata is checked when exporting the file, and the track name and author fields often contain project information.

samples.source: 审计记录只保留决策依据，不保留被翻译的正文。
samples.reference: Audit records keep the basis of a decision, never the translated text.
samples.hypothesis: The audit records retain only the basis for decision-making, not the translated text.

samples.source: 本地化产物交给第三方前，要确认术语表里没有内部代号。
samples.reference: Before handing deliverables to a third party, confirm the glossary holds no internal codenames.
samples.hypothesis: Confirm that there is no internal code in the glossary before handing over local chemicals to a third party.

samples.source: 禁用联网要能在配置层整体生效，而不是逐条网络调用点拦截。
samples.reference: Cutting network access has to work as one configuration switch, not per call site.
samples.hypothesis: Disable networking should be effective on the configuration layer as a whole, rather than blocking network callpoints on a line by line basis.

samples.source: 用户清空记忆库要连带清除派生的术语条目，否则残留仍会回显。
samples.reference: Clearing the translation memory must also clear term rows derived from it, or they keep resurfacing.
samples.hypothesis: Users must clear the memory with the deletion of the derived terminology entries, otherwise the residues will still be reflected.

samples.source: 现场部署的机器没有外网，安装介质要自带全部依赖与校验和。
samples.reference: A site machine has no outbound access, so the media must carry every dependency and its checksum.
samples.hypothesis: Machines deployed on site do not have an extranet, and the installation media must carry all dependencies and validation.

samples.source: 版本回滚要能连带回滚术语表与记忆库结构，避免旧版读坏新格式。
samples.reference: A rollback must cover the glossary and memory schema, or an old build misreads a new format.
samples.hypothesis: Version rollback should be linked to the rollback glossary and memory structure to avoid the old version reading the new format badly.

samples.source: 许可审计要覆盖运行时才出现的依赖声明，不只是构建清单里的。
samples.reference: The licence audit must cover dependencies that appear only at runtime, not just the build manifest.
samples.hypothesis: The license audit covers dependency statements that arise during operation, not just those in the build list.

samples.source: 敏感素材要按项目隔离记忆库，避免跨项目串味。
samples.reference: Keep separate memory stores per project for sensitive material, to avoid cross-project bleed.
samples.hypothesis: Sensitive material is segregated by project to avoid cross-project interference.

samples.source: 诊断接口在隐私模式下也要可用，它自身不得发出网络请求。
samples.reference: The diagnostics endpoint must stay available under privacy mode and issue no requests itself.
samples.hypothesis: The diagnostic interface should also be available in privacy mode and should not itself make network requests.

samples.source: 禁用云引擎后仍要如实说明结果来自本地，不让人误以为已升级。
samples.reference: After disabling cloud engines, still state plainly that the result is local rather than implying an upgrade.
samples.hypothesis: The disablement of the cloud engine should still be accompanied by a truthful statement that the results were on-premises, so as not to give the wrong impression that they had been upgraded.

samples.source: 现场排障的日志级别要能临时提升并自动回落，避免长期输出细节。
samples.reference: On-site log levels should be raised temporarily and revert, rather than emitting detail forever.
samples.hypothesis: The log level for on-site troubleshooting needs to be temporarily raised and automatically lowered to avoid long-term output details.

samples.source: 交付前的检查清单要包含字体、编码与语言代码三项一致性。
samples.reference: A pre-delivery checklist must cover consistency of font, encoding and language code.
samples.hypothesis: The pre-delivery checklist includes font, encoding and language code consistency.

samples.source: 批量任务的中断与续跑按片段记录进度，不保留原文正文。
samples.reference: Record resume progress per segment for batch jobs, without keeping the source text.
samples.hypothesis: Interruptions and resumes of batch tasks record the progress in fragments, without retaining the original text.

samples.source: 访问控制未实现前，对外服务面必须保持为本机回环。
samples.reference: Until access control exists, the exposed service surface must stay loopback-only.
samples.hypothesis: Until access control is implemented, the external service face must remain a native loop.

samples.source: 术语表按领域发布时不得携带用户私有条目。
samples.reference: A published domain glossary must not carry a user's private rows.
samples.hypothesis: Glossaries should not be published by domain with private user entries.

samples.source: 导出包要能出具内容清单，供客户方核对是否含敏感字段。
samples.reference: Export bundles should ship a manifest so the customer can check for sensitive fields.
samples.hypothesis: The export package should be able to provide a list of contents for the client to check for sensitive fields.

samples.source: 遥测默认关闭比默认开启加开关更安全，误操作的成本不对称。
samples.reference: Telemetry off by default is safer than on by default with a switch; the cost of a mistake is asymmetric.
samples.hypothesis: A remotely controlled default off is safer than a default on plus switch, and the cost of mishandling is asymmetric.

samples.source: 文档示例要用合成素材，不能直接粘贴客户真实稿件。
samples.reference: Use synthetic material in docs, never a client's real transcript.
samples.hypothesis: Document samples are made of synthetic material and cannot be directly pasted onto the client ' s actual draft.

samples.source: 密钥与访问令牌不写入仓库，包括测试用的假值。
samples.reference: Keep keys and tokens out of the repository, including fake ones used in tests.
samples.hypothesis: Keys and access tokens are not written to the store, including false values for testing.

samples.source: 清除数据要给出可核对的完成回执，而不是静默返回成功。
samples.reference: Clearing data must return a verifiable receipt rather than a bare success.
samples.hypothesis: Clearing data should give a verifiable confirmation of completion, rather than a silent return of success.

samples.source: 离线环境的模型获取要能校验来源，避免下载链路成为攻击面。
samples.reference: Verify model provenance in offline environments, so the download path does not become the attack surface.
samples.hypothesis: Model acquisition in an offline environment should be able to validate the source and avoid download links as an attack surface.

samples.source: 合规检查里最容易被忽略的是导出文件的元数据字段。
samples.reference: The metadata fields of exported files are the most overlooked compliance item.
samples.hypothesis: The metadata fields of the exported file are the ones that are most easily overlooked in compliance checks.

samples.source: 客户现场的问题复现要用最小样本，避免整批素材外流。
samples.reference: Reproduce field issues with a minimal sample, so a whole batch never leaves the site.
samples.hypothesis: Problems on the client site are reproduced with the smallest samples possible to avoid the loss of entire lots of material.

samples.source: 权限分级未实现前，共享终端上的记忆库要按目录隔离。
samples.reference: Until roles exist, isolate memory stores by directory on shared terminals.
samples.hypothesis: Until permission hierarchy is implemented, the storage on the shared terminal is isolated by directory.

samples.source: 审计日志的保留期要与交付合同一致，不默认长期保存。
samples.reference: Align audit retention with the delivery contract instead of keeping records by default.
samples.hypothesis: The retention period of the audit log is aligned with the delivery contract and does not default to permanent retention.

samples.source: 删除操作的语义要区分逻辑标记与物理清除，两者不可混写。
samples.reference: Separate logical flagging from physical erasure in delete operations.
samples.hypothesis: The semantics of deletion operations distinguish between logical marking and physical deletion, which cannot be confused.

samples.source: 敏感域的评测样本不能出现在公开基准里。
samples.reference: Sensitive-domain evaluation samples cannot appear in a public benchmark.
samples.hypothesis: Test samples of sensitive domains cannot appear in the public benchmark.

samples.source: 交付前要把用户数据目录从打包产物中排除并复核。
samples.reference: Exclude and re-check the user data directory from packaged artefacts before delivery.
samples.hypothesis: User data catalogs are excluded from the packaged output and reviewed prior to delivery.

samples.source: 本地化项目交接时，术语表与记忆库要分别签署授权范围。
samples.reference: On project handover, sign the scope for the glossary and the memory store separately.
samples.hypothesis: The terms of reference for the glossary and the memory are signed separately when the localization project is handed over.

samples.source: 隐私不变量由测试锁死比由文档承诺更可靠。
samples.reference: Privacy invariants held by a test are worth more than privacy promises in a document.
samples.hypothesis: Privacy invariants are more reliable when locked by testing than when promised by documentation.

samples.source: 被禁用的功能要在界面上明说被禁用，而不是隐藏入口。
samples.reference: Disable a feature visibly, rather than hiding its entry point.
samples.hypothesis: The disabled functionality should be explicitly disabled on the interface, not hidden.

samples.source: 客户环境的网络代理会改变探测结论，检查要区分不可达与未配置。
samples.reference: A customer's proxy changes probe results, so separate unreachable from unconfigured.
samples.hypothesis: The network agent in the client environment changes the discovery findings, checking to distinguish between unreachable and unconfigured.

samples.source: 默认配置要选保守的一档，把放开选项写进需要显式操作的地方。
samples.reference: Ship the conservative default and require an explicit action to loosen it.
samples.hypothesis: The default configuration is a conservative one, writing the release option where explicit action is required.

samples.source: 导出失败时不要把部分文件留在目标目录，先写临时再改名。
samples.reference: Leave no partial file behind on export failure: write to a staging name then rename.
samples.hypothesis: If the export fails, do not leave part of the file in the target directory, write it temporarily before renaming it.

samples.source: 临时文件的名称必须唯一，固定名在并发下会互相删错。
samples.reference: Staging names must be unique; a fixed one deletes the wrong file under concurrency.
samples.hypothesis: Provisional documents must have a unique title, and fixed titles may be mistakenly deleted when issued in parallel.

samples.source: 断网演练要覆盖首次安装，验证没有隐藏的外部请求。
samples.reference: Run a disconnected drill of first install to prove no hidden outbound requests exist.
samples.hypothesis: The shutdown exercise covers the initial installation and verifies that there are no hidden external requests.

samples.source: 模型文件的完整性校验要包含大小与摘要两项。
samples.reference: Integrity checking of model files should cover both size and digest.
samples.hypothesis: The completeness check of the model file includes the size and the summary.

samples.source: 现场版本升级要能只回滚配置而不丢用户已确认的术语。
samples.reference: A field upgrade must be able to roll back config alone, keeping confirmed terms.
samples.hypothesis: On-premise upgrades should only roll back configurations without losing terms that have been confirmed by the user.

samples.source: 可复核性要求日志能指出决策来自哪一层，而不是只给结果。
samples.reference: Logs must name the layer a decision came from, not just the outcome.
samples.hypothesis: Auditability requires logs to indicate the level from which decisions were made, not just the results.

samples.source: 数据出境受限时，云端引擎即便可达也不得进入路由。
samples.reference: When data may not leave the country, cloud engines stay out of routing even if reachable.
samples.hypothesis: When data exit is restricted, the cloud engine is not allowed to enter the routing, even if it is accessible.

samples.source: 交付包的哈希与版本号一起记录，便于追溯现场实际装了什么。
samples.reference: Record the delivery package's digest with its version to trace what was installed.
samples.hypothesis: The hash of the delivery package is recorded along with the version number, making it easy to trace what is actually installed on site.

samples.source: 删除记忆库后术语表仍可能被蒸馏回填，要能关闭该通路。
samples.reference: After clearing the memory, term harvesting can still refill it, so allow closing that path.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary may still be distilled after the memory has been deleted to close the loop.

samples.source: 用户确认过的条目要能标注为不可再分发。
samples.reference: Rows a user confirmed can be marked non-redistributable.
samples.hypothesis: User-confirmed entries must be marked as non-redistributable.

samples.source: 内部构建产物要能整体签名，安全策略才会放行加载。
samples.reference: Internal build artefacts need full signing, or platform security blocks loading.
samples.hypothesis: The internal build product must be fully signed before the security policy is released for loading.

samples.source: 评估一份交付风险要看数据流向而不是看功能数量。
samples.reference: Judge delivery risk by where data flows, not by how many features exist.
samples.hypothesis: Assess the risk of a delivery by looking at the flow of data rather than the number of features.

samples.source: 交付离线整合包时要一次带上引擎、模型、词表与校验清单。
samples.reference: An offline bundle ships the engine, models, vocabularies and a checksum manifest together.
samples.hypothesis: The engine, model, glossary and checklist are delivered with the offline integration package at once.

samples.source: 安装包要能在无管理员权限下装到用户目录。
samples.reference: The installer must work into a user directory without elevation.
samples.hypothesis: The installation package must be able to be installed in the user directory without administrator privileges.

samples.source: 构建产物全部签名，否则系统的应用控制会拦截本地加载。
samples.reference: Sign every build artefact, or platform application control blocks local loading.
samples.hypothesis: Build products must be fully signed, otherwise the system's application controls will block local loading.

samples.source: 安装路径含非拉丁字符时，动态库加载要能正确解析。
samples.reference: Handle non-Latin characters in the install path when loading the native library.
samples.hypothesis: If the installation path contains non-Latin characters, the dynamic library load must be parsed correctly.

samples.source: 升级安装要保留用户数据目录，并迁移其结构版本。
samples.reference: An upgrade keeps the user data directory and migrates its schema version.
samples.hypothesis: The upgrade installation would preserve the user data directory and migrate its structured version.

samples.source: 卸载时数据目录的处置要显式询问，不默认删除。
samples.reference: Ask what to do with the data directory on uninstall; never delete by default.
samples.hypothesis: The data directory is explicitly prompted for disposal on uninstallation and is not deleted by default.

samples.source: 打包脚本要列出被收录的二进制清单，避免漏签与漏装。
samples.reference: The packaging step should enumerate included binaries, so nothing is unsigned or missing.
samples.hypothesis: The packaging script must list the binary list that will be included, avoiding missing tags and missing loads.

samples.source: 绿色版与安装版共用同一份配置解析规则，避免行为分叉。
samples.reference: Keep one config resolution rule across portable and installed forms, or behaviour forks.
samples.hypothesis: The green version shares the same configuration parsing rules as the install version, avoiding behavioral forks.

samples.source: 运行时依赖版本要锁定，浮动的次版本会改变推理结果。
samples.reference: Pin runtime dependency versions; a floating minor version can change inference output.
samples.hypothesis: Dependency versions are locked during execution, and floating subversions change the inference results.

samples.source: 构建机与开发机不一致时，以可复现的干净环境为准。
samples.reference: When build and dev machines differ, the clean reproducible one is authoritative.
samples.hypothesis: In case of inconsistency between the build engine and the developer engine, the reproducible clean environment prevails.

samples.source: 交付清单要写清哪些模型需另行获取，避免装机后才发现缺件。
samples.reference: State which models must be fetched separately, so a gap is not found after installation.
samples.hypothesis: Delivery lists should specify which models are to be acquired separately to avoid missing parts being discovered after installation.

samples.source: 打包体积增长要能归因到具体新增项，别只报总大小。
samples.reference: Attribute growth in package size to a specific addition, rather than reporting a total.
samples.hypothesis: Increases in packaging volume should be attributable to specific additions rather than to the total size.

samples.source: 安装后自检要覆盖动态库加载与模型可读两项。
samples.reference: A post-install self-check must cover loading the native library and reading a model.
samples.hypothesis: After installation, the self-check will override both dynamic library loading and model readability.

samples.source: 现场无外网时，更新机制要支持离线补丁包。
samples.reference: With no outbound access, the update path must accept an offline patch package.
samples.hypothesis: The update mechanism supports offline patch packages when there is no on-site extranet.

samples.source: 配置热更新未实现前，改配置要能在文档里指明需重启哪一层。
samples.reference: Until hot reload exists, document which layer a config change restarts.
samples.hypothesis: Until hot-update configuration is implemented, the configuration must specify in the documentation which layer to restart.

samples.source: 崩溃报告默认不收集正文，只收集调用位置与版本。
samples.reference: Crash reports collect location and version by default, never the text.
samples.hypothesis: By default, crash reports do not collect the body, only the call location and version.

samples.source: 打包时排除缓存目录，避免把开发机的记忆库一起发出去。
samples.reference: Exclude cache directories when packaging, so a developer's memory store is never shipped.
samples.hypothesis: Cache directories are excluded from packaging to avoid releasing the developer's memory library with the package.

samples.source: 双平台各配一个薄壳入口，逻辑只放在脚本主体里。
samples.reference: Keep one thin launcher per OS and put the logic in the shared script.
samples.hypothesis: Both platforms have a thin shell entry, and the logic is only in the script body.

samples.source: 构建脚本要能只跳过已完成且哈希未变的阶段。
samples.reference: The build script must skip a stage whose inputs are unchanged by digest.
samples.hypothesis: The build script should only be able to skip the phases that are completed and the hash is unchanged.

samples.source: 干净构建要能一条命令复现，避免依赖历史产物。
samples.reference: A clean build must be reproducible with one command, without relying on prior artefacts.
samples.hypothesis: Clean construction requires the ability to replicate a command, avoiding reliance on historical products.

samples.source: 版本信息要在界面与诊断接口一致显示。
samples.reference: Show the same version string in the UI and in diagnostics.
samples.hypothesis: The version information should be displayed in the interface consistent with the diagnostic interface.

samples.source: 交付物要包含许可矩阵，覆盖随包分发的一切第三方成分。
samples.reference: Ship a licence matrix covering every third-party component in the package.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery will include a licensing matrix covering all third-party components distributed with the package.

samples.source: 模型文件过大时按语言对拆分下载，避免首装全量拉取。
samples.reference: Split model downloads per language pair so a first install fetches nothing wholesale.
samples.hypothesis: If the model file is too large, it is downloaded by language pair to avoid the initial full download.

samples.source: 装机脚本要幂等，重复执行不产生第二份配置。
samples.reference: Keep install scripting idempotent; running it twice must not create a second config.
samples.hypothesis: Installation scripts are parietal, and repeated execution does not produce a second configuration.
