samples.source: 安装失败要留下可读的原因文件，而不是只有弹窗。
samples.reference: On failure leave a readable reason file, not just a dialog.
samples.hypothesis: Failed installations should leave a readable reason file, not just a pop-up.

samples.source: 现场排障优先加诊断输出，而不是先改代码复现。
samples.reference: Prefer extra diagnostics when debugging in the field, rather than editing code to reproduce it.
samples.hypothesis: Field troubleshooting prioritizes the addition of diagnostic outputs, rather than first changing the code to replicate.

samples.source: 打包链路的每一步产物都要有校验和，避免半传文件进入安装。
samples.reference: Checksum every stage of the packaging chain so a truncated file never reaches an installer.
samples.hypothesis: Each step of the packaging link must have a checksum to avoid half-packed files entering the installation.

samples.source: 交付版本与仓库提交要能一一对应，便于事后追溯。
samples.reference: Map each delivered version to a repository commit for later tracing.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery version must correspond exactly to the warehouse submission for retrospective traceability.

samples.source: 默认数据目录的解析规则要在各语言绑定之间保持一致。
samples.reference: Keep the default data-directory rule identical across bindings.
samples.hypothesis: The parsing rules for the default data directory must be consistent across language bindings.

samples.source: 跨机器复现问题需要同时给出版本、配置与模型清单。
samples.reference: Reproducing an issue across machines needs version, config and a model inventory.
samples.hypothesis: Cross-machine reproduction issues require listing versions, configurations, and models at the same time.

samples.source: 安装介质要校验自身完整性再开始复制文件。
samples.reference: Verify installer integrity before copying any file.
samples.hypothesis: The installation media must verify its own integrity before starting to copy the files.

samples.source: 交付时把复现命令一起写进说明，客户才能自己重跑。
samples.reference: Include the reproduction command so a customer can rerun measurements alone.
samples.hypothesis: When delivered, the reset command is written into the instructions so that the customer can rerun it himself.

samples.source: 打包要区分开发构建与发布构建的产物路径。
samples.reference: Separate development and release output paths in packaging.
samples.hypothesis: Packaging distinguishes the product path for developing builds from the product path for deploying builds.

samples.source: 无网络环境下要能只装文档与工具而不装模型。
samples.reference: Allow installing docs and tools without models where there is no network.
samples.hypothesis: In a non-network environment, only the documentation and tools should be loaded, not the model.

samples.source: 包内脚本文本模式写入会带平台换行，按字节写更稳。
samples.reference: Write packaged scripts byte-wise; text mode sneaks platform line endings in.
samples.hypothesis: Packaged script text mode will be written with platform breaks, byte by byte, more stable.

samples.source: 发布构建要能在流水线里复现同一哈希，否则版本不可信。
samples.reference: A release build must be reproducible to the same hash in CI, or a version number means little.
samples.hypothesis: Release builds must be able to replicate the same hash in the pipeline, otherwise the version is unreliable.

samples.source: 装机后的首次启动体验要有明确路径，避免用户停在空白界面。
samples.reference: The first launch after install needs a guided path, not an empty window.
samples.hypothesis: The first boot experience after installation should have a clear path to avoid stopping the user in an empty interface.

samples.source: 安装包的版本号要与运行时自检报出的版本一致。
samples.reference: Keep the installer's version equal to what the runtime self-check reports.
samples.hypothesis: The version number of the installation package must match the version checked out during runtime.

samples.source: 依赖锁定文件要随包发布，便于现场复核。
samples.reference: Ship the lockfile with the package so a site can re-check dependencies.
samples.hypothesis: Dependency locking documents are issued with packages to facilitate on-site review.

samples.source: 构建产物目录要与源码目录分离，避免误提交二进制。
samples.reference: Keep build output separate from sources so binaries never get committed.
samples.hypothesis: Build product directories separately from source code directories to avoid incorrect binary submissions.

samples.source: 现场升级前先备份数据目录，失败时能整目录还原。
samples.reference: Back up the data directory before a field upgrade so a failure restores wholesale.
samples.hypothesis: Data catalogs are backed up prior to on-site upgrades so that the entire catalog can be restored in case of failure.

samples.source: 打包时剔除测试夹具与开发脚本，减少体积与误用面。
samples.reference: Strip test fixtures and dev scripts from packaging, cutting size and misuse.
samples.hypothesis: Packages eliminate test clamps and development scripts, reducing volume and misuse.

samples.source: 交付文档里的命令要与实际入口一致，避免过期写法。
samples.reference: Keep commands in delivered docs matching real entry points, or they rot.
samples.hypothesis: The orders in the delivery document should be consistent with the actual entry, avoiding outdated writing.

samples.source: 构建脚本失败要非零退出并指明失败阶段。
samples.reference: A failing build step must exit non-zero and name the stage.
samples.hypothesis: Failure to build the script should result in a non-zero exit and indicate the failure phase.

samples.source: 发布说明要写清哪些行为变化会影响既有指标的对比。
samples.reference: Release notes must state which behaviour changes break comparison with prior metrics.
samples.hypothesis: The release notes should specify which behavioural changes would affect the comparability of existing indicators.

samples.source: 安装介质体积上限由首装网络条件决定，而不是由功能数量决定。
samples.reference: Package size is bounded by first-install network conditions, not by feature count.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum volume of installation media is determined by the initially installed network conditions rather than by the number of functions.

samples.source: 现场环境差异要靠诊断接口回读，而不是靠聊天记录推断。
samples.reference: Read field differences back through diagnostics instead of inferring them from chat.
samples.hypothesis: Differences in the field environment are read back from the diagnostic interface rather than inferred from the chat logs.

samples.source: 交付物要能在目标机上离线验证哈希一致。
samples.reference: Artefacts must be verifiable offline on the target machine.
samples.hypothesis: The deliverable must be able to verify hash consistency offline on the target machine.

samples.source: 打包链路要能只重建受影响的部分，缩短反馈。
samples.reference: Rebuild only what a change affects, to keep packaging feedback short.
samples.hypothesis: Packaged links should be able to reconstruct only the affected parts and shorten the feedback.

samples.source: 版本兼容承诺要写明弃用窗口长度，便于客户排期。
samples.reference: State the deprecation window in compatibility promises so customers can plan.
samples.hypothesis: Version compatibility promises to specify the length of the depreciation window to facilitate customer scheduling.

samples.source: 发布构建的产物清单要包含每个文件的来源与许可。
samples.reference: A release manifest lists each file's provenance and licence.
samples.hypothesis: A list of published builds must include the source and license for each file.

samples.source: 装机脚本要检测缺依赖并给出具体的获取命令。
samples.reference: Detect missing dependencies at install and print the exact fetch command.
samples.hypothesis: The installation script detects missing dependencies and gives specific commands to get them.

samples.source: 现场没有包管理器时，依赖要能整体随包交付。
samples.reference: Ship dependencies whole where a site has no package manager.
samples.hypothesis: When there is no package manager on site, it is reliant on being able to deliver the whole package.

samples.source: 构建与发布分离，避免开发机凭据进入产物。
samples.reference: Separate building from publishing so developer credentials never enter artefacts.
samples.hypothesis: Build and release are separated to avoid developer credentials entering the product.

samples.source: 可复现构建要固定环境变量与路径归一化规则。
samples.reference: Fix environment variables and path normalization for reproducible builds.
samples.hypothesis: Replicable builds require fixed environment variables and path unification rules.

samples.source: 交付验收要包含一次干净机器安装，避免只在开发机可用。
samples.reference: Include one clean-machine install in acceptance, or it only works on a dev box.
samples.hypothesis: Delivery acceptance includes a clean machine installation to avoid only being available on the developer.

samples.source: 包内不要残留绝对路径默认值，否则他人环境不可复现。
samples.reference: Leave no absolute default paths inside a package, or another machine cannot reproduce.
samples.hypothesis: Do not leave an absolute path default within the package, otherwise the other person's environment will not be reproducible.

samples.source: 发布前跑一次全量门禁并把末行结果记进台账。
samples.reference: Run the full gate before release and record its last line in the ledger.
samples.hypothesis: Run a full lock once before publishing and record the end-of-row result in the account.

samples.source: 交付介质要能长期保存，校验和与包同存放。
samples.reference: Store the checksum beside the media so an archive stays verifiable years later.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery medium must be long-lasting, calibrated and stored with the package.

samples.source: 升级路径要覆盖从最旧交付版本到最新一跳的验证。
samples.reference: Test the upgrade path from the oldest delivered version in one hop.
samples.hypothesis: The upgrade path covers the validation of the jump from the oldest release to the latest.

samples.source: 现场回滚演练要在交付前做一次，别把第一次留给客户。
samples.reference: Practise the rollback before delivery; the first attempt should not be a customer's.
samples.hypothesis: On-site roll-back exercises should be done once before delivery, and not left to the customer for the first time.

samples.source: 打包时把第三方素材的许可文本一并装入目录。
samples.reference: Bundle third-party licence texts alongside the packaged material.
samples.hypothesis: Include the license text of the third-party material in the catalogue when you package it.

samples.source: 构建环境要固定工具链小版本，避免优化级差异影响性能数字。
samples.reference: Pin toolchain minor versions so optimisation differences do not move performance numbers.
samples.hypothesis: The build environment will fix the toolchain minor version to avoid optimization level differences affecting performance figures.

samples.source: 交付包要能单独校验某一个文件的完整性，便于定位损坏。
samples.reference: Allow verifying one file at a time, to localise corruption.
samples.hypothesis: Delivery packages should be able to check the integrity of a particular file individually, making it easier to locate damage.

samples.source: 安装后的自检输出要能复制给支持人员，含版本与路径摘要。
samples.reference: Make post-install self-check output copyable to support, with versions and path digests.
samples.hypothesis: The installed self-checkout output should be able to be copied to support staff, including version and path summary.

samples.source: 无网环境下的文档要随包离线可读。
samples.reference: Ship documentation readable offline for disconnected environments.
samples.hypothesis: Documents in a non-network environment will be readable offline with the package.

samples.source: 包内示例语料要确认可公开，避免带入客户素材。
samples.reference: Confirm sample corpora are public-safe, never client material.
samples.hypothesis: The sample language in the package should be confirmed to be public and avoid bringing in client material.

samples.source: 发布构建日志要归档，便于事后核对当时环境与结果。
samples.reference: Archive release build logs to reconstruct the environment and outcome later.
samples.hypothesis: Release build logs are archived to facilitate retrospective verification of the current environment and results.

samples.source: 交付版本要能回答某个功能在哪个版本引入。
samples.reference: A delivered version must answer which release introduced a feature.
samples.hypothesis: The release must be able to answer in which release a particular feature was introduced.

samples.source: 构建脚本的缓存目录要能指定到盘外，避免污染工作区。
samples.reference: Allow pointing the build cache outside the tree, to keep the working copy clean.
samples.hypothesis: The cache directory for the build script must be specified off-disk to avoid contaminating the workspace.

samples.source: 打包前的静态检查要拦住明显的界面与文案错误。
samples.reference: Run static checks before packaging to catch obvious UI and text faults.
samples.hypothesis: Static checks before packaging stop obvious interface and scripting errors.

samples.source: 装机脚本要在结束时打印已安装组件与版本一览。
samples.reference: Print the installed components and versions at the end of setup.
samples.hypothesis: The installation script should print a list of installed components and versions at the end.

samples.source: 现场依赖缺失时，安装器要能指出缺的那一个而不是整体失败。
samples.reference: Report the single missing dependency, rather than failing the whole install.
samples.hypothesis: When a site relies on a missing component, the installer must be able to point to the missing component rather than the failure as a whole.

samples.source: 交付物的可复现性以他人能跑通为准，而不是本机能跑通。
samples.reference: Reproducibility means someone else can run it, not that this machine can.
samples.hypothesis: The reproducibility of the deliverable is determined by the ability of others to run it, not by the ability of the machine to run it.

samples.source: 同一张显卡上并行跑推理与合成会互相争用，评测要分阶段进行。
samples.reference: Sharing one GPU between inference and synthesis starves both; measure them in separate phases.
samples.hypothesis: Parallel reasoning and synthesis will compete on the same graphics card, and the evaluation will be done in stages.

samples.source: 显存占用达到临界时系统会开始用内存换页，延迟随之出现长尾。
samples.reference: Near the memory ceiling the system starts paging, and latency grows a long tail.
samples.hypothesis: When display memory usage reaches a critical level, the system begins to page with memory, and the delay becomes long.

samples.source: 热降频会让同一模型在连续负载后段变慢，短测看不出这一影响。
samples.reference: Thermal throttling slows the same model late in a sustained load, which a short test will miss.
samples.hypothesis: Thermal deceleration slows down the same model in the post-continuous load segment, and this effect is not visible in short-term measurements.

samples.source: 笔记本在电池供电时的功耗墙会改变吞吐，性能数字要注明供电状态。
samples.reference: Battery power caps throughput on laptops, so note the power state next to any number.
samples.hypothesis: The power wall of the notebook will change throughput when powered by the battery, and the performance figures will indicate the power status.

samples.source: 批处理的吞吐提升要除以显存代价来看，否则只是用资源换时间。
samples.reference: Judge batch throughput against the memory it costs, or it is only buying time with resources.
samples.hypothesis: The throughput increases of batch processing are divided by the apparent cost, otherwise they are merely a time trade for resources.

samples.source: 磁盘读入模型的时间应计入首装等待，而不是被当成推理耗时。
samples.reference: Loading a model from disk belongs to first-start wait, not to inference time.
samples.hypothesis: The time spent reading the disk into the model should be counted as loading wait time, not as reasoning time.

samples.source: 同一份权重在不同优化级别下的输出可能不同，回归要固定构建。
samples.reference: The same weights can behave differently across optimisation levels, so pin the build for regressions.
samples.hypothesis: The output of the same weight may differ at different optimization levels, and returns are fixed.

samples.source: 采样噪声与真实性能变化靠重复测量区分，单次运行不足以判断。
samples.reference: Repeat a measurement to tell sampling noise from a real change; one run cannot decide.
samples.hypothesis: Sampling noise is distinguished from true performance changes by repeated measurements, and a single run is not sufficient to judge.

samples.source: 缓存命中率变化会同时影响延迟与成本，两者要一起看。
samples.reference: A shift in hit rate moves latency and cost together, so read them as a pair.
samples.hypothesis: Changes in cache hit rates affect both delays and costs, both of which must be considered in conjunction.

samples.source: 慢盘上的并发读写会让队列等待被误读成模型变慢。
samples.reference: On a slow disk, queueing under concurrent IO reads as a slower model.
samples.hypothesis: Simultaneous read-write on the slow disk slows down the queue waiting to be misread into the model.

samples.source: 性能回归要给出分布而不是均值，长尾正是用户体感所在。
samples.reference: Report a distribution for a regression, not a mean; the tail is where the experience lives.
samples.hypothesis: Performance returns give distributions rather than mean values, and the long tail is what the user feels.

samples.source: 量化后的精度损失要用任务指标衡量，而不是只看权重误差。
samples.reference: Judge quantisation loss on task metrics, not on weight error alone.
samples.hypothesis: Quantified loss of accuracy should be measured using mission indicators rather than weighting errors alone.

samples.source: 多核扩展在队列同步点上会停下来，加速曲线不是线性的。
samples.reference: Multi-core scaling stalls at queue synchronisation points, so the speedup curve is not linear.
samples.hypothesis: Multi-core expansion stops at the queue synchronization point, and the acceleration curve is not linear.

samples.source: 首次请求包含惰性初始化，冷启动时间要单独列出。
samples.reference: The first request carries lazy initialisation, so report cold start separately.
samples.hypothesis: The first request includes inertial initialization, and the cold start time is listed separately.

samples.source: 长时间运行后的内存增长要区分缓存驻留与真实泄露。
samples.reference: Distinguish cache residency from a real leak when memory grows over time.
samples.hypothesis: Memory growth after long runs distinguishes between cache residence and real leakage.

samples.source: 换页与内存回收会在采样窗口里制造毛刺，需要复采确认。
samples.reference: Paging and garbage collection create spikes, so confirm with a repeat sample.
samples.hypothesis: Page-shifting and memory retrieval will create spikes in the sampling window that require re-sampling confirmation.

samples.source: 同一批任务在不同顺序下耗时不同，基准要固定输入顺序。
samples.reference: The same workload takes different times in different orders, so fix input order in a benchmark.
samples.hypothesis: The same batch of tasks takes different amounts of time in different sequences, and the baseline sets the input sequence.

samples.source: 性能承诺要绑定运行环境说明，包括芯片、供电与并发规模。
samples.reference: Attach the environment to any performance promise: chip, power state and concurrency.
samples.hypothesis: The performance commitment binds the operating environment description, including the chip, power supply and concurrence scale.

samples.source: 推理与预处理重叠时，单段耗时会小于两段之和，别误判成加速。
samples.reference: Overlapping inference with pre-processing makes a segment look shorter than the sum, not faster.
samples.hypothesis: When reasoning and preprocessing overlap, a single paragraph takes less time than the sum of the two paragraphs, which should not be mistaken for acceleration.

samples.source: 一个更小的模型在延迟敏感场景可能胜过更大的模型，质量差要看任务。
samples.reference: A smaller model can beat a larger one where latency matters; check the quality cost per task.
samples.hypothesis: A smaller model may be better than a larger model in delayed-sensitive scenarios, with lower quality depending on the task.

samples.source: 缓存预取要按语料重复度决定，随机输入下预取只是额外开销。
samples.reference: Size cache prefetch to corpus repetition; on random input prefetch is pure overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Cache pre-loading is determined by the repetition of the language, and pre-loading under random input is an additional cost.

samples.source: 并发解码不上调吞吐时，说明瓶颈在算力而不是调度。
samples.reference: If concurrent decoding does not raise throughput, the bottleneck is compute rather than scheduling.
samples.hypothesis: When the decoder does not increase throughput, the bottleneck is in computing rather than scheduling.

samples.source: 负载上升时先退化的是尾延迟而不是中位数，指标要成对看。
samples.reference: Under rising load the tail degrades before the median, so read the pair together.
samples.hypothesis: It is the tail delay, not the median, that degrades first when the load increases, and the indicators must be matched.

samples.source: 把等待时间与处理时间混在一个指标里会掩盖排队积压。
samples.reference: Mixing waiting and processing into one metric hides queue build-up.
samples.hypothesis: Mixing waiting time and processing time in one metric masks backlogs.

samples.source: 评测用的机器要与交付目标同档，否则数字没有参考价值。
samples.reference: Benchmark on hardware in the delivered class, or the numbers mean nothing.
samples.hypothesis: The machine to be evaluated must be in the same file as the delivery target, otherwise the figures have no reference value.

samples.source: 内存上限保护比更大的缓存更能保证长时间运行不崩。
samples.reference: A memory ceiling protects a long run better than a larger cache does.
samples.hypothesis: Memory cap protection is better than larger cache to ensure long runtime.

samples.source: 多线程解码会增加上下文切换，小文本上反而更慢。
samples.reference: Threaded decoding adds context switches and is slower on short text.
samples.hypothesis: Multi-threaded decoding increases context switching, which is slower on small text.

samples.source: 硬件加速的收益在算子覆盖不全时会打折，需要实测。
samples.reference: Acceleration pays off only as far as operators are covered, so measure it.
samples.hypothesis: The gains of hardware acceleration are reduced when operator coverage is not complete and need to be tested.

samples.source: 性能基线要记录采集时间，跨日对比要留意后台任务干扰。
samples.reference: Stamp performance baselines with collection time; background jobs disturb day-to-day comparison.
samples.hypothesis: Performance baselines record capture time and cross-day comparisons take into account background task interference.

samples.source: 一个未接上的加速开关不该被写成功能收益。
samples.reference: An acceleration switch that is not wired up must not be reported as a gain.
samples.hypothesis: An unplugged accelerator switch should not be written as a function gain.

samples.source: 长文本按段送入会让总耗时上升，但峰值内存会明显下降。
samples.reference: Feeding long text segment by segment raises total time but lowers peak memory.
samples.hypothesis: Submitting long text by paragraph increases the total time taken, but peak memory is significantly reduced.

samples.source: 同一模型的量化版与全精度版要分开报指标。
samples.reference: Report quantised and full-precision variants of one model as separate rows.
samples.hypothesis: Indicators are reported separately for the quantified and full-precision versions of the same model.

samples.source: 评测环境里常驻服务会占用显存，测量前要先声明。
samples.reference: Note resident services holding memory before measuring; they change the result.
samples.hypothesis: Services that are permanently present in the evaluation environment will take up visible memory, and must be declared before measurement.

samples.source: 性能改善要与质量指标同批检查，避免只快不差的说法站不住。
samples.reference: Check performance and quality together, so "faster and equal" is defensible.
samples.hypothesis: Performance improvements need to be checked in tandem with quality indicators to avoid claims of " almost as good " .

samples.source: 队列积压告警要基于等待时间而不是队列长度。
samples.reference: Alert on queue age rather than queue depth, since depth alone is not user-visible harm.
samples.hypothesis: Queue backlog alerts are based on waiting time rather than queue length.

samples.source: 一个批次的总耗时不能简单除以条数当单次延迟。
samples.reference: Do not divide a batch's total by its count and call it single-request latency.
samples.hypothesis: The total time taken for a batch cannot simply be divided by the number of lines when there is a single delay.

samples.source: 首次装载与后续命中的延迟差要同时给出，避免只报好看的一档。
samples.reference: Give both cold-load and warm latency; reporting one flatters the number.
samples.hypothesis: The delay difference between the first loading and the subsequent ones should be given simultaneously to avoid reporting only the good ones.

samples.source: 设备驱动更新会改变算子实现，性能结论要注明驱动版本。
samples.reference: Driver updates change kernel behaviour, so record the driver version with a result.
samples.hypothesis: Device driver updates change the implementation of the operator, and performance conclusions specify the driver version.

samples.source: 并发上限的设定要以资源实测为据，而不是按核数猜测。
samples.reference: Set concurrency ceilings from measured resources, not from a core count.
samples.hypothesis: The setting of the concurrence ceiling should be based on empirical resources rather than on speculative nuclear numbers.

samples.source: 性能报表里区分吞吐与延迟两个目标，二者常相互拉扯。
samples.reference: Keep throughput and latency as two goals in reports; they pull apart.
samples.hypothesis: The performance statement distinguishes between throughput and latency targets, which are often in conflict with each other.

samples.source: 长任务的进度回报要能反映实际完成量，而不是固定节奏。
samples.reference: Progress for long jobs should reflect completed work, not a fixed tick.
samples.hypothesis: Progress rewards for long-term assignments should reflect actual accomplishment rather than a fixed pace.

samples.source: 一个指标的改善要能归因到具体变更，否则只是波动。
samples.reference: Attribute a metric's improvement to a specific change, or it is just noise.
samples.hypothesis: An improvement in an indicator must be attributable to a specific change, otherwise it is merely a fluctuation.

samples.source: 评测脚本自身的日志写入也会拖慢被测服务。
samples.reference: Log writing by the harness itself can slow the service under test.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation script's own logging also slows down the service being tested.

samples.source: 性能回归要设置可判定的阈值并允许噪声带。
samples.reference: Give a regression a decided threshold with a noise band around it.
samples.hypothesis: Performance returns to set judgeable thresholds and allow noise bands.

samples.source: 无加速硬件的机器也要能跑通，功能不应依赖特定算子。
samples.reference: Features must run on machines without accelerators, not on a specific kernel.
samples.hypothesis: Machines without hardware acceleration should also be able to run, and functionality should not depend on specific operators.

samples.source: 一个缓存的收益要按命中率与失效成本共同评估。
samples.reference: Judge a cache by hit rate and invalidation cost together.
samples.hypothesis: The benefits of a buffer are assessed in terms of hit rates combined with the cost of failure.

samples.source: 短任务被启动开销主导时，优化算法本身收效有限。
samples.reference: When start-up cost dominates short tasks, optimising the algorithm returns little.
samples.hypothesis: The optimization algorithms themselves are limited in their effectiveness when short-term tasks are initiated in a cost-dominated manner.

samples.source: 并发数从一到二的收益常小于从二到三，注意边际递减。
samples.reference: The gain from one to two concurrent workers is usually smaller than from two to three.
samples.hypothesis: The gains from adjacent numbers from one to two are often smaller than from two to three, noting the marginal decrease.

samples.source: 一个性能数字若不能重跑，就只能作为历史事实引用。
samples.reference: Cite an unreproducible performance number only as a historical fact.
samples.hypothesis: A performance figure that cannot be repeated can only be cited as a historical fact.

samples.source: 测量前确认没有其他负载在同一设备上运行。
samples.reference: Confirm nothing else is running on the device before measuring.
samples.hypothesis: Before measuring, verify that no other loads are running on the same device.

samples.source: 内存换页会让尾延迟出现分钟级尖峰，别当成模型退化。
samples.reference: Paging produces minute-scale spikes in tail latency; do not call it model decay.
samples.hypothesis: Memory pagination causes minute-scale tail delay peaks, and should not be treated as model degradation.

samples.source: 一个硬件相关开关未接通时，界面上的选项要如实标注。
samples.reference: Label a hardware switch honestly when it is not actually wired up.
samples.hypothesis: When a hardware-related switch is disabled, the option on the interface is marked as such.

samples.source: 性能测量要区分单次成本与摊销成本。
samples.reference: Separate per-item cost from amortised cost in performance measurement.
samples.hypothesis: Performance measurement distinguishes between unit costs and depreciation costs.

samples.source: 一个优化的收益若被额外等待吃掉，净效果为零。
samples.reference: An optimisation whose gain is eaten by extra waiting nets out to zero.
samples.hypothesis: If an optimized gain is waited for an additional time to be eaten up, the net effect is zero.

samples.source: 长时间运行的稳定性用退出码与错误计数衡量。
samples.reference: Measure long-run stability by exit codes and error counts, not by optimism.
samples.hypothesis: Long-term stability is measured by exit codes and error counts.

samples.source: 一个报告的结论要能指向同一台机器上的可复现数据。
samples.reference: A report's conclusion should point to data reproducible on the same machine.
samples.hypothesis: The conclusions of a report must point to reproducible data on the same machine.

samples.source: 性能与质量的取舍要写成产品决策而不是技术默认值。
samples.reference: Record performance-versus-quality choices as product decisions, not technical defaults.
samples.hypothesis: Performance and quality trade-offs should be written as product decisions rather than technical defaults.

samples.source: 模型推理的能耗在长时间批量任务里也会成为约束。
samples.reference: Energy becomes a constraint in long batch inference, not only in mobile use.
samples.hypothesis: The energy consumption of model reasoning can also be a constraint in long-term batch tasks.

samples.source: 一个未固定的构建会让两次测量结果不可比。
samples.reference: An unpinned build makes two measurements incomparable.
samples.hypothesis: A non-fixed construction makes two measurements not comparable.

samples.source: 把设备差异写进结论限定，比在正文里加免责声明有效。
samples.reference: Stating device scope inside a conclusion beats a disclaimer elsewhere.
samples.hypothesis: The inclusion of equipment differences in the conclusion limitation is more effective than adding a disclaimer in the body.

samples.source: 测量窗口要避开系统更新与索引重建的时间段。
samples.reference: Schedule measurement windows away from system updates and index rebuilds.
samples.hypothesis: The measurement window should avoid the period of time between system updates and index rebuilding.

samples.source: 一个加速路径的正确性要单独测，别只测它有多快。
samples.reference: Test an accelerated path for correctness separately from its speed.
samples.hypothesis: The correctness of an acceleration path is measured individually, not just how fast it is.

samples.source: 性能相关的缺陷要给出可复跑入口，便于回归验证。
samples.reference: A performance defect needs a re-runnable entry point for regression checks.
samples.hypothesis: Performance-related defects are given recursive inputs to facilitate return validation.

samples.source: 批量吞吐提升不等于单条延迟改善，两者分别验收。
samples.reference: Higher batch throughput is not lower per-item latency; accept them separately.
samples.hypothesis: Bulk throughput upgrades are not equal to single-line delay improvements, both of which are separately approved.

samples.source: 一个指标的抖动若大于版本差异，就不足以支撑结论。
samples.reference: When a metric's jitter exceeds the version difference, it cannot support a conclusion.
samples.hypothesis: If the fluctuation of an indicator is greater than the version difference, it is not sufficient to support a conclusion.

samples.source: 飞轮的前提是AI先做对一次，之后本地复用才省成本。
samples.reference: The flywheel assumes the AI got it right once, so local reuse is what saves afterwards.
samples.hypothesis: The premise of the hovercraft is that AI does it right once, and then local reuse saves costs.

samples.source: 蒸馏入库的阈值决定术语表信噪比，过松会污染后续所有请求。
samples.reference: The distillation threshold sets the glossary's signal-to-noise ratio; too loose pollutes every later request.
samples.hypothesis: The threshold of the distillation store determines the terminology signal-to-noise ratio, and too loose will contaminate all subsequent requests.

samples.source: 机器抽取的条目要能与人工确认的条目区分，复核才有效。
samples.reference: Machine-extracted rows must be distinguishable from human-confirmed ones, or review is pointless.
samples.hypothesis: The machine extracted entries must be distinguishable from the manually confirmed entries in order for the review to be effective.

samples.source: 同一术语在不同领域下允许不同译法，主键必须含领域。
samples.reference: One term may translate differently per domain, so the key must include the domain.
samples.hypothesis: The same term allows for different interpretations in different fields, and the primary key must include fields.

samples.source: 用户修改过的条目应优先于任何自动来源，且不被静默覆盖。
samples.reference: A user's edit outranks any automatic source and must not be silently overwritten.
samples.hypothesis: User-modified entries should take precedence over any automated sources and should not be silently overwritten.

samples.source: 术语表要能导出复核，且导出不带用户私有条目。
samples.reference: A glossary must be exportable for review, without the user's private rows.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary should be able to export revisions and export private entries without users.

samples.source: 蒸馏产出的碎片化条目要靠源侧语言校验拦住。
samples.reference: Fragmented distillation output has to be stopped by a source-language check.
samples.hypothesis: Fragmented entries in the distillation output are stopped by source-side language proofing.

samples.source: 飞轮收益要靠命中率与质量同时验证，只看其一会误判。
samples.reference: Validate the flywheel with both hit rate and quality; either alone misleads.
samples.hypothesis: The gains of the hovercraft are verified by both the hit rate and the quality, only by the occasional error of judgment.

samples.source: 一次误译被记忆固化后会被反复复用，标坏机制要可用。
samples.reference: A mistranslation stored in memory is reused forever, so the bad-mark path must work.
samples.hypothesis: Once a mistranslation is memorized, it is repeatedly used, and the bad tag mechanism is available.

samples.source: 术语表的规模不等于注入规模，能进上下文的那部分才是效果。
samples.reference: Glossary size is not injection size; only the rows reaching context have effect.
samples.hypothesis: The size of the glossary is not equal to the size of the injection, and it is the part that fits into context that is effective.

samples.source: 注入窗口按置信度排序时，平局必须有确定序，否则不可复现。
samples.reference: When the injection window sorts by confidence, ties need a deterministic order, or runs are irreproducible.
samples.hypothesis: When the injection window is sorted by confidence, the tie must be in a definite order, otherwise it cannot be reproduced.

samples.source: 一条术语是否生效，要靠响应字段回读而不是靠猜测。
samples.reference: Read back whether a term applied from the response, do not guess it.
samples.hypothesis: Whether or not a term is in effect depends on the response field, not on guesswork.

samples.source: 蒸馏回灌的条目要能整体关闭，便于隔离问题。
samples.reference: Returned distillation rows must be switchable off wholesale, to isolate faults.
samples.hypothesis: The distillation re-injection entry should be completely closed to facilitate segregation.

samples.source: 术语表变更要能被评测复跑反映，否则改了语义却看不见。
samples.reference: Glossary changes must surface in a re-run, or a semantic change stays invisible.
samples.hypothesis: Changes to the glossary must be reflected in the rerun of the evaluation, otherwise the semantic changes will not be visible.

samples.source: 一条错误术语的代价是它会被每个含该词的句子复用。
samples.reference: The cost of one wrong term is that every sentence containing it reuses it.
samples.hypothesis: The cost of a wrong term is that it is repeated in every sentence that contains it.

samples.source: 术语治理的核心是可追溯：来源、置信度与修改人要能区分。
samples.reference: Glossary governance is traceability: source, confidence and editor must be distinguishable.
samples.hypothesis: At the heart of terminology governance is traceability: the source, credibility and modifier must be distinguishable.

samples.source: 锁定与删除是两种不同保护，不能相互替代。
samples.reference: Locking and deleting are different protections and cannot substitute for each other.
samples.hypothesis: Blocking and deletion are two different types of protection and cannot be substituted for each other.

samples.source: 按语言对分别维护术语表，跨语言对复用会串味。
samples.reference: Maintain glossaries per language pair; reusing across pairs bleeds meaning.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary is maintained separately for each language pair, and cross-language duplication is inconvenient.

samples.source: 新领域包的收益要用同批句子对照测，不做跨批比较。
samples.reference: Test a new domain pack on the same sentences, never across batches.
samples.hypothesis: The benefits of the new area packages are measured against the same batch of sentences, without cross-batch comparisons.

samples.source: 人工复核过的条目要能标注来源批次，便于回退。
samples.reference: Reviewed rows should record which batch they came from, to allow reversal.
samples.hypothesis: Entries that have been reviewed manually should be marked with the source batch to facilitate return.

samples.source: 术语冲突要报出双方来源，而不是静默选一个。
samples.reference: Term conflicts must name both provenances rather than silently picking one.
samples.hypothesis: Conflicts of terminology require the disclosure of both sources, not the tacit choice of one.

samples.source: 蒸馏阈值调整后要重跑质量回归，否则信噪比未知。
samples.reference: Rerun the quality regression after changing the distillation threshold, or the ratio is unknown.
samples.hypothesis: After adjusting the distillation threshold, the mass return must be rerun, otherwise the signal-to-noise ratio is unknown.

samples.source: 一条术语的译文若含变量占位，需要显式转义规则。
samples.reference: Escape rules are needed when a term's translation contains a placeholder.
samples.hypothesis: The translation of a term with variable positioning requires explicit translational rules.

samples.source: 飞轮的收益上限由重复内容占比决定，不由模型决定。
samples.reference: The flywheel's ceiling is set by how repetitive the content is, not by the model.
samples.hypothesis: The upper limit of the hovercraft ' s earnings is determined by the proportion of duplicate content, not by the model.

samples.source: 术语表要能按领域整体替换，便于客户自带词表交付。
samples.reference: Allow replacing a whole domain glossary so a customer's own terms can ship.
samples.hypothesis: The glossaries should be interchangeable by field and should be delivered with the client ' s own glossary.

samples.source: 一次注入失败要区分引擎不支持与本次无命中。
samples.reference: Separate "engine cannot use terms" from "no term matched this sentence".
samples.hypothesis: A failed injection is to be distinguished from the engine not supporting and this time no hit.

samples.source: 统计口径要说清分母是全部行还是含术语的行。
samples.reference: State whether a denominator is all rows or only rows containing terms.
samples.hypothesis: The statistical gauge is to tell whether the denominator is the entire row or the row containing the term.

samples.source: 术语表与记忆库的更新要能分别回滚。
samples.reference: Roll back the glossary and the memory store independently.
samples.hypothesis: Updates to the glossary and the memory must be rolled back separately.

samples.source: 蒸馏的批处理窗口影响入库顺序，跨批比较需谨慎。
samples.reference: A distillation batch window affects insert order, so cross-batch comparison needs care.
samples.hypothesis: The batch window of distillation affects the order of entry and cross-batch comparisons require caution.

samples.source: 一条被锁定的术语仍可被本人再次修改，锁不是权限墙。
samples.reference: A locked row stays editable by its own author; a lock is not a permission wall.
samples.hypothesis: A locked term can still be modified by the user, and the lock is not a permission wall.

samples.source: 术语治理的效果最终体现在一致性指标，而不是条目数量。
samples.reference: Governance shows up in consistency metrics, not in row counts.
samples.hypothesis: The effectiveness of terminology governance is ultimately reflected in consistency indicators rather than in the number of entries.

samples.source: 一个领域包的覆盖率要按语料实测，不靠条目数推断。
samples.reference: Measure a pack's coverage against the corpus, do not infer it from row counts.
samples.hypothesis: The coverage of a domain package is measured by lexical content rather than by the number of entries.

samples.source: 新词冷启动阶段，人工先补几条高价值术语比批量灌入更有效。
samples.reference: At cold start, a few hand-picked high-value terms beat bulk import.
samples.hypothesis: In the cold-start phase, it is more effective to manually fill in a few high-value terms than to inject them in bulk.

samples.source: 同一术语的两种译法并存时，要显式选择并记录原因。
samples.reference: Where two renderings coexist, choose explicitly and record why.
samples.hypothesis: When two translations of the same term coexist, the choice should be made explicitly and the reasons documented.

samples.source: 飞轮假设的是正确译法被复用，错误复用会放大问题。
samples.reference: The flywheel assumes correct renderings get reused; reusing wrong ones amplifies them.
samples.hypothesis: The flywheel assumes that the correct translation is repeated, and that the wrong translation magnifies the problem.

samples.source: 一个术语包的许可与来源要可追溯，禁止传染性许可进入。
samples.reference: Keep a pack's licence and provenance traceable, and exclude copyleft sources.
samples.hypothesis: The license and source of a glossary should be traceable, preventing contagious licenses from entering.

samples.source: 术语表条目要能按来源批量清理，便于回退一次误灌。
samples.reference: Allow bulk cleanup by provenance, to undo one bad import.
samples.hypothesis: Glossary entries should be able to be cleaned in batches by source to facilitate the return of a misfill.

samples.source: 一次导入部分失败必须整体拒绝，不留半套条目。
samples.reference: Refuse a partially failed import whole, leaving no half-applied rows.
samples.hypothesis: If a partial import fails, it must be rejected as a whole, leaving no half-set of entries.

samples.source: 一条术语的置信度不由导入路径抬高，声明值就是最终值。
samples.reference: Do not raise a declared confidence during import; the authored value is final.
samples.hypothesis: The credibility of a term is not elevated by the import path, and the declaration value is the final value.

samples.source: 删除领域行需要按完整主键操作，否则碰到同名通用行。
samples.reference: Deleting a domain row needs the full key, or it hits a generic twin instead.
samples.hypothesis: To delete a field row, the entire primary key must be used, otherwise the generic row of the same name will be encountered.

samples.source: 术语治理的评审节奏要与语料扩充同步，否则指标漂移。
samples.reference: Keep glossary review in step with corpus growth, or metrics drift.
samples.hypothesis: The pace of terminology governance review must be synchronized with the expansion of the vocabulary, otherwise the indicators will drift.

samples.source: 一条被禁用的术语要能保留历史而不参与注入。
samples.reference: Keep a retired term for history while excluding it from injection.
samples.hypothesis: A banned term should be able to preserve history without participating in the injection.

samples.source: 术语表要按客户环境分级：通用、领域、项目三层。
samples.reference: Layer glossaries by scope: generic, domain and project.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary is organized according to the client environment: three levels: general, field and project.

samples.source: 一个词的多义性要靠上下文消歧，而不是靠强制唯一。
samples.reference: Handle polysemy with context, not by forcing one rendering.
samples.hypothesis: The ambiguity of a word is determined by its context, not by imposing its uniqueness.

samples.source: 飞轮的度量要包含升级率，升级频繁说明本地能力不足。
samples.reference: Include the upgrade rate in flywheel metrics; frequent upgrades mean local capability is thin.
samples.hypothesis: The measurement of the hovercraft should include the rate of upgrades, the frequency of which indicates inadequate local capacity.

samples.source: 一次测量若只跑单臂，就没有可比的对照组。
samples.reference: A single-arm measurement has nothing to compare against.
samples.hypothesis: There is no comparable control group if only one arm is measured.

samples.source: 术语注入与记忆复用是两条通路，效果要分别归因。
samples.reference: Injection and memory reuse are two paths; attribute their effects separately.
samples.hypothesis: Term injection and memory reuse are two pathways, each of which has its own effects.

samples.source: 一个领域包的评审记录要能指向具体条目变更。
samples.reference: Pack review must point to specific row changes.
samples.hypothesis: The review record of a domain package must be able to point to specific entry changes.

samples.source: 术语冲突处理要保守，宁可报出歧义也不静默改写。
samples.reference: Handle term conflicts conservatively: report ambiguity instead of rewriting silently.
samples.hypothesis: Conflicts of terminology should be handled conservatively, and ambiguities should be declared rather than silently rewritten.

samples.source: 一条自动条目的默认置信度要低于人工确认的值。

samples.source: 源码注释统一英文，面向用户的文案按产品语言。
samples.reference: Keep source comments in English and user-facing copy in the product language.
samples.hypothesis: The source code notes are consistent in English, and the user-oriented texts are in the product language.

samples.source: 每个对外数字都要能追到一次可复现运行。
samples.reference: Trace every published number to one reproducible run.
samples.hypothesis: Each external number must be traced back to a repeatable operation.

samples.source: 评审前要自查规范合规缺口，不等他人指出。
samples.reference: Self-check convention compliance before review, not after being told.
samples.hypothesis: Self-assessment of normative compliance gaps prior to assessment, rather than waiting for others to point them out.

samples.source: 变更后的旧承诺句要一并搜干净，避免残留两处。
samples.reference: Search out stale promises after a change, so no second copy survives.
samples.hypothesis: The altered old commitment sentences should be cleaned up together to avoid leaving two places.

samples.source: 台账与代码不一致时先信代码并回写台账。
samples.reference: Trust code over the ledger on conflict, then correct the ledger.
samples.hypothesis: When the counter and the code do not match, first send the code and write back the counter.

samples.source: 一次跑批前要确认范围参数与它可能覆盖什么。
samples.reference: Confirm a run's scope and what it can overwrite before starting it.
samples.hypothesis: Before running a batch, verify the scope parameter and what it may cover.

samples.source: 文档里的命令要能直接执行，不写伪代码。
samples.reference: Keep documented commands executable, never pseudocode.
samples.hypothesis: The commands in the document must be executed directly, without writing fake code.

samples.source: 测试的跳过原因要打印出来，SKIP 不是通过。
samples.reference: Print a skip reason; a skip is not a pass.
samples.hypothesis: The reason for skipping the test is printed out, and SKIP is not passed.

samples.source: 一次修复的解释要绑定到具体证据而不是印象。
samples.reference: Bind an explanation to concrete evidence, not to recollection.
samples.hypothesis: The explanation of a repair is tied to concrete evidence rather than impressions.

samples.source: 共享计数只允许一处真相，两处会互相打脸。
samples.reference: Keep one source of truth for a shared counter, or two disagree.
samples.hypothesis: Shared counting allows only one truth, and the two face each other.

samples.source: 新旋钮要有上下界与注入接缝，便于测试钉住。
samples.reference: Give a new knob bounds and an injection seam so tests can pin it.
samples.hypothesis: The new knob should have an upper and lower boundary with the injection seam to facilitate test pinning.

samples.source: 一次变更的边界要在提交信息里写清未做什么。
samples.reference: State what a change deliberately did not do, in its message.
samples.hypothesis: When a boundary is changed, what has not been done should be clearly stated in the submission.

samples.source: 缺陷编号要与分项口径一致，避免按编号排工错位.
samples.reference: Keep a defect's sub-item numbering consistent, or work split by number misaligns.
samples.hypothesis: The numbering of defects should be consistent with the sub-item caliber to avoid misalignment with the numbering ...

samples.source: 可复跑的入口要登记在意图清单里，别只留在聊天记录。
samples.reference: Register a re-runnable entry in the intent table, not in chat history.
samples.hypothesis: Repeatable entries should be registered in the intent list, not just in the chat log.

samples.source: 一次评测的输入与脚本一起入库，便于重放。
samples.reference: Commit an evaluation's inputs with its script, to allow replay.
samples.hypothesis: The input of a test is stored with the script for easy replay.

samples.source: 测量结果要注明环境前提，跨机引用时不可省略。
samples.reference: Note environment preconditions; they are not optional in a cross-machine citation.
samples.hypothesis: Environmental assumptions must be indicated in the measurement results and must not be omitted in cross-references.

samples.source: 文档的引用要指向能被他人跑起来的东西。
samples.reference: Cite things other people can actually run.
samples.hypothesis: Documentation references should point to something that can be run by others.

samples.source: 一次修复要连带检查同一形状的其他位置。
samples.reference: After a fix, check for the same shape elsewhere in the tree.
samples.hypothesis: In one repair, other locations of the same shape are checked together.

samples.source: 语音闭环的耗时由分段、识别、翻译与合成四段串联而成。
samples.reference: The voice loop chains segmentation, recognition, translation and synthesis in series.
samples.hypothesis: The time-consuming process of speech looping consists of segmentation, recognition, translation, and synthesis.

samples.source: 识别错误会向翻译与合成传染，段级评估要独立跑。
samples.reference: Recognition errors propagate into translation and synthesis, so score segments independently.
samples.hypothesis: Identification errors are transmitted to translation and synthesis, and segment evaluation runs independently.

samples.source: 麦克风增益过高会让削波后的波形失去可识别性。
samples.reference: Excessive microphone gain pushes the waveform into clipping and ruins recognisability.
samples.hypothesis: Excessive microphone gain can make the cut-off waveform unrecognizable.

samples.source: 录音静音裁剪要在分段之后做，不能在波形上做能量阈值一刀切。
samples.reference: Trim silence after segmentation, not by a blanket energy threshold on the waveform.
samples.hypothesis: The cut-out of recording silence should be done after the segments and not on the waveform with a one-size-fits-all energy threshold.

samples.source: 扬声器输出的音量归一化要放在编码前而不是编码后。
samples.reference: Normalise speaker output volume before encoding, not after.
samples.hypothesis: The volume unification of the speaker output is placed before the encoding, not after the encoding.

samples.source: 播放头跨段跳变时要触发一次冲刷，避免残留上一段音频。
samples.reference: Flush the buffer when the playhead crosses a segment, or the previous audio lingers.
samples.hypothesis: When the playhead jumps between segments, a wipe is triggered to avoid leaving the previous audio segment.

samples.source: 多说话人播客要先分流再分配合成通道。
samples.reference: Route multiple speakers apart before assigning synthesis channels.
samples.hypothesis: Multi-speaker podcasts have to be diverted before allocating synthesis channels.

samples.source: 语音链路的模型体积上限要按首装下载条件定。
samples.reference: Set the voice model size ceiling by first-install download conditions.
samples.hypothesis: The model volume limit for voice links is determined by the initial download condition.

samples.source: 演示阶段的转写加翻译不能被称为同传。
samples.reference: A transcript plus translation in a demo must not be called simultaneous interpretation.
samples.hypothesis: The transcription and translation of the demonstration stage cannot be called co-translation.

samples.source: 合成侧的音色切换要在段边界生效，避免段内跳变。
samples.reference: Switch timbre at segment boundaries, not mid-segment.
samples.hypothesis: On the synthesis side, the tonal switching takes effect at the segment boundaries, avoiding inter-segment jumps.

samples.source: 识别与翻译用同一语言代码集合，避免两侧口径分叉。
samples.reference: Share one set of language codes between recognition and translation, or the two diverge.
samples.hypothesis: Identification and translation are collected using the same language code to avoid bifurcation on both sides.

samples.source: 语音素材的采样率要与模型要求对齐。
samples.reference: Match voice material's sample rate to what the model expects.
samples.hypothesis: The sample rate of the voice material must be aligned with the model requirements.

samples.source: 分段策略改变会同时影响可懂度与延迟，需一起评估。
samples.reference: A segmentation change moves both intelligibility and latency, so judge them together.
samples.hypothesis: Changes in segmentation strategies affect both comprehensibility and delay and need to be assessed together.

samples.source: 合成失败时保留文本结果，不能连带丢弃转写。
samples.reference: Keep the text result when synthesis fails, rather than losing the transcript too.
samples.hypothesis: If the synthesis fails, the text result is retained, and the transcription cannot be discarded.

samples.source: 端到端语音评测的样本要包含噪声与口音两种条件。
samples.reference: Voice evaluation samples must cover both noisy and accented conditions.
samples.hypothesis: Samples for end-to-end voice assessment include both noise and accent conditions.

samples.source: 声码器的选择影响自然度上限，与模型规模不完全同向。
samples.reference: A vocoder bounds naturalness, and not in lockstep with model size.
samples.hypothesis: The choice of acoustic encoder affects the upper limit of naturalness and is not entirely in line with the scale of the model.

samples.source: 识别语言检测在中英混排素材上不稳定，需要按语段回退。
samples.reference: Language detection is unstable on mixed Chinese-English material, so fall back per segment.
samples.hypothesis: The language recognition detection is unstable on Chinese-English mixed material and needs to be returned by segment.

samples.source: 模型量化到 int8 后体积下降明显，自然度损失要按任务测。
samples.reference: Int8 quantisation shrinks size; measure the naturalness cost per task.
samples.hypothesis: The volume decreases significantly after quantification of the model to int8, and the loss of naturalness is measured by task.

samples.source: 链路里任何一段换模型，都要重跑端到端指标。
samples.reference: Rerun end-to-end metrics whenever any single model in the chain changes.
samples.hypothesis: Any part of the link that changes model requires the end-to-end indicator to be rerun.

samples.source: 语音交付要能只给转写与字幕，不强制合成。
samples.reference: Allow delivery of transcript and subtitles without forcing synthesis.
samples.hypothesis: Voice delivery should be able to provide only transcription and subtitles, not compulsory synthesis.

samples.source: 离线语音包要能单独更新识别或合成一侧。
samples.reference: Let an offline voice package update recognition or synthesis independently.
samples.hypothesis: Offline voice packs must be able to update the recognition or synthesis side separately.

samples.source: 说话人分离在重叠语音上会合并两人，需人工复核。
samples.reference: Speaker diarization merges two voices on overlap, so keep human review.
samples.hypothesis: Separate speakers will merge on overlapping voices and require manual review.

samples.source: 强制对齐的时间戳精度决定字幕可用性与配音定位。
samples.reference: Forced-alignment timestamp accuracy decides subtitle usability and dubbing placement.
samples.hypothesis: The time stamp accuracy of the forced alignment determines the availability and positioning of the subtitles.

samples.source: 逆文本规整把口语数字转成书面形式，影响下游解析。
samples.reference: Inverse text normalization turns spoken numbers into written form, which downstream parsing depends on.
samples.hypothesis: Reverse transcription translates spoken numbers into written form, affecting downstream analysis.

samples.source: 词表覆盖不足会让专名切成碎片，识别质量随之下降。
samples.reference: A thin vocabulary shreds proper nouns and drags recognition down.
samples.hypothesis: Inadequate coverage of the glossary fragments the names and thereby decreases the quality of identification.

samples.source: 半精度推理在部分硬件上不支持，需要回退路径。
samples.reference: Half-precision inference is unsupported on some hardware, so keep a fallback.
samples.hypothesis: Half-precision reasoning is not supported on some hardware and requires a return path.

samples.source: 模型权重的来源与许可要一并交付，不能只给文件。
samples.reference: Deliver a model's provenance and licence with the weights, not the file alone.
samples.hypothesis: The source of the model weights should be delivered with the license, not just the documentation.

samples.source: 流式合成落地前，语音产品叙述只承诺转写与翻译。
samples.reference: Until streaming synthesis lands, voice product copy promises transcript and translation only.
samples.hypothesis: Until the arrival of stream synthesis, voice product narration only committed to transcription and translation.

samples.source: 语音链路的评测要避免与常驻服务争用同一设备。
samples.reference: Keep voice evaluation off the device a resident service is using.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation of the voice link avoids competing for the same equipment as the resident service.

samples.source: 识别置信度低的段要在字幕里标注而非静默替换成猜测。
samples.reference: Flag low-confidence segments in subtitles rather than guessing silently.
samples.hypothesis: Identify low-credibility passages by marking them in the captions rather than silently replacing them with guesses.

samples.source: 音频格式转换要显式选择是否重采样并声明滤波器。
samples.reference: Make resampling and filter choice explicit in audio format conversion.
samples.hypothesis: The audio format conversion explicitly selects whether to re-sample and declares the filter.

samples.source: 语音模型的更新周期与产品发布周期不同步，要能独立升级。
samples.reference: Voice model updates land off the product release cycle, so allow independent upgrade.
samples.hypothesis: The update cycle of the voice model is not synchronized with the product release cycle and must be upgraded independently.

samples.source: 转写与译文要能分别导出，供不同下游使用。
samples.reference: Export transcript and translation separately for different downstream needs.
samples.hypothesis: Transcriptions and translations should be exported separately for different downstream uses.

samples.source: 合成语速与字幕停留时长要共同满足阅读约束。
samples.reference: Match synthesis pace and subtitle dwell to one reading constraint.
samples.hypothesis: The synthesis speech speed and the length of the subtitles stay together to meet the reading constraints.

samples.source: 语音素材的时长统计要按有效语音段而非文件长度。
samples.reference: Measure voice material by active speech span, not file length.
samples.hypothesis: The length of the audio material is measured by the length of the active voice segment, not by the length of the file.

samples.source: 链路里的每段延迟都要单独可测，否则优化无据。
samples.reference: Make each stage's latency measurable, or optimisation has no basis.
samples.hypothesis: Each delay in the link must be individually measurable, otherwise optimization is unfounded.

samples.source: 模型体积与首次可用时间的权衡由产品场景决定。
samples.reference: Balance model size against time-to-first-use by product scenario.
samples.hypothesis: The trade-off between model size and first availability time is determined by the product scenario.

samples.source: 语音交付的验收要在目标机型上做，而不是开发机。
samples.reference: Accept voice delivery on the target machine, not the development box.
samples.hypothesis: Acceptance of voice delivery is done on the target machine, not the developer machine.

samples.source: 语音闭环的失败要指出是哪一段失败，不整体报错.
samples.reference: Failures in the voice loop must name the failing stage, not the loop as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: Failure of the voice closed loop to indicate which is the failure, not the whole error.

samples.source: 识别词表要能按客户领域追加，避免硬改模型。
samples.reference: Extend recognition vocabularies per customer domain instead of patching a model.
samples.hypothesis: Identification glossaries should be able to be added by client domain to avoid hard modification of the model.

samples.source: 合成产物要能保留参数记录，便于复现同一效果。
samples.reference: Keep synthesis parameters so the same result can be reproduced.
samples.hypothesis: The synthetic product must retain a record of parameters to facilitate the reproduction of the same effect.

samples.source: 语音链路的质量与延迟要在同一报表里对照呈现。
samples.reference: Show voice quality and latency side by side in one report.
samples.hypothesis: The quality and latency of the voice link are compared in the same report.

samples.source: 模型清单要注明每个模型的许可、体积与获取方式。
samples.reference: List each model's licence, size and fetch method in the manifest.
samples.hypothesis: The list of models should indicate the license, volume and accessibility of each model.

samples.source: 语音评测的语料许可要与产物许可一致，避免污染。
samples.reference: Keep voice evaluation corpora licence-compatible with the product.
samples.hypothesis: Licensing of speech material for voice assessments must be consistent with product licensing to avoid contamination.

samples.source: 链路的可观测性要覆盖到每段起止时间。
samples.reference: Instrument start and end times for every stage of the chain.
samples.hypothesis: The observability of the link extends to each start and end time.

samples.source: 识别与合成的语言支持面要分别声明，不共用一个列表。
samples.reference: Declare recognition and synthesis language support separately, not as one list.
samples.hypothesis: The language supports for recognition and synthesis are declared separately and do not share a list.

samples.source: 模型获取失败要给出可复制命令与校验和预期。
samples.reference: On a model fetch failure, print the copyable command and the expected digest.
samples.hypothesis: Model acquisition fails to give replicable instructions with validation and expectations.

samples.source: 一次请求要能回读它走过的路径、耗时与最终引擎。
samples.reference: A request should read back the path it took, the time each stage spent and the engine that answered.
samples.hypothesis: A request must be able to read back the path it has taken, the time it has taken, and the final engine.

samples.source: 健康检查要区分存活、就绪与忙碌三种状态。
samples.reference: A health check should separate alive, ready and busy rather than collapsing them.
samples.hypothesis: Health checks distinguish between survival, readiness, and busyness.

samples.source: 排队中的请求要计入可见指标，否则运维只能从时间推断。
samples.reference: Requests waiting in a queue need a visible metric, or operators can only infer them from timing.
samples.hypothesis: Requests in the queue must be counted against visible indicators, otherwise operations can only be inferred from time.

samples.source: 超时配置要有上界，超出表示范围会直接断开而不是等更久。
samples.reference: A wait limit needs an upper bound; past the representable range it severs instead of waiting.
samples.hypothesis: The timeout configuration must have an upper limit, beyond which the indicated range will be disconnected immediately instead of waiting longer.

samples.source: 被放弃的请求要记账，因为它仍然消耗了一次真实计算。
samples.reference: Record abandoned requests, since they still consumed a real computation.
samples.hypothesis: The abandoned request is accounted for as it still consumes one real calculation.

samples.source: 一个建议等待时长要来自已完成工作的分位数，而不是平均值。
samples.reference: A suggested wait should come from a quantile of finished work, not from an average.
samples.hypothesis: One suggestion is that the waiting time should be derived from the digits of the work completed, rather than from the average.

samples.source: 重启兜底要能被主动触发，而不是等它自己发生。
samples.reference: A bounded restart must be triggerable on purpose, not only by accident.
samples.hypothesis: A reset must be triggered, not wait for it to happen.

samples.source: 评测跑批要按语言对限定范围，避免覆盖其他引擎的证据。
samples.reference: Scope an evaluation run by pair and engine, so evidence belonging elsewhere survives.
samples.hypothesis: Evaluation runs are limited by language to avoid overlapping evidence from other engines.

samples.source: 一个批次结束时给出汇总：条数、失败数、耗时分布与退出码。
samples.reference: Close a batch with a summary: counts, failures, the latency distribution and an exit code.
samples.hypothesis: At the end of a batch, a summary is given: the number of lines, the number of failures, the time distribution and the exit code.

samples.source: 观测数据要能区分自身开销与被测对象的开销。
samples.reference: Observability data must separate its own cost from the measured system's cost.
samples.hypothesis: The observation data must be able to distinguish between its own expenditure and the expenditure of the subject being measured.

samples.source: 一次故障复现要留下最小可重放输入。
samples.reference: Leave a minimal replayable input for every reproduced failure.
samples.hypothesis: One failover leaves the minimum replayable input.

samples.source: 指标命名要带单位与口径，避免同名指标两种含义。
samples.reference: Name metrics with unit and definition, or one label carries two meanings.
samples.hypothesis: Indicators should be named with units and scales to avoid the double meaning of the same name.

samples.source: 长时运行的告警要基于趋势与噪声带，不基于单点。
samples.reference: Long-run alerts should key off trend and noise band, not a single point.
samples.hypothesis: Long-term alerts are based on trends and noise bands rather than single points.

samples.source: 一次变更的影响要用同机同负载前后对比。
samples.reference: Judge a change on the same machine and load, comparing before and after.
samples.hypothesis: The effect of a change is compared before and after with the same machine and load.

samples.source: 评测结果要能重跑出同样的身份名，便于版本追溯。
samples.reference: A rerun must land under the same identity name, for traceability across versions.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation results should be able to rerun the same identity name to facilitate version traceability.

samples.source: 日志要能按请求标识聚合，而不是只能按时间顺序读。
samples.reference: Aggregate logs by request identity, not only by time order.
samples.hypothesis: The logs should be able to be aggregated by request ID rather than read only in chronological order.

samples.source: 一个指标的绝对值不可比，跨环境只引用相对差。
samples.reference: Absolute metric values are not comparable across environments; cite the relative difference.
samples.hypothesis: The absolute value of an indicator is not comparable, and only relative variations across environments are referred to.

samples.source: 观测接口的字段要向后兼容并标注未知含义。
samples.reference: Keep observability fields backward compatible and say what an unknown means.
samples.hypothesis: The fields in the observation interface are backward compatible and marked for unknown meanings.

samples.source: 失败行要单独落盘，便于重跑而不重复成功部分。
samples.reference: Persist failed rows separately, so a rerun does not repeat what already succeeded.
samples.hypothesis: Failure lines should be separated, so that they can be repeated without repeating the successful ones.

samples.source: 一个流程的可观测性以能否定位到阶段为准。
samples.reference: A process is observable when a fault can be localised to a stage.
samples.hypothesis: The observability of a process is based on the ability to negatively locate it to a stage.

samples.source: 评测要报告分母，未答出的行不能被算成质量差。
samples.reference: Report the denominator; unanswered rows must not be scored as low quality.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation reports the denominator, and unanswered rows cannot be counted as poor quality.

samples.source: 一次跑批的环境要记录芯片、内存、并发与常驻服务。
samples.reference: Log chip, memory, concurrency and resident services for every run.
samples.hypothesis: A batch-run environment records chips, memory, concurrency, and resident services.

samples.source: 一个指标的抖动要给出噪声带而不是只给两点。
samples.reference: Present jitter as a noise band, not as two numbers to compare.
samples.hypothesis: The shake of an indicator should give a noise band rather than just two points.

samples.source: 运维手册要写清哪些指标能判断需要扩容。
samples.reference: State which metrics indicate a need to scale, in the operations runbook.
samples.hypothesis: The operating manual should state clearly which indicators can be used to determine the need for expansion.

samples.source: 一次修复后要先确认旧遮盖手段已移除。
samples.reference: After a fix, confirm the workaround that hid it is gone.
samples.hypothesis: After a repair, first confirm that the old covering has been removed.

samples.source: 评测样本的顺序会造出假退化，回访同一批才能分辨。
samples.reference: Sample order can fake degradation; revisit the same rows to tell them apart.
samples.hypothesis: The sequence in which the samples are evaluated creates a false degradation, and it is necessary to return to the same batch to distinguish.

samples.source: 一个未度量的环节不要声称已经优化。
samples.reference: Do not claim an unmeasured step has been optimised.
samples.hypothesis: Don't claim that an unmeasured segment has been optimized.

samples.source: 指标的采集频率要高于退化发生的时间尺度。
samples.reference: Sample metrics finer than the timescale on which decay appears.
samples.hypothesis: The frequency of collection of indicators is higher than the time scale of degradation occurrence.

samples.source: 一次交付的验收要包含一条端到端可复现命令。
samples.reference: Acceptance of a delivery includes one end-to-end reproducible command.
samples.hypothesis: The acceptance of a single delivery includes an end-to-end repeatable command.

samples.source: 评测报表要指出未覆盖的语言对与领域组合。
samples.reference: An evaluation report names the pairs and domains it does not cover.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation report should indicate the combination of language pairs and domains not covered.

samples.source: 一个结论若依赖特定服务在跑，要在正文里写明。
samples.reference: State in the body when a conclusion depends on some service running.
samples.hypothesis: If a conclusion depends on a specific service to run, it should be stated in the body.

samples.source: 观测要覆盖等待时间，不只是处理时间。
samples.reference: Observe waiting time as well as processing time.
samples.hypothesis: Observations cover waiting time, not just processing time.

samples.source: 一次异常的现场要包含版本、配置与输入摘要。
samples.reference: An incident record holds version, config and an input digest.
samples.hypothesis: An exception scene contains a version, configuration, and input summary.

samples.source: 指标口径变更要同时改代码与文档，不能只改一处。
samples.reference: Update code and docs together when a metric definition changes.
samples.hypothesis: Changes in the gauge of the indicator require changes in the code and documentation at the same time, not just in one place.

samples.source: 一个跑批的日志要能安全公开，不含客户正文。
samples.reference: Keep batch logs safe to publish, without client text.
samples.hypothesis: A batch log must be securely public and must not contain client body text.

samples.source: 评测的对照组要固定为同一构建与同一数据目录。
samples.reference: Fix the control group to one build and one data directory.
samples.hypothesis: The test control group must be fixed to the same build and the same data catalog.

samples.source: 一次评测要能在报告里指回它的证据文件。
samples.reference: Every reported number should point back to its evidence artefact.
samples.hypothesis: An evaluation must be able to point back to its documentary evidence in the report.

samples.source: 运维指标要能区分用户可感等待与内部等待。
samples.reference: Distinguish user-visible waiting from internal waiting in operations metrics.
samples.hypothesis: Operational metrics must be able to distinguish between user-perceived waiting and internal waiting.

samples.source: 一个阈值要有来源，不能沿用上一次的经验数字。
samples.reference: Give every threshold a source instead of inheriting the previous number.
samples.hypothesis: A threshold must have a source and cannot be based on a previous experimental figure.

samples.source: 评测结束要清理常驻服务，避免污染下一次测量。
samples.reference: Clean up resident services after a run, so the next measurement is not polluted.
samples.hypothesis: At the end of the evaluation, the permanent service is cleaned to avoid contamination for the next measurement.

samples.source: 一次故障的结论要写它排除了什么。
samples.reference: State what an incident conclusion ruled out, not only what it found.
samples.hypothesis: A failure conclusion is to write what it excludes.

samples.source: 报表里的每个百分比都要能追到计数。
samples.reference: Trace every percentage in a report back to its counts.
samples.hypothesis: Each percentage in the statement must be trackable.

samples.source: 一个未复采的差值要标注为单次观测。
samples.reference: Mark an unreplicated difference as a single observation.
samples.hypothesis: A non-repetitive difference is marked as a single observation.

samples.source: 评测脚本要能在他人机器上原样运行。
samples.reference: Evaluation scripts must run unchanged on someone else's machine.
samples.hypothesis: Test your script to see if it will work on someone else's machine.

samples.source: 一次交付后的回访要复用同一身份名以便比较。
samples.reference: A follow-up visit reuses the same identity name so the two runs compare.
samples.hypothesis: Return visits after a delivery are repeated with the same identity for comparison purposes.

samples.source: 观测数据缺失时要显式报缺，不补默认值。
samples.reference: Report a missing observation instead of defaulting it.
samples.hypothesis: The absence of observation data should be explicitly indicated and the default values should not be supplemented.

samples.source: 一个指标的用途要在采集时就确定。
samples.reference: Decide a metric's purpose when it is collected, not afterwards.
samples.hypothesis: The use of an indicator is determined at the time of collection.

samples.source: 评测报告要写清样本量不足时不判定的规则。
samples.reference: State the rule that refuses a conclusion when the sample is too small.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation report should clearly state the rules for non-determination when the sample size is insufficient.

samples.source: 一次评测的可信度来自它能被推翻。
samples.reference: An evaluation is trustworthy because it could have failed.
samples.hypothesis: The credibility of an assessment comes from its ability to be refuted.
